name: Ducky Dash 3D
description:
Ducky Dash 3D is a fun, colorful 3D endless runner featuring an adorable duck running through a lush green forest. Jump over obstacles, collect golden coins, build combos with perfectly timed jumps, and try to beat your highest score!

Built with Three.js and WebGL, the game features a cute 3D duck character, animated jungle scenery, dynamic camera movement, particle effects, sound effects, and a smooth arcade-style gameplay experience.

Players have three lives to survive as the running speed gradually increases. Every run brings a new challenge, making Ducky Dash 3D a great addition to casual game websites, browser game portals, HTML5 game collections, and mobile-friendly gaming platforms
instructions: Tap on screen OR press Spacebar to jump

name: Dino Evolution: Survival
description:
The island is home to dozens of different dinosaurs, and each of them can become either a dangerous opponent or an important milestone on the path to your development. Explore new territories, engage in battles, and choose your targets wisely — not every enemy will be within your strength.
Each victory makes your dinosaur stronger, unlocks new opportunities, and allows you to advance further on the island.
instructions: Explore the island, find rivals, and attack. Win battles for growth, complete quests, and evolve into new species. Avoid dangerous enemies and swim through water.

name: Fishing Bay
description:
Fishing Bay is a realistic fishing game about fishing in picturesque bodies of water: lakes, rivers, and ponds. Choose a fishing rod, feeder rod, or spinning rod, select your tackle, bait, and lures, feel the bite, and hook a trophy fish at the perfect moment.
Each location is unique: it's home to carp, pike, perch, zander, bream, trout, catfish, and many other fish. Each location is unique, so the choice of float, spoon, or wobbler, along with the right tactics, makes all the difference.
instructions:
Find a fishing spot and tap the water to cast your line. When a fish bites, press the reel to reel in the fish and watch the catch and rod load indicators. Maintain balance without making any sudden movements.
Pearls are used to purchase and upgrade equipment, while experience increases your level and unlocks new mechanics.
Before fishing, choose bait based on the local fish species—this will increase your rewards. Complete quests, receive daily gifts, and use the Lucky Wheel to progress faster.

name: Snowball
description:
Winter, a backyard, two teams and a pile of snowballs! Snowball is a team snow fight: bright graphics, seven kinds of ammo, destructible snow forts and real progression.
• Quick battle 3v3 or 5v5, three difficulty levels, first to three round wins.
• An endless campaign: up to ten opponents, and the last enemy standing whistles for backup.
instructions:
Running is keyboard only, the mouse only throws.
On desktop:
• WASD or arrows — run. You can throw on the move.
• Left mouse button — hold, aim toward the cursor and release. The longer you hold, the farther the snowball flies. Space works the same way.
• Keys 1–7, Q/E or the mouse wheel — pick ammo.
• Esc — pause, F — fullscreen, M — sound.
On phones:
• Left half of the screen — movement joystick.
• Right half — drag to aim, release to throw.
• Ammo buttons at the bottom.
Tips:

name: Hero vs Traps
description:
Guide a brave hero through a series of dangerous levels where one wrong move can lead straight into a spinning blade. Moving saws, tricky mechanisms, locked passages, and unusual bosses await along the way.
Each stage presents a new objective: reach the exit, survive until the timer ends, collect chests, or activate the required objects. Completing challenges rewards you with crystals. Spend them in the in-game shop on useful abilities.
instructions:
Hold the left mouse button or touch the screen, then drag the pointer or your finger in the desired direction. The hero will follow your movement. Release to stop.
Watch the movement patterns of the saws and wait for a safe moment to advance. Do not rush through difficult areas: touching a hazard will end the attempt.
The objective changes between levels. You may need to reach the exit, survive until the timer runs out, collect a required number of items, or press a button.

name: Nuts Puzzle: Sort By Color
description:
Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color is a classic puzzle game where you sort various colored nuts onto screws until they are all the same color.
As you progress through the levels, the puzzles get trickier, requiring you to plan your moves carefully and think several steps ahead. With each successful sort, you'll feel a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Get ready to test your strategy and problem-solving skills as you work your way through increasingly complex and colorful challenges!
instructions:
- Touch any stack to select the top Nut
- Touch another stack to move the Nut into it
- Or you can drag and drop to move the Nut

name: Zoocraft 2
description: ZooCraft 2 is a colorful 2D game about a ranger building and expanding a unique zoo. Explore diverse natural biomes, discover and tame wild animals, then guide them safely to suitable enclosures. Every animal has its own personality: calm creatures are easier to approach, timid ones may run away, and aggressive animals can attack. Gather wood, stone, and food, construct new enclosures, and unlock additional territories.
instructions:
Control the ranger using the WASD keys or arrow keys. On phones and tablets, use the virtual joystick. Explore the map, gather resources, and look for wild animals.
Approach an animal and stay close to it—taming will begin automatically. The process requires food. Don't stray too far: the animal might run away, and aggressive beasts could attack and interrupt the taming. Press the Spacebar to clearly see the action radius.
Tamed animals follow the ranger.

name: Easy Halloween Coloring Quest
description:
Get ready for a fun and spooky coloring adventure with Easy Halloween Coloring Quest! Grab your favorite colors and bring charming Halloween scenes to life with pumpkins, friendly ghosts, witches, bats, haunted houses, and other festive surprises.
Choose your colors, fill each picture with your own creative style, and enjoy a relaxing coloring experience designed to be simple and fun. Whether you love cute Halloween characters or spooky scenes, every picture is a new coloring quest waiting to be completed.
Color, create, and enjoy the Halloween fun!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Barsik: Fish Tournament
description:
Fish fly. Cucumbers fall. Barsik calls it a tournament! The characters are voiced in a fun way — you definitely won’t get bored!
Pounce through the air, chain catches into combos, and dodge household chaos. Tackle 50 levels across five rooms: a cozy living room, a busy kitchen, a nursery, a leafy balcony, and a music studio. Boris the vacuum and a cast of quirky troublemakers bring flying toast, bouncing balls, gusts of wind, and disco waves!
Then make a splash in your own aquarium.
instructions:
Desktop: A/D or arrow keys to move, Space to pounce, Esc or P to pause.
Mobile: hold the lower-left or lower-right part of the playfield to move. Tap the upper playfield to pounce in that direction, or use the on-screen buttons.
Line up below a flying fish and jump into its path. Simply touching it does not count! Chain catches to build your combo and activate Fish Frenzy. Watch the warning markers and dodge hazards.
Meet the level objective and complete extra challenges for stars.

name: Word Domino Match
description:
An engaging word puzzle that combines solitaire-style mechanics with finding associations. Instead of traditional cards, you work with word tiles, discovering meaningful connections between them and forming the correct groups.
The themes are constantly changing: travel, animals, food, professions, sports, nature, everyday objects, and much more. Some connections are easy to spot, while others will make you think a little.
instructions:
Your goal is to find words connected by a common theme and group them together.
The game board contains tiles with words. Select available tiles and move them into the appropriate slots. Look at the meanings of the words and determine what association connects them.
When a correct group is completed, it is cleared and makes room for further moves. To complete the level, you need to find all of the intended word groups.
The number of available moves is limited.

name: How Hungry?
description:
Hans the Horse is very hungry. In fact, he’s so hungry that he could eat a... carrot! And it’s your job to feed him.

In this silly block‑pushing game, you will help Hans get all the treats on each island. Sounds simple, but hold your horses just yet! Think through your steps first. It’s quite a thinky game!

There are 36 levels, and each of them is a clever hand‑crafted brain teaser. Some puzzles are tricky, others are challenging, and some might even make you laugh!
instructions:
To move, use the Arrow Keys or WASD. On a mobile device, you can control the character using Swipes.
Press Z or Right Mouse Button to undo your last action. You can redo what you cancelled by pressing Y or Middle Mouse Button (scroll wheel).
Resta R to restart the level. You can undo the restart.
If you ever get stuck, you can use a hint by pressing the light bulb icon in the bottom‑right corner of the screen.

name: GMO RP: Village Chaos
description:
Welcome to an open-world village! Explore the huge map, get behind the wheel, get into fights, shootouts, and police chases.
Collect cars, steal vehicles, drift and tune your cars. The fun ragdoll system lets you fly out of cars and tumble around after crashes.
Earn in-game cash by taking on different jobs: taxi driving, ambulance work, cargo delivery, and more. Build your own business, buy new vehicles, and unlock new opportunities.
instructions:
Controls:

For PC:
Mouse — Look around.
WASD — Move.
E — Interact.
Shift — Run.
Space — Jump.
Mouse wheel — Switch weapon.
Left mouse button — Shoot.
Right mouse button — Aim.
R — Reload.
TAB — Menu / Pause.

For Mobile:
Joystick — Move.
Right side of the screen — Look around.
Jump — Button.
Shoot — Button.

name: Witch's Potion Match
description:
The witch’s cauldron is missing some ingredients!
Welcome to a magical world where every matching pair brings you closer to brewing a potion. Find identical items and bring them together, but choose carefully which ones to send down — there is very little space below.
The game combines pair-matching, logical thinking, and the physics of falling objects. Every move changes the position of the remaining items, so one mistake can turn a perfect plan into magical chaos.
instructions:
The goal is to clear the field of all items. Find identical items and interact with them to make them fall down. If an identical item is already in the pit, the two items are removed and fly into the cauldron. But if too many different items pile up in the pit, you lose the level.
Some levels feature special elements:
Portal — releases items one at a time.
Spider Web — temporarily blocks an item.
Crystal — takes up space and prevents items from falling freely.

name: Adventure Squad
description:
Adventure Squad is a tactical RPG where smart strategy and hero synergy determine the outcome of every battle!
60 Unique Classes
Recruit fighters and guide them through branching evolution trees. Each promotion drastically changes a hero’s role, stats, and abilities.
Tactics & Positioning
Formation is everything: shield fragile mages and archers behind sturdy frontline tanks. Adapt your layout against enemies that strike the backline, inflict poison, or summon reinforcements.
Combat Control
instructions:
On the squad screen, recruit heroes and drag them onto empty slots. Place defenders in front and keep archers and mages behind them.
2. Open the mission map and select an available battle.
Heroes attack automatically. Tap a ready hero ability and select a highlighted target when required. You can pause the battle.
Enable Auto mode to cast abilities automatically. Each automatic cast consumes one AutoCoin.
Defeat enemy waves, earn gold, recruit new fighters, and upgrade hero classes.

name: Standstill
description:
A top-down shooter you play like a puzzle. The world advances at exactly your speed: run and it runs, stop and it stops. Aiming costs nothing — only a step moves time.
The rules are short. One hit kills, yours and theirs alike. Six rounds and no reload: when the gun runs dry, throw it at someone's head and pick up theirs. Rooms restart instantly, with no loading and no checkpoints.
instructions:
Keyboard and mouse: WASD to move, mouse to aim, LMB to shoot, SPACE to dash, RMB to throw your gun, E to pick one up, ESC to pause.
Touch screen: left stick moves, right stick aims and the shot goes off when you lift your finger: while you hold the stick, a dotted line out of the barrel shows where the bullet will go. Throwing has its own stick, bottom right: same pull-and-release, only the gun flies instead of a bullet. DASH and GRAB stay buttons.

name: Kung-Fu Little Animals
description: In this game, you are the new assistant of the Great Master. Your task is to teach funny and dexterous little animals the art of kung fu. With simple clicks, you train your students to become worthy followers of the Master's work. As you progress through the game, you discover new animals and unusual locations. Join the kung fu team and have fun teaching the little animals martial arts!
instructions: Get to know the world of martial arts, where your guides will be animal heroes from oriental fairy tales. Control is a mouse click or a simple touch on the touch screen. If you want to speed up the passage, use bonuses, but wisely. And the result can be saved as a PNG image at any time.

name: Bubble Rush
description: Bubble Rush is a colorful bubble-shooting puzzle game. Aim and fire bubbles to match colors, clear the board, and work through increasingly challenging levels. Plan shots carefully, use helpful power-ups, and chase a new high score.
instructions: Aim with your mouse or finger, then click or tap to shoot a bubble. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to pop them. Clear the bubbles to complete a level. Use the on-screen buttons for power-ups, pause, and settings.

name: Elemental DressUp Magic
description: Welcome to the enchanting universe where the magic of nature takes on flesh! You will be greeted by the guardians of the elements - five dazzling maidens, whose beauty reflects the power of the primary elements. Fire, Water, Earth and Air come to life in their images - the makeup and outfits of each heroine are woven from the characteristic features of her element. But there is one among the girls who stands apart. The fifth virgo is the Avatar, the embodiment of harmony and unity of all four forces!
instructions: Immerse yourself in the world of magic! Here you will meet beautiful ladies of the natural elements. They will trust you to create their perfect image: choose makeup and an outfit that reflects the power and beauty of their element. And the finished masterpiece can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

name: Merge Beasts
description: Merge Beasts is a colorful card-merging puzzle game where clever moves turn matching monsters into new creatures. Arrange cards across four columns, combine identical beasts, and create chain reactions to discover higher-level monsters. Plan ahead to keep space for new cards, collect coins, and use helpful boosters when the board gets crowded. How far can you evolve your beasts?
instructions: Use the mouse on desktop or touch controls on mobile. Drag a monster card, together with the cards stacked above it, to another column. Place identical monsters next to each other in the same column to merge them into a higher-level beast. Each column holds up to seven cards, so manage your space carefully. Keep merging to discover new beasts and use the available boosters when you need help.

name: Happy Orange Glass
description:
Happy Orange Glass is a fun and challenging puzzle game where your goal is to draw a line and guide the juice safely into the glass. Plan your path carefully, avoid obstacles, and find the best way to complete each level.

Draw the Perfect Path

Use your creativity and logic to draw a path from the juice source to the glass. Think carefully before drawing, because the juice will follow the line you create.

Avoid Obstacles

Different obstacles can make each level more challenging. Find a safe route around them and make sure the juice reaches the glass without getting blocked or spilled.

Fill the Glass

Your main goal is to fill the glass with enough juice to complete the level. Try different paths to find the right solution.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: DESCENT
description: DESCENT is a downhill mountain-bike time trial. 6 kilometres of hand-routed trail and 400 metres of vertical drop: berms, rock gardens, root sections, jump lines and a final sprint. The bike is simulated for real — progressive fork and shock, per-wheel grip, load transfer, pumping and air control. Read the trail, carry speed through the berms, keep the wheels on dirt, and take down your personal best split by split. Chase the clock in Timed Runs or explore the hillside in Free Ride.
instructions: Keyboard: W/S or arrows — pedal and brake, A/D — lean, Space — pump/jump, R — restart, Esc — pause. Gamepad is supported. On the descent, braking before a corner and leaning through it is faster than dragging the brakes. Pump the backsides of rollers to gain speed without pedalling. Crashes cost seconds, not the run — get back on and finish. The default track is the ranked one: only it feeds the leaderboard.

name: Fruit Slice Dojo
description: Slice the fruits, that is your job in this game. But is not so simple, your job will be obstructed by bombs which will appear on your screen suddenly. You must be careful because if you cut a bomb, the game is over for you. Click only the fruits, fast without omissions, you can miss only 3 fruits.
instructions: Cut the fruit

name: Night Silk Dark City Fashionistas
description: Welcome to a world where fashion meets mystery. The city is falling asleep, but for the noir ladies, life is just beginning. Two friends live in this gloomy place. And tonight they will have a magnificent Gothic ball in an old mansion. Help create the perfect holiday images, which will be dominated by deep black, shades of graphite, blood red and dazzling silver. In the world of noir, there is no place for gray everyday life - there is only fatal beauty and style!
instructions: Discover the world of high fashion in the noir style - create a unique image of a femme fatale, a mysterious stranger or a lady detective. The game controls are as convenient as possible - click with the mouse or just touch the screen to bring each image to life.

name: Rat purrsuit
description: Rat Catcher is a fast-paced arcade-style game where you step into the shoes of a determined exterminator tasked with clearing out a rodent infestation. Armed with traps and quick reflexes, your goal is to catch as many rats as possible before time runs out.
instructions: Use Keyboard

name: Meowgix
description: Assume the role of a cate wizard, learn, upgrade, and combine meowgic spells to grow stronger and defeat the evil hordes.
instructions: Use keyboard

name: Dinosaur Dig
description: Set out in search of ancient fossils and experience the work of a paleontologist. Explore different locations, uncover hidden bones, carefully clean each discovery, and assemble complete dinosaur skeletons. Every stage brings a different activity, including digging, using tools, finding pieces, cleaning fossils, solving puzzles, and playing cheerful mini-games. Travel across the map, complete activities, and unlock new excavation sites. The game is suitable for children and anyone who enjoys dinosaurs, discovery, and relaxing educational adventures.
instructions: Choose an available location on the map. Use a mouse or touchscreen to control tools and complete each activity. Remove layers of soil, uncover bones, and clean away the dirt. Drag the discovered pieces into the correct places to assemble a skeleton. Follow the on-screen hints and finish every stage. In the extra mini-games, select the right objects, catch fish, or help a character avoid obstacles. Completing activities unlocks new excavation sites.

name: Race Through Traffic
description:
A single-player arcade racing game where you drive along a busy road, overtake cars, and try to survive as long as possible. The farther you go and the riskier your maneuvers are, the higher your final score becomes.

Collect coins, unlock new cars, and upgrade speed, handling, and other stats. Choose a mode, watch the road carefully, and set new records in each run.
instructions:
Control the car with on-screen buttons or the keyboard. Press A or the left arrow to move left. Press D or the right arrow to move right. Use the up and down arrows to accelerate and brake when available in the current mode.

Dodge traffic, avoid crashes, collect coins, and try to drive as far as possible. After each run, upgrade your car and unlock new vehicles.

name: SeedFall
description: Seedfall is a botanically-themed physics puzzle game where every level is a small garden waiting to bloom. Cut the vines holding your seed, guide it through gravity, wind and obstacles, and land it safely in the planter to grow your garden. Simple to pick up, deeply satisfying to master.
instructions: Cut the vines

name: Puzzle Fit the Pieces
description: Build recognizable vehicles from separate pieces. Each level presents a new guide: a train, ship, submarine, rocket, airplane, or tank. Move and rotate every element precisely while using the translucent silhouette as a reference. Keep the pieces white or switch to soft pastel colors to tell them apart more easily. The layout adapts to your screen, completed levels are saved, and every challenge works equally well for a quick break or a focused puzzle session.
instructions: Choose a level card. Drag every piece into its matching place inside the translucent guide, then rotate it until it fits precisely. On desktop, hold the left mouse button to move a piece; rotate it with the mouse wheel or the Q/E, A/D, or Z/X keys. Hold Shift to rotate faster. On a phone or tablet, move a piece with one finger and use a second finger to rotate it. The button with three diamonds toggles soft pastel colors. The level is complete when every piece is in the correct position.

name: Solitaire The Collection
description:
33 card game variants in one collection. Play familiar solitaires, discover new rules and pick the difficulty — from a calm deal to a real puzzle.

Modes include Klondike with draw one or three; Spider with one, two or four suits; FreeCell; Pyramid; Vegas; Yukon, Russian Solitaire and Alaska; Scorpion; Forty Thieves and Josephine; Tri Peaks; Golf; Eight Off; Double Klondike and Easthaven; Spiderette and Simple Simon; Memory on a normal or large board.

Take daily challenges, journeys with quests, collect keys, postcards and achievements. Customize card faces, backs and backgrounds, enable dark mode and left-handed layout. Hints, undo and auto-collect help mid-game; progress saves automatically. Winning deals greet you with sounds and a card dance.
instructions:
How to play

- Pick a solitaire from the collection and a difficulty level.
- Lay out cards by the rules of the mode: build sequences, pairs or tableaus as required.
-In Klondike-style games, build foundations by suit from ace up; on the tableau, build down by alternating colors when the rules say so.
-In Spider, assemble full same-suit sequences and remove them from the board.
-In Pyramid, clear pairs that match the mode’s sum rule.
-In Memory, flip cards and find matching pairs.

Use hints, undo and auto-collect when stuck. Choose random or solvable deals where supported. Games save automatically so you can return later. Resize cards, drag with mouse or finger, or move with a single tap.

name: Slime RNG Obby
description:
Test your luck in Slime RNG Obby — a fun online Roblox adventure full of rare slimes, exciting obby challenges, upgrades, battles, and new worlds to unlock!
Collect powerful slimes, get luckier with every roll, clear tricky obby levels, and discover new zones packed with even more slimes!
instructions:
Your goal is to collect different slimes and unlock new worlds. Level up your slimes and get rare and unique ones!

Computer controls:
W, A, S, D - move character
Spacebar - jump
Mouse movement - camera movement
Tab - show/hide cursor

Mobile controls:
Left joystick - move character
Right button - jump
Swipe the screen - move camera

name: TRACE THE STARS
description: Starlight Trace** is a beautiful and engaging one-line constellation puzzle game where players connect every star using a single continuous path. The goal is simple but challenging: trace the complete constellation without lifting your finger and without retracing any path.
instructions: Draw Line

name: BLASTING BALLS
description: Blasting Balls is a high-octane HTML5 arcade shooter packed with vibrant visuals and responsive gameplay. Players control a powerful, auto-firing cannon tasked with destroying giant falling balls by splitting them into smaller pieces. Featuring satisfying explosion effects, coin collection, three-life survival mechanics, and polished animations, it offers an escalating challenge across increasingly difficult levels.
instructions: Slide or drag left and right to control your cannon—firing is automatic.

name: Cannon Balls
description: Cannon Balls is an addictive cyberpunk-inspired arcade shooter that tests your precision, timing, and reflexes. Set against procedural space backgrounds with smooth particle effects and immersive audio, your objective is to destroy the numbered center block by firing continuous cannonballs while dodging dynamic, rotating barriers that get tougher with every level.
instructions: Press, hold, and drag the screen to align your shot.

name: Dot Split
description: Dot Split is a fast-paced, cyberpunk-inspired arcade puzzle game that tests your reflexes and precision. As glowing energy nodes descend toward the core, your goal is to manipulate neon barriers to guide every node to its correct color target. Featuring dynamic difficulty scaling, combo multipliers, particle effects, and premium neon visuals, it delivers an intense visual experience across desktop and mobile devices.
instructions: Tap and hold the screen to split the neon energy barriers and change the nodes' paths.

name: Cube Crush Quest
description: Cube Crush Quest is a fun and colorful match-3 puzzle game where you match identical cubes to clear the board. Plan your moves carefully, create powerful combinations, and aim for the highest score as you progress through challenging levels.
instructions: Match 3 or more identical cubes to remove them from the board. Create larger matches and chain combinations to earn more points. Think ahead, make smart moves, and complete each level's objectives.

name: Animal Merger
description: Animal Merge is a fun and addictive physics-based puzzle game where your goal is to drop, merge, and evolve adorable animals. Drop matching animals into the arena and combine them to create bigger and more powerful creatures, progressing through a 10-stage evolution chain from a tiny Hatchling to the mighty Tiger. Use powerful boosters such as Bomb, Freeze, 2x Score, and Swap to create better combinations, build combos, and achieve high scores. Complete daily challenges, unlock achievements, and compete against your own best score in this simple-to-learn but highly replayable HTML5 game. The game is fully responsive and works smoothly on mobile, tablet, and desktop without requiring external servers or dependencies.
instructions:
Desktop: Use the Mouse to move and position the animal, then Click to drop it into the arena. Use the available power-ups by clicking their buttons.

Mobile: Touch and drag to position the animal, then Release to drop it. Tap the Power-Up buttons to activate Bomb, Freeze, 2x Score, or Swap.

name: Clean the Squishes! ASMR Sorting Obby
description:
CLEAN UP THE SQUISHY STORE!
The best squishes in one game! Dumplings, Butter, NeeDoh and other popular ASMR toys are scattered all over a huge 3D store. Collect them all and place them on the correct shelves!
The more toys you organize, the more rewards you'll earn! Make money, buy upgrades, boost your aura, unlock new abilities, and become the fastest player to clean the entire store!
In the game you'll find:
Hundreds of squishies and popular toys
Relaxing ASMR sorting and store cleaning
instructions:
Desktop
WASD — Move
Left Mouse Button — Hide cursor (activate camera)
Mouse — Look around
F — Show cursor
Space — Jump
Left Mouse Button — Pick up, squeeze or place a squish
Q — Throw a squish
E — Activate ability
1–0 — Inventory navigation
G — Switch mode
Y — Settings
C — Magic
B — Inventory
Z — Upgrades
V — Shop
R — Rewards
Mobile Controls
Use the joystick to move.
Swipe on the right side of the screen to control the camera.
To pick up a squish, aim the camera at it and tap the item.

name: Fluffy Recipes: Cook with Love!
description:
A cozy and addictive food-themed merge game — with a cat full of personality.
Basic ingredients fall randomly into a glass. Merge identical items to create rarer and more valuable ingredients. Plan every drop carefully: if the glass becomes overfilled and the level reaches the dotted line, it will start shaking and cracking. You only have 9 lives — after that, the glass will shatter.
instructions:
The controls are simple and intuitive. Move the cursor over the glass and release the product with the left mouse button. On mobile devices, use a finger tap. If you hold the mouse button or keep your finger pressed, a trajectory guide will appear — you’ll see exactly where the item will land.
Merge identical products to create rarer and more valuable ingredients. Keep an eye on the fill level of the glass: if it reaches the dotted line, the glass will begin to shake and lose lives.

name: Starward Legacy
description:
Starward Legacy is a fast, bullet-dodging vertical space shooter (shmup) with deep meta-progression. Fly through 5 chapters of a stellar war, weave through bullet storms, shred enemy waves and topple colossal bosses.
Between battles opens an star map: jump between sectors, spend fuel wisely, find supply bases and rare rewards. Each difficulty is its own campaign.
Features:
• 6 ships + the story-ship AEGIS, assembled from 5 parts across the chapters
instructions:
Dead-simple controls: drag your ship with a finger (or mouse) — it follows your touch. Fire is automatic, so focus on dodging.
• Bomb — clears the screen in a pinch.
• Switch weapons — tap a slot; the lock pins your active weapon so pickups don't swap it.
• Time-warp — blast through slow stretches 1.5× faster.
), dock at supply bases for a free upgrade and gear. Run out of fuel and that difficulty's campaign resets — watch your reserve.

name: Fruit Pairs: Zombieland
description:
Classic triple-tile meets zombie apocalypse.
Match three identical fruits into a 7-slot tray, clearing layers one by one. But watch out — zombie fruits bite every few moves and drain your HP. Throw them into the tray and burn them in triples before your health bar hits zero.
• 60 levels with changing locations
• Boosters: undo, shuffle and lawnmower
• Stars for remaining HP + leaderboards
• Short cutscenes with sysadmin, student and veteran
instructions: Tap fruits to send them into the bottom tray. Match three identical ones to clear them. Zombie fruits can also be matched in threes, but while they stay on the board they bite every few moves and reduce your HP. Don’t let the tray fill up (max 7) and don’t lose all health. Use boosters: undo, shuffle, lawnmower (clears a row). Earn stars for remaining HP.

name: SUMO CARS 3D
description:
# SUMO CARS 3D

Get behind the wheel and enter the ultimate car-sumo battle! ????️????

Drive, boost, smash, and outmaneuver your opponents in a chaotic 3D arena where the only rule is simple: **stay on the platform and knock everyone else off.**

Battle against aggressive AI drivers, use powerful boosts to launch opponents across the arena, survive massive collisions, and pull off insane last-second saves when you're hanging over the edge.

### ???? FEATURES

* ????️ Fast-paced 3D car battles
* ???? Physics-based collisions and knockbacks
* ???? Powerful boost system
* ???? Multiple AI opponents with different behaviors
* ????️ Colorful floating arenas
* ???? Chaotic chain-reaction crashes
* ???? Last car standing wins
* ???? Simple keyboard controls
* ⚡ Quick matches designed for replayability
* ???? Fun stylized 3D graphics

**WASD / Arrow Keys** — Drive
**SPACE** — Boost
**ESC** — Pause

**RAM THEM. PUSH THEM. SURVIVE.**

# Be the last car on the arena and become the SUMO CARS champion! ????
instructions:
# HOW TO PLAY

### ???? CONTROLS

**W / ↑** — Accelerate
**S / ↓** — Reverse / Brake
**A / ←** — Steer Left
**D / →** — Steer Right
**SPACE** — Activate Boost
**ESC** — Pause Game

### ????️ OBJECTIVE

Your goal is simple:

**Knock every opponent off the arena and be the last car standing.**

name: Zig Zag
description:
ZigZag is a fast-paced tapping game where the player controls a ball moving along a narrow, winding path. The ball moves continuously, and each tap changes its direction at the right moment. The goal is to stay on the path for as long as possible without falling off.

As the game progresses, the movement becomes faster and more challenging, requiring quick timing and precise taps. Each successful turn or section increases the player's score. If the ball misses the path, the game ends, and the player can restart to try for a higher score.

The gameplay is simple, minimal, and addictive, with easy one-tap controls but increasingly difficult timing.
instructions:
How to Play

Wait 3 seconds for the game to begin.

Tap anywhere on the screen to change the ball’s direction.

Time your taps carefully to keep the ball on the zigzag path.

Don’t fall off the edge!

The longer you survive, the higher your score.

If you fall, tap to restart and try again.

name: Cubes Match 3 Quest
description:
Match the cubes, create combos and complete your quest!

Get ready for a colorful Match-3 adventure with Cubes Match 3 Quest! Match three or more identical cubes to clear them from the board, earn points, and create powerful combinations. The more cubes you match, the bigger your combos and the higher your score!

Challenge yourself across fun levels filled with colorful cubes and exciting puzzles. Plan your moves carefully, discover the best combinations, and see how far you can go!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Happy Diner Rush
description:
Welcome to **Happy Diner Rush**, a fast-paced restaurant time-management game where every second counts!

Take control of a busy diner, welcome customers, guide them to their tables, take orders, serve delicious meals, collect coins, and clean tables before the next hungry guests arrive. Keep customers happy, build long service combos, earn bigger tips, and reach the target before time runs out.

Complete **20 increasingly challenging levels**, discover hidden **Secret Missions**, and return every day to complete **Daily Missions** for extra rewards. Upgrade your waitress speed, customer patience, and tip bonuses to handle even the busiest restaurant rush.

Different customers have different levels of patience, so plan your route carefully and decide who needs attention first. Serve quickly, keep everyone smiling, and turn your small diner into the happiest restaurant in town!

**Features:**
• 20 challenging restaurant levels
• Fast-paced time-management gameplay
• Daily Missions and daily rewards
• Secret objectives in every level
• Customer happiness and patience system
• Combo and Perfect Service bonuses
• Multiple customer types including VIPs and critics
• Restaurant and waitress upgrades
• Bonus coins and optional rewarded rewards
• Colorful animated characters and responsive gameplay

Can you survive the dinner rush and become the ultimate restaurant manager?

name: Ember Boy and Ripple Girl
description:
Ember Boy and Ripple Girl is a cooperative puzzle-platform game where two elemental heroes must work together to escape each level. Each character has unique environmental abilities, requiring players to switch between them, activate switches, avoid hazards, move platforms, and solve environmental puzzles.
The core gameplay focuses on cooperation, timing, exploration, and problem-solving. Players must learn where fire and water can safely travel and use both characters abilities together to reach the exit.

name: Nuts sort 3d
description: Looking for a calming experience? Explore the world of 3D Nuts Sort, a soothing and therapeutic nuts sorting puzzle game. Immerse yourself in a delightful challenge that offers stress relief and relaxation through vibrant colors and intricate colored tasks. Let 3D Nuts Sort inspire and unwind your mind.
instructions:
How to play 3D Nuts Sort:
Select a nut to transfer to another bolt, ensuring it matches in color and there's adequate space available. Strategically pour the nuts to overcome the challenges and progress through the game levels.

name: Neon Breaker
description: This game introduces the best Neon Breaker game that everyone can enjoy. Enjoy various missions and addictively simple play control by just dragging the padding to left or right to catch the ball. Break all bricks and don't let the ball fall down. Catch the power ups to help quickly destroy the bricks above.

name: Sumo Cars
description: SUMO CARS BY UBEEZY is a fast-paced futuristic car-sumo battle game featuring 100 intense levels, 10 unlockable vehicles, boss battles, physics-based collisions, and swipe controls. Knock rival cars out of the arena, defeat powerful bosses, unlock new vehicles, and conquer the entire campaign.
instructions:
Instructions

Ram enemy cars to knock them out of the arena.

Stay inside the arena and avoid the black knockout zone.

Defeat the boss to complete each level.

Win levels to unlock enemy vehicles and expand your garage.

Choose different vehicles based on their speed, hit power, and mass.

Progress through 100 levels and defeat the final boss.
Instructions

Swipe in the direction you want your car to move.

Defeat the boss to complete each level.

Win levels to unlock enemy vehicles and expand your garage.

Choose different vehicles based on their speed, hit power, and mass.

Progress through 100 levels and defeat the final boss.

name: Happy Farm Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing card adventure filled with fun TriPeaks Solitaire levels!

Clear cards from the board by creating sequences, plan your moves carefully and complete each challenge before you run out of cards.

Travel across a colorful farm map, discover new locations and face increasingly challenging layouts. Use helpful boosters or undo your last move whenever you need a little extra help.

Collect daily rewards, improve your solitaire skills and see how far your card journey can take you!
instructions:
