For example, you can place a 5 or a 7 on a 6.

Keep creating card sequences and remove as many cards from the board as possible.

If there are no available moves, draw a new card from the deck.

Use boosters and undo when you need help with a difficult situation.

Clear the entire board before running out of cards to complete the level.

name: Creepy Spa for Little Monsters
description: Welcome to the spa located in the world of Monsters! The hostess of the salon warmly welcomes each of her guests. Today, two friends came for the procedure - the mysterious mummy Nefertina and the glamorous vampire Draculina. The girls will receive skin care, makeup from a makeup artist and stylist services for the selection of hairstyles, outfits and accessories. Immerse yourself in the world of monstro-beauty together with the beautifully-terrible clients of this unusual beauty salon!
instructions: Help two beautiful creep-spa clients shine at the party: give them spa care, create flawless makeup, and help them choose the perfect beach look from a variety of outfits, hairstyles, and accessories. All controls are as convenient as possible - click with the mouse or just touch the screen to bring each image to life.

name: Budgie Spot the Difference
description:
Can you spot all the differences?

Get ready for a fun bird puzzle adventure with Budgie Spot the Difference! Look carefully at two colorful budgie pictures and try to find everything that has changed. Some differences are easy to see, while others are cleverly hidden!

Test your observation skills, find every difference, and complete each level. With cute budgies, colorful scenes, and relaxing gameplay, this is a fun game for kids and bird lovers of all ages.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Tic tac ball
description:
⚽ Tic-Tac Ball

Tic-Tac Ball is a fast-paced football twist on classic Tic-Tac-Toe. Aim your shot at one of the 9 zones of the goal and claim it for your side. But there's a catch: if you hit a zone already controlled by your opponent, you flip their mark and take it over.

Score three in a row to win!

???? Aim. Kick. Flip. Score.
???? Play against the CPU or challenge a friend in local 2-player mode.
instructions:
How to Play

1. Choose VS CPU or 2 Player Pass & Play.


2. Select a difficulty (Easy, Normal, or Pro) when playing against the CPU.


3. Aim at one of the 9 goal zones.


4. Shoot the ball to claim that zone with your mark (X or O).


5. If you hit a zone owned by your opponent, it flips to your side.


6. Take turns until someone forms 3 marks in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal).


7. If all 9 zones are filled with no winner, the match ends in a draw.


8. Press Rematch to start a new game.



Controls

Mobile: Tap the goal zone you want to shoot.

Desktop: Click a zone with the mouse or use the keyboard controls (if enabled).


Objective

Be the first player to create three marks in a row by claiming or flipping goal zones. Use smart timing and strategy to outplay your opponent and become the Tic-Tac Ball champion! ????

name: STOP
description:
STOP — Game Description

STOP is a fast-paced timing game where every move comes down to one decision: stop at exactly the right moment.

Watch the moving target, judge the timing, and hit STOP when you think you've nailed it. Land in the perfect zone to score big, build streaks, and progress through increasingly challenging levels. Miss the timing, and the round is over.

Features:

???? Precision-based one-button gameplay

???? Increasingly difficult levels

⭐ Perfect and close-hit scoring

???? Streaks and high-score chasing

♾️ Endless mode for infinite challenges

???? Sound and feedback effects

???? Responsive HTML5 gameplay


Simple to learn. Hard to master.

This fits WGPlayground well as a Casual / Arcade game, categories that are prominent on the platform.  
instructions:
How to Play — STOP

1. Watch the moving target around the circle.


2. Tap STOP when the target lines up with the highlighted zone.


3. Perfect timing earns the most points and builds your streak.


4. Close timing keeps you going but gives fewer points.


5. Miss the zone and the round ends.


6. Complete levels to unlock harder challenges.


7. Try Endless Mode and see how long you can survive.



Tip: Don’t rush — watch the movement and hit STOP at the right moment.

name: Kitty Garden Tile Puzzle
description:
Meet the cutest gardener ever — a white kitty in a straw hat and blue overalls!
In Kitty Garden Tile Puzzle you relax with classic triple tile match gameplay: tap 3 identical vegetable tiles (carrot, tomato, corn and many more), clear the board and earn crystals.
Spend crystals to:
Decorate cozy rooms — living room, bedroom, kitchen and more
Unlock heartwarming wordless comic pages about kitty’s garden adventures
Climb global leaderboards & collect achievements
instructions:
Welcome to the cozy world of the cute gardener kitty! This game is a relaxing tile-match puzzle where you collect vegetable triples, earn crystals, and furnish the kitty's house. Everything is simple and timer-free — play at your pleasure!
1. Main Gameplay: Collect Tile Triples
Vegetable tiles (carrot , tomato , corn and many others!) lie on the board.
Select 3 identical tiles and drag them to the special zone at the bottom of the screen.

name: Numerology by Ubeezy
description: Guess the number lil bro.
instructions:
????️ Instructions
The AI secretly chooses a number from 1–100.
Enter your guess and press Guess.
The game tells you whether the secret number is HIGHER or LOWER.
The possible range gets smaller after every guess.
You have 5 guesses maximum.
Get it exactly right to win.
The fewer guesses you use, the better your rank.
On the final guess, the tension reaches CRITICAL.
Controls
PC/Laptop: Mouse + keyboard; press Enter to submit.
Phone/Tablet: Tap the number field and use the on-screen keyboard, then tap Guess.

name: War Of Tanks
description:
Jump into fast-paced tank battles inspired by World War II warfare.
Choose your tank and enter quick matches. Fight alongside your team or face every opponent on your own in Free-for-All.
Choose between accessible Arcade rules and a deeper combat mode featuring armor zones, ricochets, penetration, and damage to individual tank modules.
Aim for weak spots, damage tracks, engines, turrets, and guns. Switch ammunition, use boosters, and take advantage of terrain and cover.
instructions:
On PC, use the keyboard to control your tank and the mouse to aim and move the camera.
Fire with the left mouse button or Space. Use the right mouse button or Shift to enter sniper mode.
On mobile devices, use the virtual joystick to move and swipe across the screen to control the camera. Fire, aiming, ammunition, and boosters have separate on-screen buttons.
In Team Battle, fight alongside your allies and destroy the enemy team.
In Free-for-All, every tank is your enemy.

name: Sucka Digg
description: Sucka Digg is a fast-paced arcade game where you must react quickly, avoid danger, and survive for as long as possible. Test your reflexes, chase a high score, and see how long you can last before the game gets you!
instructions:
Tap / click to control the character.

Avoid the obstacles and dangers coming your way.

Survive as long as possible to increase your score.

Keep playing to beat your high score.

Game Over ends the round — restart and try again.

name: Cozy Puzzle: Cats
description: Fit shapes onto the board, discover new cats, complete levels, and earn daily rewards.
instructions:
Drag cat-shaped pieces from the bottom of the screen onto the board. Place them so they fill the empty cells without overlapping or going outside the borders. Click a piece to rotate it, then keep dragging it into position.
Complete a level by fitting every piece into the correct place. The cleaner your solution and the fewer extra moves you make, the more stars you earn. Unlock new campaign levels, try random puzzles, and complete daily and weekly challenges.

name: Richochet 2
description:
RICOCHET 2 — Game Description

RICOCHET 2 is a precision-based arcade puzzle game where every shot counts. Fire projectiles into a maze of walls, obstacles, and moving hazards, using ricochets and precise angles to reach and destroy the glowing target.

With 100 challenging levels, different obstacle types, increasing difficulty, and multiple bullet types with unique abilities, players must plan their shots rather than simply fire directly at the target.

Features:

???? 100 levels

???? Ricochet-based physics and obstacles

???? Multiple bullet types with unique abilities

⚡ Moving and rotating obstacles

???? Score and bounce tracking

⭐ Level progression and unlocks

???? PC and mobile controls

???? Arcade-style sound effects


Goal: Calculate the angle, fire the shot, use the environment to your advantage, and destroy the target with as few shots and bounces as possible.
instructions:
PC Instructions

Aim: Move your mouse to choose the shooting direction.

Left Click: Fire the projectile.

Use the walls: Bounce shots off surfaces to reach targets from difficult angles.

Avoid obstacles: Time your shots around moving and rotating hazards.

Use special bullets: Choose the right bullet type when a level requires a different approach.

Complete the level: Hit/destroy the target to advance.

Save your shots: Try to finish levels with fewer shots and bounces for a better score.

Pause: Use the in-game pause button whenever needed.

Goal: Master the ricochets and clear all 100 levels.

name: Knife Talk
description:
KNIFETALK is a fast-paced HTML5 arcade game where players test their timing and precision by throwing knives at moving targets. Aim carefully, throw at the right moment, avoid hitting existing knives, and complete increasingly challenging levels.
The game features simple one-tap gameplay, smooth animations, score progression, sound effects, and a clean arcade-style interface. Designed for both desktop and mobile browsers, KNIFETALK is easy to learn but challenging to master.
instructions:
Instructions

Tap / Click to throw the knife.

Time your throw carefully and hit the target.

Avoid hitting knives that are already stuck in the target.

Hit the required number of targets to complete each level.

As levels progress, targets become more challenging.

Complete levels to increase your score.

If you hit an existing knife, the round ends.

Use Pause whenever you need a break.

Keep playing and aim for the highest score!

name: Candy Flow Factory
description: Welcome to Candy Flow Factory, a colorful and relaxing logic puzzle adventure! Connect matching candy machines with bright candy tubes and fill every playable tile without letting the paths cross or overlap. Plan each route carefully as 90 handcrafted levels become progressively more challenging. Enjoy cheerful candy-factory visuals, smooth controls, helpful hints, and satisfying puzzles with no timer or move limit.
instructions: Click or tap a candy machine and drag through adjacent tiles to connect it to the matching machine. Move up, down, left, or right—paths cannot cross, overlap, or enter blocked cream tiles. Connect every matching pair and fill all dark playable tiles to complete the level. Drag backward along your path to change your route.

name: BTS Budgie Coloring Book
description:
Get ready for a colorful bird adventure with BTS Budgie Coloring Book! Pick your favorite colors and bring adorable budgies to life in this fun and relaxing coloring game.

Explore cute bird pictures, fill them with bright colors, and create your own beautiful budgie artwork. Whether you love colorful birds, drawing, or simple creative games, there are plenty of fun pictures to enjoy.

Color Cute Budgies!

Choose from different colors and use your creativity to decorate each adorable budgie. Try bright feathers, colorful wings, funny patterns, and beautiful backgrounds. There are no rules—just have fun and create your own unique bird designs!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Chic Cuts
description: Chic Cuts is a stylish 2D logic puzzle set in a cozy fashion atelier. Plan each cut carefully, separate colorful fabrics, and send completed pieces into their matching baskets before you run out of moves. Solve 90 handcrafted levels, use Undo to rethink your cuts, and use Hint whenever you need a little help.
instructions: Drag with the mouse or your finger along a valid horizontal or vertical line to cut the fabric. Separate each fabric type so it can be collected into its matching basket. Complete every basket before your moves run out. Use Undo to reverse a cut and Hint if you need help finding the next move.

name: Draw The Bridge
description: Draw it. Drive it. Don’t fall! Draw the Bridge is a fun and challenging physics puzzle game where you need to draw a bridge and help your car safely reach the finish line. Every level is a new challenge – avoid obstacles and use your creativity to find the perfect path! Draw the Bridge – draw your way to victory!
instructions:
Touch Mobile 
Mouse PC

name: Zig Zag Warp
description: Zig Zag Warp is a fast-paced HTML5 endless arcade game set inside a glowing neon warp tunnel. Control a futuristic 3D arrow, dodge the shifting corridor walls, survive as long as possible, and reach higher levels as the speed increases.
instructions: Tap on screen

name: Snake 67: Save the Apple
description: Control a battle snake and protect the giant apple from waves of garden pests. Move across the field, block enemies, use the snake body for defense, and choose upgrades after waves. Each run helps you survive longer, build stronger combinations, and unlock new options.
instructions: Control the snake with WASD or arrow keys on desktop, and use the on-screen controls on mobile. Your goal is to stop pests from reaching the apple. Move around the field, block enemies with the snake body, survive waves, and choose upgrades between attacks.

name: Trump Wall Building
description:
Trump Wall Building is a fun and free online game for kids. The goal is to create the funniest face for our lovable president and watch him build the wall! This is a lighthearted parody game, so don’t take it too seriously.

Have fun and enjoy the game!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Buzztime
description:
Buzz Time — Description

Buzz Time by Ubeezy is a fast-paced reaction game where every second counts. Stay focused, wait for the perfect moment, and hit the buzzer as quickly as possible. Test your reflexes through rapid-fire rounds, chase higher scores, and see how fast you can react.

Think fast. Tap faster. Buzz in and beat your best score!
instructions:
Buzz Time — Instructions

How to Play

Wait for the red buzzer to activate.

Tap / click the buzzer as fast as possible when it lights up.

Tapping too early costs you points or time.

Each successful buzz gets harder and faster.

Build the highest score you can before the round ends.


Controls

???? Mobile: Tap the buzzer.

????️ PC: Click the buzzer or use Spacebar.


Goal: Think fast. Tap faster. Beat your high score!

name: Arrow Escape
description: Arrow Escape: Puzzle is a logic-based brain teaser where arrows block one another, and only the correct move order will clear the board. Carefully untangle routes, think ahead, and choose each move with precision. you can play more at CrazyCubix.com
instructions: Tap on arrow

name: Hookshot
description: HOOKSHOT BY UBEEZY is a fast-paced physics-based arcade puzzle game where you use a hookshot to swing, launch, and navigate through challenging levels. Master your movement, use the environment to your advantage, avoid hazards, and reach the goal. As the levels progress, the challenges get harder and require better timing, precision, and strategy.
instructions:
Aim: Move your cursor to aim the hookshot.
Hook: Click/tap to attach your hook to available points.
Swing & Launch: Use momentum to move through the level.
Avoid: Watch out for obstacles and hazards.
Reach the Goal: Get your character to the designated finish point.
Progress: Complete each level to unlock the next challenge.
Tip: Timing your hook releases is key to gaining maximum momentum

name: Ricochet
description: Physics-based ricochet shooting, strategic aiming, bouncing projectiles, destructible targets, challenging levels, obstacle mechanics, score system, multiple shot types, level progression, and replayable arcade gameplay.
instructions:
AIM: Drag from the player to aim your shot.

SHOOT: Release your finger to fire.

RICOCHET: Use walls and obstacles to bounce your projectile toward the target.

OBJECTIVE: Destroy the glowing target to complete the level.

TIP: Direct shots are not always the best option. Use ricochets and carefully calculate your angle to reach difficult targets.

Complete levels, conserve your shots, and try to achieve the highest score possible.

name: Royal Defense
description: Build a strong defense and hold the road against incoming waves. Choose tower spots, upgrade archers, mages, artillery and barracks, summon heroes, and use powerful spells at the right moment. Victories unlock new levels, stars, and upgrades that help you handle tougher challenges. The game combines classic tower defense mechanics, quick tactical choices, and steady army progression.
instructions: Choose a level and start the battle. Tap empty build spots to place towers: archer towers, magic towers, artillery, or barracks. Defeat enemies, earn gold, and upgrade your defense during the fight. Watch your base lives: if enemies reach the end of the path, your lives decrease. Use spells and heroes when a wave becomes too dangerous. After winning, earn stars, unlock new levels, and buy permanent upgrades before the next battles.

name: My Tiny City
description: This is a single-player idle game about developing a city. Tap to collect in-game coins, purchase upgrades, and gradually unlock new parts of the city. Increase the number of coins received per tap and the rate of automatic coin generation, add residents, and improve comfort. The game is suitable for short sessions: actions are quick, and the city grows step by step.
instructions: Tap the city to collect in-game coins. Use them in the upgrade shop: some upgrades increase the number of coins per tap, while others speed up automatic coin generation or unlock new objects. Compare prices and choose the most useful upgrade. The more upgrades you purchase, the faster the city develops and changes.

name: Street Fist
description: A fast-paced arcade game about a fighter caught in the middle of a street showdown. Enemies approach from the left and right, and your task is to choose the correct direction and strike at the right moment. Every defeated gangster increases your score, while the pace keeps rising and a single mistake can end the run. Earned points remain available between games. Spend them to unlock new fighters and change your hero’s appearance. Simple controls let you jump straight into the action, while the increasing difficulty tests your reactions, focus, and sense of rhythm. How many enemies can you defeat in one attempt?
instructions: Click or tap the left half of the screen to strike an enemy approaching from the left. Click or tap the right half to attack an enemy approaching from the right. Do not strike too early: wait until the enemy is within attack range. If a gangster reaches your hero, the attempt ends. You receive one point for every defeated enemy. Spend accumulated points in the fighter selection screen to unlock new characters. During a game, use the pause button to continue, restart the attempt, or adjust the sound settings.

name: Dangerous Turn
description: Test your reflexes in a fast arcade challenge with simple controls and steadily increasing difficulty. Your hero travels along a winding path where every new section may hide a trap, obstacle, or useful bonus. Collect coins, avoid fire, ice, and spikes, use power-ups, and try to travel as far as possible. Spend collected coins to unlock new characters. Improve your high score, choose your favorite hero, and return for a daily reward. Quick sessions make the game suitable for both a short break and a longer high-score run.
instructions: Tap the screen or click the left mouse button to change direction. Your hero moves automatically along a diagonal path. React early to avoid falling or hitting obstacles. Collect coins and useful items along the way. Some power-ups grant temporary invincibility, while others help you deal with traps. The farther you travel, the faster and more difficult the path becomes. After a failed run, start again or open the character selection menu. Use collected coins to unlock new heroes.

name: Endless Golf Tour
description: This is a fast-paced arcade challenge where every shot continues your journey across an ever-changing course. Choose the direction and power, watch the wind, and try to reach the next hole with a limited number of strokes. Collect coins along the way and unlock new balls. The terrain is generated as you advance, so every new section demands careful aim and quick adaptation. Improve your best score and discover how far you can go.
instructions: Press or touch the screen and drag to choose the direction and power of your shot. Release to launch the ball. Account for the wind direction and the shape of the terrain. Reach the hole before you run out of available strokes. A successful shot grants additional strokes so you can continue your journey. Collect coins on the course and use them to unlock new balls. The run ends if all attempts are spent before the ball reaches the hole.

name: Cooking Chinese Dishes
description: A colorful cooking game where players prepare popular Asian dishes step by step. Choose ingredients, mix, cut, roll dough, boil, fry, decorate and taste the finished food. The game includes several mini levels with different recipes: noodles, sweet dumplings, dim sum, fortune cookies and spring rolls. Controls are simple and fit short play sessions: tap, drag items and complete actions on the screen. No complicated rules or extra text, just a clear visual cooking process.
instructions: Choose a dish and complete each cooking step in order. Tap the needed items, drag ingredients, use kitchen tools and follow the visual prompts on the screen. Different stages ask you to mix food, roll and cut dough, boil or fry dishes, choose sauces, decorations and fillings. When the dish is ready, move to the next stage or pick another recipe. The controls work with a mouse or touch screen.

name: Funny Volleyball
description: This is a light and dynamic sports arcade game about volleyball. Control your character, jump, hit the ball and try to score the required points before the computer opponent does. The game includes different characters, balls, rewards and gradual progress. Matches are quick, so you can play one round in a couple of minutes or stay longer to unlock new items and improve your result. Simple physics, clear rules and bright 3D visuals make it easy to enjoy short play sessions.
instructions: Use the movement buttons to move your character around the court. Jump to reach high balls and hit the ball at the right moment. Try to send the ball to the opponent’s side so it cannot be returned. Watch the score and the ball position: the better your timing, the higher your chance to win the rally. Earn coins, unlock new balls and characters, return to the menu for upgrades and keep playing against the computer opponent.

name: Ninja on the Run
description: An endless path awaits, packed with traps, dangerous enemies, and shining coins. Test your reflexes, leap over gaps at the right moment, and strike before an enemy ends the run. The farther you travel, the higher your score becomes. Spend collected coins to unlock new characters. Every attempt is another chance to sharpen your timing, beat your record, and reach a little farther.
instructions:
The character runs automatically.
On a computer:
• click the left side of the game area to jump;
• click the right side of the game area to attack.
On a phone or tablet:
• tap the left side of the screen to jump;
• tap the right side of the screen to attack.
Leap over gaps and obstacles, attack enemies, and collect coins. Coins can be used to unlock new characters. The run ends when you hit a hazard.

name: Bump the Balls
description:
Test your logic and understanding of physics in an engaging puzzle game. Your objective is to help two balls meet by drawing a suitable line.

Once the drawing is complete, the balls begin moving under the force of gravity. Consider the position of obstacles, dangerous objects, and moving mechanisms. Sometimes a simple platform is enough, while other levels require a more elaborate route.

The game includes 100 unique levels. The difficulty gradually increases as new obstacles appear and solutions require greater precision. If a level seems too difficult, you can use a hint.
instructions:
1. Press an empty area and drag your finger or cursor to draw a line.
2. Release your finger or mouse button to finish the drawing.
3. Physics will activate, and the balls will begin to move.
4. Help the two balls reach each other.
5. Use a hint if you cannot find the solution.

name: Candy Farm
description:
A bright casual puzzle game with sweets, simple rules, and quick levels. Find groups of matching items, collect them, and complete each level goal: reach the target score or gather specific sweets.

Every level has a new objective and limited time, so quick attention and smart choices matter. The larger the group you collect in one tap, the more points you can earn.

The game is easy to start and comfortable to play during short breaks. Controls are simple, sessions are fast, and progress is saved between launches.
instructions:
Find a group of three or more matching sweets and tap it to collect the items.

Watch the level goal. Some levels ask you to reach a target score, while others ask you to collect specific sweets.

The bigger the group, the more points you earn. Try to choose large groups and avoid weak moves.

Each level has limited time. Complete the goal before time runs out to win.

Use earned coins for bonuses before starting a level.

name: Color Mosaic
description:
Enjoy a relaxing logic puzzle built around colorful shapes. Drag pieces onto empty cells and create groups of the same color. The more cells you clear in one move, the more points you earn.
Several shapes are always available, so planning ahead matters. Save room for larger pieces, build combinations, and try to beat your best score. The round continues while at least one available shape can still fit on the board.
Play for a quick break or settle in for a longer thoughtful session. There is no time limit, so you can study the board and choose the most rewarding move at your own pace.
instructions:
Choose one of the available shapes at the bottom of the screen.
Drag it onto empty cells on the board.
Connect several neighboring cells of the same color to clear them and earn points.
Plan each placement and keep enough free space for upcoming shapes.
The round ends when none of the available shapes can fit on the board.

name: Airport Seven Jobs
description: Try different airport jobs and complete seven engaging challenges. Scan luggage, help passengers check in, collect shopping-list items, clean the cabin, wash and prepare the plane for departure, provide first aid, and serve passengers on board. Each mini-game has its own rules, interactive tools, and colorful animations. Complete tasks carefully and quickly to earn up to three stars, collect points, and improve your total score. Simple controls make every activity easy to learn.
instructions: Choose a challenge on the airport map. Follow the on-screen hints and use a mouse or touch controls. Drag items to the correct places, use tools, find suspicious luggage, connect routes, and serve passengers. In timed challenges.

name: Tidy Up the Dollhouse
description: The little ones have made a huge mess! Eight colorful rooms are filled with misplaced objects, dusty surfaces, stains, cobwebs, and rubbish. Return every item to the correct spot, rotate and assemble objects, throw rubbish away, and clean each area with the right tool. Every room has a time limit, so work carefully and keep moving. Use a hint when the next task is difficult to find. Completing a room unlocks the next one. Finish all eight rooms and make the whole house shine.
instructions: Choose an available room on the map. Drag objects with a mouse or finger and place them where they belong. Tap objects that need to be rotated or changed. Move rubbish into the bin. For stains, dust, and cobwebs, select the correct tool

name: Railroad Master
description: Become a train worker who has to help passengers get to their destinations. This is a fun and exciting game where you have to perform simple but important tasks! The main tasks in the game: Boarding passengers: At each station, you need to board passengers in the right cars. Sometimes passengers need help getting out, sometimes they can be a little capricious - but it's all in your hands!
instructions: PC: Movement - WASD, arrows or hold LMB and drag in the desired direction. Mobile: Movement - move your finger in the desired direction.

name: Obby: Epic SkatePark
description: Obby: Epic SkatePark is a blend of skateboarding, parkour, and arena combat set in a vibrant, physics‑driven world. You are a fearless skater who lives for the rush of speed, the thrill of perfect landings, and the chaos of dodging other riders. Whether you're grinding rails, soaring over gaps, or throwing yourself into insane parkour lines, the challenge is always evolving.
instructions:
WASD - move around
RMB + drag - rotate camera with mouse
SHIFT - RUN in usual mode
LMB - basic attack
SPACE - jump
SHIFT - drifting in skate mode

name: wheee
description: wheee is a real-time 1v1 tactics game on a 7×7 grid. Two players move and reshape the landscape simultaneously — raise hills for cover, dig pits as traps. After every 5 moves, a cataclysm strikes: wind pushes players off the edge, rain floods low ground. Survive the elements while your opponent doesn't. Three unique characters. A compass hints at wind direction, a barometer shows rain chance. Spectators predict outcomes and earn points. An Architect role lets you control the weather.
instructions: Pick a character and hit Play — matchmaking is automatic. Each round has 5 simultaneous moves. On each turn: move to an adjacent cell (8 directions), raise a cell to build a protective hill, or lower a cell to dig a trap. After 5 moves, a cataclysm hits: wind pushes you sideways (hills block it, flat ground doesn't), rain floods pits (standing in one means drowning). Use the compass for wind direction and the barometer for rain chance. Win by letting the elements eliminate your opponent.

name: Mystery Mansion Lost in the no spotlight rooms
description: Solve the mystery of the disappearance of the famous millionaire James Hartman, who lived in an ancient manor, similar to a haunted mansion. As a detective, you'll have to solve challenging puzzles, explore no spotlight rooms, and find clues that lead to solving the crime. As you delve deeper into the case, you will realize that the old walls hide something much darker and otherworldly.
instructions: Two control methods are available: mouse or touch screen. Interacting with items is done by tapping on them, and moving around the locations is done through the pointers on the screen. When searching for hidden objects, double-tap the item to collect it.

name: Coloring: Mosaic by Symbols
description:
Coloring: Mosaic by Symbols – a relaxation game where you become a virtual artist of diamond mosaics.
Game Features:
- Symbol-based coloring – each color in the picture is linked to a specific symbol. For example: heart, star, flower.
- Symbol Upgrades – for each symbol, you can unlock 3 skills using Flowers. Flowers are earned by coloring pictures.
- Beautiful paintings on various themes: landscapes, animals, travel, fantasies and fairy tales.
instructions:
The goal of the game is to paint over as many pictures as possible.
Economy:
- The game has in-game currency, which is intended only for use within the game and cannot be exchanged for real money.
- At the beginning of the game you are given 1000 gold coins. For this money you can buy sets of paintings.
- During the painting process, coins will fall out. Collect them and you can buy new paintings.

name: BeesPuzzle
description:
Welcome to the cozy world of little bees! BeesPuzzle is a casual puzzle, where every level is a new mini-puzzle with vibrant, colorful artwork.

Drag the hives across the field and help the bees collect tiles. The further you go, the trickier it gets.

The perfect game to unwind in the evening, take a break, or pass the time on the go. No stress, no timers — just warm buzzing and sweet honey.
instructions:
Goal — fill all the slots on the board and collect all the tiles.

Controls:
• Tap a hive of the desired color — the bees will fly out to collect the tiles.
• Objects connected by a rope move together. Drag any one — the rest will follow.
• Unlock hives that are currently unavailable.
• The speed-up button at the bottom of the screen makes the bees fly faster when you don't feel like waiting.

Enjoy the game!

name: Deep Orbit
description:
Dive a glowing neon submarine straight down through hand-crafted deep-sea corridors in
Orbit Deep, a one-touch precision arcade game. Hold left or right to bank your sub around
drifting hazards, closing gates, and narrowing walls — one hit and it's a hull breach.

Race through a story mode of hand-built levels, each with its own layout and escalating
challenge, or push your reflexes in Infinite Madness, an endless descent that gets faster
and tighter the deeper you go. Chase your best time on every level, collect pearls for a
clean no-damage run, and see how deep you can go before the pressure gets you.

Simple to pick up, hard to master — steer with a single hand, no menus to fight, no combos
to learn. Just you, the current, and the deep.
instructions:
- Steer: hold the LEFT or RIGHT half of the screen (touch), or Arrow Keys / A-D (keyboard)
- Pause: Esc or P
- Sound toggle: S or the speaker icon
- Restart: R
- Touch is the primary control scheme; keyboard/mouse works as a secondary/desktop option.

name: Toca Coloring Book
description:
Toca Coloring Book is a fun and creative coloring game where you can bring cute characters, animals, and colorful pictures to life! Pick your favorite colors, grab your virtual paintbrush, and fill each picture with your own unique style.

How to Play Toca Coloring Book?

Choose a picture to start coloring and select the colors you like from the palette. Use your brush to carefully paint different parts of the picture and watch your artwork come to life. Experiment with bright colors, create fun combinations, and don't worry about making mistakes—your creativity is what matters!

What is the Goal in Toca Coloring Book?

The goal is simple: color each picture and create your own colorful masterpieces. Complete the drawings, try different color combinations, and have fun exploring your artistic side.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: INKWAY
description: In this game, you have to draw a line to create a road and guide the car to the winning point.
instructions: Draw line

name: Sand Truck
description: In this game, you have to fill up the truck and complete each level.
instructions: Tap on key

name: Tile Stack Mahjong
description:
Tile Stack Mahjong is a fun and challenging Mahjong puzzle game where strategy and careful planning are the keys to victory. Place tiles into the right columns, create matching groups, and complete the board while managing every move.

How to Play Tile Stack Mahjong?

Choose a column for your next tile and watch as the tiles shift into position. The tile pushed out from the end becomes the new central tile, deciding which player gets the next turn. Match the correct suits, plan ahead, and build complete stacks of matching tiles.

Be careful with the ???? White Dragon tile! If it appears on your board, it must be discarded because it cannot be matched with other tiles. However, drawing this special tile gives you an extra turn.

What is the Goal in Tile Stack Mahjong?

Your goal is to complete all 9 columns by creating groups of 4 matching tiles in each column. Use smart moves, predict upcoming tiles, and clear the board with the perfect strategy.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Toca Hidden Stars
description:
Play Toca: Hidden Stars online and put your observation skills to the test! Explore colorful scenes filled with friendly characters, adorable animals, and cozy locations as you search for cleverly hidden stars. Every level is packed with fun details that make each search a new adventure.

What is Toca: Hidden Stars?

Toca: Hidden Stars is a relaxing hidden object puzzle game where your goal is to find all the hidden stars before moving on to the next scene. Look carefully around houses, farms, playgrounds, and other charming locations to spot every hidden star. The faster you find them, the better your score!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Gatka Grid
description: Gatka Grid is a fast-paced 2.5D isometric HTML5 micro-RTS swarm arena! Choose from 6 unique martial arts factions, command your unit squads across an isometric battleground, and capture tactical map nodes -Heart nodes for +10% HP/s unit healing and Spawn nodes for +30% reinforcement speed. Fill your Gatka Flow Kill Meter by defeating 10 enemies to unleash 10 seconds of devastating +50% speed and 2x attack power!
instructions:
• Drag-Select: Click and drag a selection box to select your fighters.
• Move / Target: Left-click on the grid or an enemy unit to issue move and attack commands.
• Map Nodes: Stand inside nodes to capture them. Heart (+10% HP/s) heals your units, while Spawn (+30%) speeds up unit spawns.
• Gatka Flow Meter: Defeat 10 enemy units to fill the meter and click the activate button for 10s of +50% speed and 2x attack rate!
• Camera Controls: Pan using WASD / Arrow keys or right-click drag. Mouse wheel to zoom.

name: Archer vs Monsters
description:
Archer vs Monsters is a casual archery arcade where timing is everything.
Monsters rotate in different ways: some spin at a steady pace, others lurch forward in chaotic bursts, some sharply reverse direction on every hit. Study their behavior and pick the perfect moment to strike.
Every arrow you land sticks into the monster and claims its spot. Hit an occupied zone and the raid is over — so the more arrows you fire, the tighter things get. That last arrow always hits different!
instructions:
Tap the screen — the archer shoots an arrow at the monster.
The monster rotates: each one has its own speed and movement style. Some spin steadily, others lurch forward in sudden bursts, some reverse direction on every hit.
Your goal: deal as many hits as the monster has HP. Every arrow that lands sticks in and takes up space. If a new arrow hits one that's already there — the raid is over!
After each victory, head back to the village:

name: Werewolf Classic
description:
Werewolf Classic is an interactive online multiplayer social deduction game inspired by the classic open source party game Werewolf / Mafia.

Players take on hidden roles—such as Villagers, Werewolves, Detective, Doctor, and more. During the night, Werewolves eliminate unsuspecting villagers, while special roles use their abilities to protect or investigate. When day breaks, players discuss in real-time, share suspicions, and vote to eliminate suspected Werewolves before the village is overrun!

Key Features:
- Real-time online multiplayer rooms (Public & Private custom games)
- Diverse character roles with unique abilities
- In-game real-time chat & voting system
- English and Russian localization support
- Fast-paced, thrilling social deduction gameplay
instructions:
Controls:
- Mouse / Touch: Click or tap buttons to navigate menus, select targets, and cast votes.
- Keyboard: Type in the chat box during the discussion phase and press Enter to talk.

How to Play:
1. Join a Quick Play room or create a custom game with your friends.
2. At game start, you will be secretly assigned a role (Villager, Werewolf, Seer, Doctor, etc.).
3. Night Phase: Werewolves choose a villager to eliminate, while special roles use their abilities.
4. Day Phase: Read the night report, discuss with fellow players in live chat, deduce who the Werewolves are, and vote to eliminate suspects before time runs out!

name: Arrows: Picture Puzzle
description:
A unique logic puzzle with direction, where every arrow you remove doesn't just clear the board — it gradually reveals a real picture, painted like brushstrokes of an impressionist artist. Tap the arrows, clear them in the right order, and watch chaotic colored lines transform into a living image.
Collect picture collections across many themes: objects, landmarks, animals, food, art, and more.
instructions:
Tap an arrow — if the path ahead is clear, it flies off the board and reveals a piece of the hidden picture. If another arrow blocks its path, a collision occurs: it bounces back, and the move is wasted.
Your goal is to clear all arrows from the board , fully revealing the image without unnecessary mistakes. Plan your taps ahead of time, watch each arrow's direction, and think several moves in advance.

name: Threads
description:
In this game, you untangle pieces of fabric and wind them onto matching colored spools. Fabric falls from above, and your task is to correctly place spools so each thread is collected by its matching color.
Each level becomes more challenging: more colors appear, the speed increases, and combinations become more complex. You need to make quick decisions and carefully plan your moves to avoid mistakes.
instructions:
In this game, your goal is to untangle pieces of fabric and correctly distribute them onto matching spools. On each level, fabric pieces of different colors fall from the top, while spools are placed at the bottom.
Your task is to match each fabric color with the correct spool. If the match is correct, the fabric is automatically wound onto the spool. If you make a mistake, the level becomes more challenging and requires more careful planning.

name: Idle Mutation Tower Defense
description:
Idle Mutation Tower Defense is an idle defense roguelite set in a biopunk fantasy world, where you protect a living fortress from relentless waves of monsters.

Upgrades physically transform your tower: new abilities grow into 3D organs that appear on its body and directly affect combat. Develop offensive organs, defensive structures, and rare cores to create powerful mutation combinations.

During each run, collect red crystals for temporary upgrades, blue crystals for research, and genetic material to unlock new mutations. Between attempts, improve core stats, develop active and passive abilities, and prepare your fortress for deadlier waves.

Experiment with builds, change your playstyle, and watch your base evolve from a simple tower into a deadly living organism.
instructions:
Your goal is to survive as many waves as possible and stop the monsters from destroying your living fortress. The tower automatically fires at approaching enemies.

Collect resources during battle and choose temporary upgrades. Red crystals improve your stats for the current run, blue crystals are used for research between attempts, and genetic material unlocks new mutations.

After each defeat, improve your base stats, research active and passive abilities, and grow new organs. Combine offensive mutations, defensive structures, and rare cores to create powerful builds and survive increasingly dangerous waves.

When the fortress's health reaches zero, the run ends, but part of your progress is kept for the next attempt.

The game is controlled with a mouse.

name: Deep Drill Run
description:
Drill deep. Risk everything. Escape with the loot.

A fast-paced 3D mining arcade game built around short, intense runs.

Every descent takes you into a new mine, where your choices in the moment decide how far you go — and how much you bring back.

Tactile real-time drilling
Break through rock in real time with satisfying impact, pressure, and contact.

Risk vs reward
The farther you move from the base, the richer the resources — and the greater the danger.
Leave now, or push deeper?

Every run is different
Each mine is generated from scratch. No repeated routes. No safe memorization.

Instant upgrades
Find upgrade cards and power up your drill during the run, without slowing down the action.

Simple to play, deep to master
Power, speed, and modules let you build your drill around your own playstyle.

Constant tension
Heat and instability keep rising — but you never know exactly where the limit is.

Quick sessions
Drop in. Drill. Decide. Escape.
instructions:
Use the arrow keys on keyboard or the virtual joystick to move your miner. On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen to control movement. Drilling starts automatically when your character pushes into a block.

Drill ore, collect money, and buy upgrades. Glowing blocks are bonus blocks: they are tougher to break, but give more rewards. Bright colored glow means a bigger bonus.

You can upgrade not only your miner, but also the mines themselves. Better mines contain more resources, more valuable ore, character upgrade cards, extra oxygen, and cooling supplies.

Every level is procedurally generated, so each run is different. The farther you progress and the more you upgrade, the more rock types, bonuses, and rewards you will discover.

Some bonuses are unlocked through overall progress. Upgrade your miner, improve the mine, or do both — every few upgrade levels can open new gameplay features and extra options.

name: Classic Corners: Forest
description:
In our corner version, you can improve your analytical skills and strategic thinking while immersing yourself in an atmosphere of calm and coziness.

- Computer Play: Battle a virtual opponent whose difficulty ranges from beginner to master. Upgrade your skills and take on new challenges.
- Play with a friend: Have fun playing on the same board with a loved one. See who can handle the pieces better!
- Competitions and leaderboards: Challenge yourself in matches against players from all over the world and climb the leaderboards by showcasing your talents.

Aesthetics and atmosphere: Enjoy pleasant, calm music and a beautiful forest setting that creates a relaxing atmosphere for concentration and strategic planning.
instructions:
Choose the game mode - with the computer or on one board.
Move your pieces

End game conditions:
1. One player has moved all his pieces to the opponent's house. That player has won the game.
2. In the case when both opponents have simultaneously placed all their checkers in the house, a draw is recorded.
3. All checkers must be removed from the OWN house in 40 (80 moves of the game) moves
4. A player also loses the game if he puts one of his checkers back into his house after the 40th move (80th move of the game).
5. After Black's 80th move (160 moves of the game), if neither side has built a house, the checkers placed in it are counted; whoever has more, wins, in case of equality - a draw.

name: Classic Checkers: Forest
description: A captivating board game set in a unique forest-themed atmosphere! Enjoy classic checkers rules surrounded by nature. Sharpen your strategic thinking, challenge friends or AI, and immerse yourself in a relaxing yet exciting experience. Perfect for all ages!
instructions: Don't forget to customize the game to your liking: giveaway mode, mandatory captures, and other settings are available in the menu! Choose your game mode: play against the computer or share the board with a friend. Move your pieces according to the classic checkers rules. Win and enjoy!

name: Color Path Puzzle
description:
Color Path Puzzle is a bright and engaging logic game where every move matters.

Move shapes across the board, follow the color clues, and guide each puzzle piece through the right zones. To complete a level, you need to choose the correct path and move all shapes out of the field.

The rules are simple: shapes can pass through areas that match their color. But with each new level, you will need to think more carefully and plan every move.

This game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing puzzles, colorful challenges, and smart logic tasks. Can you find the right path and complete all levels?
instructions:
Your goal is to move all shapes out of the game field.

Move the shapes across the level and use color clues to find the right path. Each shape should pass through zones that match its color.

On a computer, control the game with the mouse or keyboard. On a phone, use swipes.

Think ahead, clear the board, and complete new levels one by one.

name: Last stand Zombie Defense
description:
Are you the last stand ready to defend against stupid zombies in the union city? In this ultimate resident evil experience, build your own arsenal in the gun builder or gun range and dive into the action of this gun simulator. With gun idle gameplay, you’ll face hordes of zombie tower enemies while you test your skills and relax in the ultimate idle defense.
Join the battle legion of last stand survivors! Feel the power of gun shot sounds and gun noises as you take down waves of idle zombie attackers. This game is perfect for anyone who loves the gun club experience and wants to enjoy the thrill of gun run 3D. Hear the incredible gun sound effects and experience gun sounds gun simulator as you progress through each level, making your way through the chaos of machine gun action.
instructions: shoot the zombi with fire

name: Fall Guys Coloring Book
description:
Fall Guys Coloring Book

Fall Guys Coloring Book is a fun and creative coloring game where you can bring adorable bean-shaped characters and exciting obstacle-course scenes to life with your favorite colors! Choose from a collection of playful pictures and start coloring, painting, and creating your own colorful masterpieces.

How to play Fall Guys Coloring Book?

Start by choosing your favorite coloring page and pick the picture you want to decorate. Select different colors from the palette and carefully fill in the characters, costumes, obstacles, and backgrounds. Use your creativity to create bright, funny, and unique artwork inspired by the colorful world of Fall Guys!

Can you create your own colorful masterpiece?

Explore every coloring page and experiment with different color combinations to make each picture special. Whether you prefer bright and cheerful colors or wild and imaginative designs, there are plenty of ways to express your creativity.

What makes Fall Guys Coloring Book fun?
???? Color fun character pictures
???? Choose from a variety of bright colors
????️ Create your own unique artwork
⭐ Explore fun and playful coloring pages
???? Enjoy a relaxing and creative experience
???? Play directly in your browser

Grab your virtual coloring tools and get ready for a colorful adventure! Start coloring your favorite characters, unleash your imagination, and create amazing artwork in Fall Guys Coloring Book!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Angry Zombies in Sight
description: A single-player physics arcade game where you launch skulls from a slingshot and knock out the undead on each level. Every stage is about choosing the right angle, pull strength, and timing. Destructible structures, obstacles, and limited attempts turn each level into a compact challenge of aim and planning.
instructions: Hold the skull, pull the slingshot back, and release to shoot. The farther you pull, the stronger the launch. Hit enemies directly or break the structures around them. Clear the level by defeating every enemy before you run out of attempts.

name: Billiard Challenge
description:
A single-player billiards game with levels, different tables, and simple controls. Your goal on each level is to pot the required balls while staying within the available number of attempts. Choose a cue, aim carefully, set the shot power, and complete challenges one by one.

The game is made for quick sessions and calm skill practice. There is no multiplayer: your progress depends only on your decisions, precision, and ability to choose the right shot.
instructions:
Choose a level and wait for the table to load. Aim the cue, adjust the shot power, and release to hit the cue ball. Try to pot the balls and avoid wasting attempts.

Watch the remaining lives on the level. If you run out of attempts, you will need to restart the level. Winning unlocks the next level. In the menu, you can choose a cue and adjust quality and volume settings.

name: Twist Your Path
description:
This is a single-player arcade game about reaction and focus. The character runs forward along a rotating trunk, and your task is to turn the path at the right moment to avoid obstacles. The longer you survive, the higher your score becomes.

You can collect coins during runs and use them to unlock new characters. The game is built for short sessions: the rules are simple, but the speed and direction changes quickly make every run tense.
instructions:
Tap the screen or click the mouse button to rotate the trunk. Watch the branches ahead of the character: if the path is blocked, turn in time and keep moving.

Try to survive as long as possible. Your score increases during the run, and your best result is saved. Collect coins along the way and unlock new characters in the selection menu.

name: Kalulu Tanghulu: ASMR Mukbang
description:
Meet Kalulu — your new favorite mukbang streamer! Make delicious desserts, host ASMR streams, and win over your viewers' hearts!

Create crunchy Tanghulu
Skewer juicy berries, dip them in sugar syrup, and enjoy the perfect crunch! Experiment with strawberries, grapes, and other treats to create the most beautiful Tanghulu.

Make refreshing Boba Tea
Mix aromatic tea, add tapioca pearls, and create drinks that will delight your audience!

Host ASMR Mukbang streams
Go live and watch Kalulu eat the dishes you prepared! The relaxing eating sounds will help attract more viewers. Fulfill their requests and receive donations!

Customize everything around you
Create the perfect streaming space: choose wallpapers for the room, change the desk, and pick out stylish outfits for Kalulu. Make your studio look cozy and vibrant!

Join the relaxing world of mukbang with the cute Kalulu!
instructions:
Welcome to the world of mukbang streaming, where the charming and funny Kalulu is your main character! Help him become a true internet star!

Become the best mukbang streamer!

Your main goal is to host live streams, eat delicious food, and attract as many viewers as possible. The more entertaining your stream, the more popular you become!

✨ What can you do in the game?

    Make Tanghulu: Start your journey by preparing the biggest hit — sweet and crunchy Tanghulu! The cooking process itself is pure joy.

    Unlock Boba Tea: Surprise your subscribers with variety!

    Visit the Shop: Don't feel like cooking? No problem! Stop by the shop, where you can always buy ready-made food for your stream.

    Grow your audience: The more diverse food you try on stream, the more viewers will join you. Break records and become a top streamer!

Ready to start your delicious adventure? Kalulu is waiting for you!

name: Pixel Car Memory Quest
description: Pixel Car Memory Quest is a fun and amazing memory matching game for players of all ages! Flip cards and search for matching pairs. Test your memory, improve your concentration, and challenge yourself through increasingly exciting levels. Can you remember where every matching car is hidden? Start your memory quest and find them all!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Block Bloom
description:
Block Bloom is a relaxing wood-themed block puzzle. Drag pieces from your
tray onto the 8x8 board — fill an entire row or column to clear it. Chain
clears back-to-back for combo bonuses, and earn random Bomb or Sword
boosters every 1,000 points to blast or slice your way out of a tight
board. There's no timer and no time pressure: it's a calm, one-more-run
puzzle experience for all ages, playable in short bursts or long sessions.
Try to beat your personal best score every time you play.
instructions:
Drag a piece from the tray at the bottom of the screen and drop it
anywhere on the board — the game shows a preview of where it will land.
Fill a full row or column with blocks to clear it and score points.
Clearing multiple lines in a row builds a combo for bonus points.
When you earn a Bomb or Sword booster, tap its icon in the header, then
drag it onto the board to use it and clear space.
Works with both mouse (click and drag) and touch (tap and drag) — no
keyboard needed.

name: Police Chase Run
description: Take the wheel and try to survive as long as possible in a tense police chase. The car keeps moving forward, while you steer at the right moment, avoid police cars, and collect coins. The longer the run, the higher the score. Unlock new cars, improve your result, and compete for a place on the leaderboard. The game is made for one player and works well for quick arcade sessions.
instructions: Control the car with the on-screen steering wheel. Turn in time to avoid crashing into police cars. Collect coins during the run and try to stay in the chase for as long as possible. After losing, you can restart, open the shop, and choose another car. The longer you survive, the more points you score.

name: Memory Tiles
description:
This is a simple and engaging game for training memory, attention, and reaction. On each level, you need to memorize the positions of the correct tiles and then open them without making a mistake.

With every completed level, the challenge becomes harder: there are more tiles to remember and the memory load increases. The game is great for short sessions, brain warm-ups, and competing for a better score.
instructions:
First, watch carefully which tiles are revealed on the board. When they close, tap the same tiles in any order.

If you choose a correct tile, the level continues. If you tap a wrong tile, the game ends. After losing, you can continue once per run by watching an ad.

Clear levels, score points, and try to beat your best result.

name: Memorize and Repeat the Shape
description:
A short pattern of connected dots appears on the screen. Watch it carefully, remember the shape, then recreate it after the lines disappear.

Each level becomes more challenging: more lines appear, the grid changes size, diagonals are introduced, and longer connections become possible. After the grid expands, the difficulty eases slightly so the new layout feels fair, then gradually rises again.

The game trains visual memory, focus, and precision. The rules are simple: look, remember, and repeat the pattern as accurately as possible.
instructions:
Press the start button. A pattern made of connected dots will appear on the grid.

Use the timer to memorize the lines. When the pattern disappears, connect the dots to recreate the same shape. If your answer is correct, the level ends automatically and you can continue.

If the repeat timer runs out or the pattern is wrong, the level is failed. Your best score is saved.

name: Paradise Journey: Match3
description:
Escape to a relaxing island adventure! Travel through beautiful tropical locations inspired by paradise destinations, complete match-3 levels, and discover stunning landscapes along the way.
Features:
10 unique tropical island episodes
Beautiful tropical island backgrounds with living shader effect
Relaxing ocean atmosphere
Living environments with ambient effects
Gorgeous sunsets and moonlit nights
Calm immersive soundtrack
Classic and satisfying Match-3 gameplay
instructions:
PC:
Left Mouse Button — Select and swap elements.
Mobile:
Swipe — Select and swap elements.

Match 3 or more tiles of the same type to score points and complete objectives.

name: Merge the Presidents
description: Merge the Presidents is a fun and addictive merge game where you combine the heads of famous U.S. presidents to create bigger and more powerful presidential characters! Start with smaller presidential heads, merge matching ones together, and watch as your collection evolves through history until you reach the ultimate giant presidential head. Start merging, combine every presidential character you can, and see how far you can go! Can you master the board and reach the ultimate big presidential head?
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Up Hero
description:
Ready to challenge endless hordes of monsters? Up Hero is an action-packed RPG where you level up and power up your character right on the battlefield. Wipe out waves of enemies and prove that you are the ultimate hero!
What awaits you in Up Hero:
Horde Battles: Fight your way through crowds of monsters!
Vast Arsenal & Epic Skills: Mix and match swords, firearms, and magic!
Dangerous Worlds: Explore unique locations, each with its own monsters and bosses!
instructions:
Controls: On PC, move your hero using WASD or arrow keys. On mobile, simply drag your finger anywhere on the screen (virtual joystick).
Auto-Combat: No need to mash attack buttons! Your character automatically strikes monsters as soon as they get close. Just maneuver through the crowd and dodge threats.
Gather Resources & Cargo: Explore locations, chop wood, mine stone, deliver valuable cargo, and collect gold dropped by defeated enemies.

name: Military Strike
description:
A realistic first-person military shooter focused on modern combat. Intense firefights, a high cost of mistakes, and fast-paced battles demand accuracy, quick reactions, and composure.
Watch your surroundings, take advantageous positions, and make decisions in seconds. Every shot can change the outcome of a battle, while one careless move can lead to defeat.
instructions:

name: Sudoku Online
description: Classic, Killer, Master, X-Sudoku, Windoku, Points
instructions:
The goal is to fill a × grid with digits from to so that each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and × box. Some cells are pre-filled — these are your starting clues.

Begin with cells that have the most filled neighbors: fewer options make it easier to identify the correct digit. As cells are filled in, the choices for adjacent ones narrow down — the puzzle unfolds as a chain of logical steps.

Use the notes mode to write down multiple candidates in a cell and eliminate them as the grid fills up. This is especially useful at Hard and Expert levels.

Additional modes come with extra rules. In X-Sudoku, digits must also be unique along both main diagonals. In Windoku, extra highlighted regions apply the same uniqueness rule. In Killer Sudoku, groups of cells must add up to a given sum. In Kropki, markers between cells define relationships: a white dot means the two digits differ by , a black dot means one is exactly twice the other.

Train your mind!

 Different ingredients float in the pot. Your goal is to collect them all!

 If there's no plate for an ingredient yet, it goes into an extra slot at the bottom. It waits there until you find a match for it.

 Careful! There are only a few extra slots. If they all fill up and there's no room for a new ingredient — the soup is ruined and the level is lost.

Warhead (explosion power);

Engine (speed and maneuverability);

Durability (margin of safety against damage).

As the current drone or rocket is fully upgraded, access to the next, more advanced model opens up.

The missions are built on a level‑based basis. In each level, the player sees an enemy base with unique landscapes: sandy deserts, grassy plains with trees, archipelagos of islands.

Air defense — mobile systems attacking drones;

Missile defense — stationary installations aimed exclusively at nuclear missiles.

The player sends a drone to an enemy base to destroy missile defense systems. During the flight, the drone is attacked by air defenses — you need to maneuver, avoiding hits.

A red button is available to the player — after pressing it, the player takes control of a nuclear missile and tries to destroy the enemy base. description:
Your past is your greatest ally.
A mistake isn't failure — it's a setup for your next move.

Every time a cycle ends, your actions are recorded — and a ghost of your past self stays on the level, replaying every step. Every cycle. Until you escape.

Press two buttons at once?
Block a laser with a mirror while walking through a door?
Plan it several cycles ahead.

What awaits you:
- 70+ levels with increasing difficulty — from simple one-cycle puzzles to complex multi-cycle combinations
- Two difficulty modes (timed cycles and unlimited time)
- Level editor — create your own puzzles
- Buttons, doors, portals, conveyors, lasers, mirrors — each mechanic changes the rules
- Hunt for the perfect solution in the fewest cycles

Think in cycles. Act precisely. Escape.
instructions:

Time Loops:
When a cycle ends, a ghost clone appears that replays your exact moves from that cycle. Use your clones to cooperate with yourself: one clone holds a button while you walk through the door it opens.

Game Objects:
- Buttons & Doors — step on a button to open a linked door. The door stays open only while the button is held.
- Push Blocks — push blocks onto buttons to hold them. Blocks stay in place between cycles.
- Lasers — red beams that reset your current cycle on contact. Use blocks or mirrors for cover.
- Mirrors & Levers — mirrors reflect lasers. Step on a lever to rotate its linked mirror.
- Portals — paired tiles that teleport you (and lasers!) to the other side.
- Conveyors — moving tiles that push you in a set direction.
- Enemies — moving hazards that patrol the level. Push blocks into them to redirect their path.

Star Rating:
Each level awards 1-3 stars based on how few cycles you use. Collect stars to unlock new level packs.

 In the game you can improve tools and production.

name: Eerie Tower Defense
description: Eerie Tower Defense is an atmospheric tower defense game where you protect a central tower from endless enemy waves.
instructions: Your goal is to survive as many waves as possible and keep the tower alive. In battle, the tower attacks automatically. Defeating enemies gives you gold, which you spend on run-based upgrades: increase damage, attack speed, survivability, and utility effects. Watch the tower’s HP, choose upgrades based on the current wave, and use active items at the right time. Between runs, spend crystals on permanent upgrades, unlock talents, and improve cards to get stronger starts in future runs. If difficulty spikes, adjust your build and rebalance your focus between damage, crowd control, and defense. The longer you survive, the better your rewards and leaderboard ranking.

name: Easter Match 3 Saga
description:
Dive into the colorful world of Easter Match 3 Saga, a fun and relaxing puzzle game filled with bright, falling Easter eggs! Tap on groups of two or more connected eggs to clear them from the board and create satisfying chain reactions.

Keep an eye on the top of the screen to see your goal—destroy the required number of eggs to unlock the next level. With simple controls, vibrant visuals, and addictive gameplay, every level brings a fresh challenge and more egg-smashing fun!
instructions: Mouse to play. Destroy the required number of eggs!

name: Mahjong build farm
description: A Mahjong-style game. Match tiles with pictures, complete exciting levels, earn coins, and turn an empty hill into a thriving farm. Colorful graphics, pleasant music, and useful bonuses await you in this cozy adventure.
instructions:
Gameplay combines simplicity of classic Mahjong with engaging farm building. You'll get the hang of the controls within minutes, and the variety of levels will keep you entertained.

Your goal is to find and match three identical pictures. Once you've collected a triplet, the tiles disappear. The objective of each level is to clear the board by matching all possible combinations.

The game features 90 levels with gradually increasing difficulty. In the beginning, you'll quickly learn the ropes, but as you progress, you'll encounter real puzzles that require attention and logical thinking.

Bonuses and hints: If a level gets too tricky, don't worry! Helpful bonus assistants are available. They can shuffle the tiles, highlight a matching combination, or remove extra elements to help you continue playing.

Building your farm: Completing levels earns you coins. Use them to develop your farm. Gradually, the empty hill will turn into a thriving homestead with a cozy house, animal pens, and fields.

name: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description: "Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic" — play for free, enjoy Russian-style cards and classic gameplay. Become a true solitaire master!
instructions:
1. Objective: Arrange all the cards into four foundation piles by suit, starting with Ace and ending with King.

2. Game Board: Seven columns are laid out on the table. Cards are placed in descending order, alternating between red and black suits.

3. Moving Cards: You can move cards between columns if they follow the rules — in descending order and alternating colors. Both single cards and valid sequences can be moved.

4. Empty Columns: Vacant columns can be filled only with Kings or sequences starting with a King.

5. Deck: If you have no available moves, draw an additional card from the deck to continue playing.

6. Victory: The game is won when all cards are successfully placed into the foundation piles by their respective suits.

name: Chroma Tower
description: Drop blocks, destroy towers, collect them all! Beat your move and cascade records, maintain your win streak, and earn trophies through daily challenges. How many awards can you unlock?
instructions:
Tap a column to drop the current block. It falls to the lowest available position. If it lands next to blocks of the same color, the entire connected group is destroyed. Remaining blocks then fall down and may trigger new cascades.
A translucent ghost block shows exactly where the block will land — use it to plan ahead. You have a limited number of moves, so spend them wisely.
Levels: complete many campaign levels. The fewer moves you use, the better your record.
Daily challenges: a unique level every day. Complete them consecutively to maintain your win streak.
Collection: earn awards for achievements, collect monthly trophies for daily challenges, and track your personal records.

Watch your character flop, bounce, and crash through a lively playground full of interactive objects. TWhether you're playing on PC or mobile, you can jump into the action anytime and anywhere.

A screenshot of the new dragon can be saved as a PNG image at any time. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it.

Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.
instructions: This game takes you back to the 2000s and introduces you to the fashion trends of those years, which have been revived in our days under the name of the Y2K style. You will get to know this fashion trend better and create a Y2K-style look yourself. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

Move: Drag one element to an adjacent element (vertically or horizontally) to swap them and create a row.
Attack: Collect stone symbols for physical attack, and bombs for a massive attack.
Shields block damage, and health pots restore health.

name: Europe at War
description:
Europe at War
Turn-based strategy on Europe's map, 1936. 15 playable nations, 369 regions, 74 achievements. Three paths to victory — military, diplomatic or economic. Will you conquer the continent?
instructions:
Choose a nation and start conquering Europe. Each turn represents one month of war.
BASICS: Click your regions to select troops. Declare war through Diplomacy first — you cannot attack without it. Select Attack mode and click an enemy region. Troops have energy — each attack and move costs 1 point.
ECONOMY: After each turn you receive gold from regions and factories. Build factories for income, barracks to recruit troops, airfields for aviation.
TECHNOLOGY: Research military, economic and diplomatic technologies to strengthen your nation.
VICTORY: Three paths — capture all regions, ally with all nations, or build 12 factories.
EXTRAS: Launch airborne assaults behind enemy lines. Use aviation for long-range strikes. Every 8 turns choose a national focus — a powerful one-time bonus.
Unlock new nations by winning games!

name: Tic Tac Toe Merge
description: New tic-tac-toe! Merge pieces, conquer the board, chain reactions. Play online vs players worldwide or challenge AI.
instructions:
GOAL: 
Score victory points before your opponent by creating lines of 3 matching pieces.

BASIC RULES:
• You have 3 pieces in hand (initially all level 1)
• Tap a piece to select it, then tap an empty cell to place it
• When 3+ same-level pieces align (row, column, diagonal), they award points
• The number of points depends on the level of the figures, their number and combos

MERGING:
• In hand: Tap two same-level pieces to merge them (level 1+1=2, level 2+2=3)
• On board: Place your piece on your existing same-level piece to upgrade it

CAPTURING:
• Place a higher-level piece on opponent's lower-level piece to capture their spot
• Example: Your level 2 can capture opponent's level 1

CHAIN REACTIONS:
• When pieces clear, a new higher-level piece appears at center
• If it creates another line, COMBO! Points multiply.

TIMER:
• The move is limited in time - think quickly!

GRID SIZES:
• 3×3 (quick), 5×5 (tactical)

Large, clear tiles and easy-to-use controls
Beautiful Traditional Design
Stress-Free Experience
instructions:

1) Find two identical tiles
2) Move one tile or group of tiles in any direction: left, right, up, or down
3) Tiles form a pair when:
• They are adjacent to each other
• They are in a line with no other tiles between them
4) The pair automatically disappears from the board

Tip: Think several moves ahead – success requires strategy!

Game Help:

Hint – Highlights an available pair if you can't see the moves.
Shuffle – Shuffles the tiles when the combinations run out, opening up new possibilities.

name: The end of the tunnel

After making a move, the player's tiles are replenished from the stack to seven and the turn passes to the opponent. The figure next to the installed tile is moved to this tile and the player who owns this figure is awarded points corresponding to the tile on which the move was made. The player with the most points wins when none of the players can make their move - all the tiles have been laid out on the playing field. 

The game can be played with artificial intelligence or with an online opponent in multiplayer mode.

- Golden Dead End — A piece moved to this tile adds four points to the player. 
- Gold mine — A piece moved to this tile adds two points to the player. 
- Poisonous Roots — A piece placed on this tile takes away two points for the player. 
It is impossible to install tiles outside the boundaries of the game board. A tunnel running into the boundary of the playing field or into another tunnel ends and the figure moves back to the first fork.

name: Daily Mahjong Challenge

instructions: Goal is simple: Clear every tile from the board. How? Match identical pairs. But here's the catch—only "free" tiles count. Free means nothing sits on top AND at least one side (left or right) is open. Blocked tiles? Ignore them. Remove the blockers first. Click a free tile. Click its twin. Gone. Repeat until the board is empty.
