Your task is to place the units in the menu and start the battle, then watch the battle in the colosseum. The leaderboard shows the number of levels completed.

PC controls:
W,A,S,D - camera movement.
mouse - view.

Phone controls:
joystick - camera movement.
right side of the screen - rotate the camera.

name: Russian Treasure Hunter
description: Explore locations with a metal detector, find valuable items, sell them in town, and upgrade your backpack and skills.
instructions:
Select a location and press "Forward" to proceed.

Control the metal detector and listen carefully: if the device beeps and the signal bar increases, treasure is nearby.

When the bar is full, switch tools and dig up the item.

Click on the dug-up object to add the find to your backpack.

Keep an eye on your backpack's capacity—a full backpack means it's time to return to town and sell it.

Finds earn coins and experience; spend coins on new backpacks and bonuses, while experience unlocks new locations with rare items.

Your progress is saved when you change locations or leave them—don't risk losing your loot.

When you leave a location, you get a 5-minute cooldown before returning—plan your expeditions accordingly.

Examine the items you've found in your collection, complete quests, and collect rewards.

name: FNAF Alchemy: Collect All Animatronics
description: Create all the legendary animatronics in the spirit of the cult horror series! Combine parts on the alchemical board, unlock new characters, and build a show stage that will bring you income. Test your ingenuity and become the best entrepreneur!
instructions:
The game consists of two main modes:
1. Alchemy Mode (Creation):
The main screen features a game board and shelves with elements (preparations, tools, parts).
Drag elements to the central board.
Place two or more items next to each other—if the combination is correct, they will transform into a new animatronic.
The new animatronic will appear on the board and will be automatically added to the reference book.
Use it again as a component for more complex recipes!
The goal is to unlock all the animatronics by following the logic and finding new combinations.
2. Scene Mode (Earnings):
Go to the "Scene" tab.
You can purchase animatronics in the scene shop using in-game currency.
Place purchased animatronics on the stage. Each one generates income every second.
The more animatronics on the stage, the higher your earnings. Use this money to buy more animatronics and upgrade the stage (sets, attractions) to increase your income.
Alternate modes: create new characters in Alchemy and buy them for the Stage.

name: Anomaly Search
description: A psychological horror game that tests your attentiveness. You're a bunker operator. Look for anomalies on the cameras to prevent the collapse of reality!
instructions:
Quiet Hour Phase (First 30 seconds): You have half a minute of complete safety. Switch between cameras. REMEMBER. You must remember the location of every mug, painting, and shadow. This is your standard of reality.

Active Phase: Chaos ensues. Continuously "press" all the rooms. Only one anomaly per zone at a time.

Recording Algorithm: Noticed a difference? Don't panic.

Open the type menu (arrow on the left).

Select a category: Item / Room / Entity / Reality.

Double-tap directly on the anomaly.

Resources: Success earns RP (Research Points). Failure damages your sanity. If your sanity bar drops to 0, the operator is written off.

Shop: Spend RP on upgrades between shifts. You'll need it.

name: Escape from Africa
description: You play as a character who was imprisoned in a cage by the Africans, and now you can escape from it in this adventure-filled browser-based arcade game!
instructions:
Complete the levels by following the purple markers. Avoid being spotted by the natives, or you'll lose the level. The main leaderboard tracks the number of levels you've completed, and each level has its own time-based leaderboard.

Controls:
W,A,S,D - walking on a computer.
Joystick - walking on a phone.

name: Cubica
description: Train your brain! Match-2 block blast puzzle game with cubes. Blast the blocks of cubes and have fun!
instructions: Cubica is a match-2 block blast puzzle. It's very similar to match-3, but you don't swap tiles. Find two identical cubes next to each other and click on one of them to make the cubes disappear. If a combination contains more than 5 cubes they used to create a bonus on the board. More cubes in a combination - greater the bonus. The bonus you get is shown on the cube icon.

name: Triangles Dots 2048
description: Triangles Dots 2048 is an addictive puzzle game where the player must connect triangles-dots on the board to get triangles with an even higher value.
instructions:
Click on the field to place the next triangle in the right place on the board.
Place triangles-dots with the same value on the playing field next to each other so that they merge into a triangle with a higher value.
The game ends when there is no space left on the field to place the next triangle-dot.

name: Romantic K-Pop Transformation

Experiment with makeup in red and pink tones; change the hairstyles and hair color of the girls. Choose the perfect outfit: from cute dresses and stylish tops to trendy skirts and trousers. Complete the look with handbags, jewelry, and fashion accessories. Compare the resulting images and decide which of the heroines of the game has become the real queen of romantic K-pop style.
instructions: Try to create several different images for the three heroines of this game - from gentle romance to a vivid scene. Save your images, share them with your friends and come back again to come up with new romantic transformations. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

name: 2048 Block Fusion

instructions:

 Combine blocks with the same values.
 In the "Adventure" and "Advanced" modes:

- Collect coins — they are credited to your account and help in the game.

- swapping places

- reducing the value by 2 times

Capture banks, factories, and warehouses to earn profits and strengthen your team. Make money, unlock powerful weapons and awesome cars. name: Blockibo: Color Blocks

instructions:

name: SUDOKU puzzle
description: Immerse yourself in a world of pure logic and numbers! This intellectual puzzle challenges your mind with endless combinations to solve. It's the perfect way to train your brain, find meditative focus, and conquer a challenge anytime, anywhere.
instructions: This game is a global phenomenon, the gold standard of number puzzles, and an unparalleled trainer for developing critical thinking, memory, and concentration. Its beauty lies in the perfect balance of simple rules and bottomless depth of logical possibilities.Every gaming session becomes a mini-journey where you, step by step, digit by digit, restore perfect order. It's a meditative process that clears the mind of clutter and allows you to fully focus on solving an elegant task. Yet, the game never gets boring: thanks to algorithms that generate unique puzzles, you get a fresh, new challenge every time.It is suitable for absolutely everyone: beginners can enjoy easy levels to unwind after a long day, while experienced players will be challenged by the cunning combinations of high difficulty levels, where every digit becomes part of a complex logical jigsaw. It is the perfect companion for travel, waiting in line, or during a break—a game that always helps keep your mind sharp.The puzzle doesn't just test your ingenuity; it teaches patience, a systematic approach, and perseverance. It proves that even the most complex problems can be solved by breaking them down into sequential logical steps. This is more than a game—it's a philosophy embodied in numbers. Discover the pure joy of intellectual discovery and become a master of logic.

name: Chain & Gain!
description:
Hi there! Try this cute casual puzzle game. Your task is to connect matching items into chains — not just horizontally and vertically, but also diagonally! This opens up a world of spectacular moves and unexpected combos.

Every move changes the board: when you clear a chain, blocks from above fall down, and the bottom row disappears. This keeps the gameplay fast and dynamic!

Use awesome power-up items: bombs, rockets, rainbows, mirrors, dice, and chests. They are activated automatically if they end up next to your chain, and trigger chain reactions with bright explosive effects! But stay alert: you'll also encounter stones, grates, and other obstacles that will complicate your task. Sometimes you'll have to plan your moves one step ahead… or even two!

The first few levels will help you easily master all the game mechanics, followed by 100+ levels of increasing difficulty. The game is adapted for mobile devices and browsers — play anywhere, no installation needed!

Chain them up and gain points — good luck!
instructions:
Tap and drag across matching items to form a chain — horizontally, vertically, or even diagonally. This earns you points and helps complete the level goals: collect the required number of specific items.

Power-ups (activated if they touch your chain horizontally or vertically):  
Bomb – removes all items around itself.  
Rocket – clears an entire line (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal).  
Rainbow – collects all items of the same type as in your chain.  
Mirror – removes items at the reflected positions of your chain.  
Dice – with a 30% chance, transforms items on the board into the type from your chain.  
Chest – grants extra moves, required items, or coins.

Obstacles:  
Stones – fall down and can clog columns.  
Chained Hearts – need to be activated to count towards level goals.  
Grates – block tiles with items. They do not react to power-ups.  
Paint – spreads only along your chains and is ignored by power-ups.

name: Cyvasse: Chess ice and flame
description:
The game is between two players who take turns making their moves.
The pieces cannot complete their movement on the field in which the mountain, their other piece, or the opponent's piece is located if it cannot be eaten. The figures, except for the bishop figure, can move through fields occupied by other figures of the same color - their own figures, but they cannot complete their movement on these fields.
 To capture an opponent's piece, a player follows the same rules as when making a normal move, except that he must move his piece in a straight path (i.e., in only one direction) and must complete his movement on the field occupied by a piece of his opponent's color, which is called the captured piece. In addition, the captured piece must be available for capture - it must not have numbers with the designation of armor. After the capture is completed, the captured piece is removed from the game board.
instructions:
The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode.

Basic concepts

Attack — the relative position of the pieces in a straight line, leading to a decrease in armor units.
Armor is a characteristic of a figure that is reduced by an attack, the positive value of which prevents the enemy figure from capturing and eating the figure.
Capture is an opportunity to move your piece into the field where the opponent's piece is located, which does not have armor.

Armor

Each piece has an armor class and an attack range, which are determined by its type.
An opponent's piece is considered to be attacked if there is a direct route to it and the distance to it is equal to or less than the capture range of the attacking piece. Attacking through the field where the mountain is located is not possible.
Attacking a piece reduces the value of the piece's armor. Pieces without armor can be taken when an opponent's piece is moved onto them.
The armor class of a piece determines how many enemy pieces must attack a piece in order for it to be captured: pieces with heavy armor must be attacked by at least two pieces, pieces with light armor by at least one, and unarmored pieces can be captured without attacking at all.
A capture can also be made by a piece that does not attack if the captured piece has no armor left.

Mountains and water

No figure can stop in the fields where the mountains are located. Only a dragon can pass through the fields where the mountain is located. The catapult can make a shot through the mountains.
Fields of water stop the movement of figures passing through these fields. A piece that enters a field of water can continue moving - it can only leave the water on the player's next turn.

Completing the game

The player loses if:
- All the kings of this player have been captured;
- all the pieces of this player are at the tower;

Types of shapes

The ten types of shapes are listed below. The type of a figure determines its armor class, movement, and attack range. There are also special rules related to each type.

Militia — Armor: 1, Move: 1, Attack: 1.
Spearman — Armor: 1, Movement: 1, Attack: 1. The attack is carried out only two fields ahead. The opponent's pieces cannot pass through any field in front of the spearman in one turn. Only a dragon can fly over these fields in one turn.
Rider — Armor: 1, Movement: 3, Attack: 1.
Knight — Armor: 2, move: 2, Attack: 1.
Elephant armor: 2, Move: 1, Attack: 2. Cannot move through fields containing its own shapes.
Crossbowman — Armor: 0, Movement: 2, Attack: 3. Cannot capture enemy pieces.
Trebuchet armor: 0, Move: 1, Capture/Attack: 4, minimum 2.
Dragon Armor: 2, Move: 4, Attack: 2. Can move through fields with mountains.
Armor tower: 2, does not move, friendly figures in neighboring fields become invulnerable.
King — Armor: 1, Move: 1, Attack: 1.

name: Gala: Farm chess
description:
The objectives of the game are to capture two enemy kings or move two of your kings to any of the four central squares.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode.

Taking the opponent's pieces is possible only if the piece is moved from the corner to the central zone or vice versa.

If a bishop or rook has moved one or more squares before the line of demarcation of the central and corner zones intersects, they can only move one square further.

The elephant walks diagonally in the corners, and vertically or horizontally in the middle. The rook moves vertically or horizontally in the corners, and diagonally in the middle. Bishop and rook can cross zones only once in one turn.

A bishop and a rook can pass through the four central squares if there is no king in this field. But the bishop and the rook cannot stop in these fields.
instructions:
Movement of figures:
- The pawn moves diagonally towards the middle of the board until it is in the central area. When a pawn is in the center or in one of the opponent's corner zones, it can move one square in any direction.
- The elephant walks diagonally in the corners, and vertically or horizontally in the middle. The bishop takes the opponent's pieces only if he crosses the line of demarcation of the central and corner zones.
- The rook moves vertically or horizontally in the corners, and diagonally in the middle. The rook takes the opponent's pieces only if it crosses the line of demarcation of the central and corner zones.
- The king moves one square in any direction.

The game ends:
- The victory of the player, whose two kings will be moved to the four central fields.
- Defeat the player who loses all his kings.
- A draw if two players have one king each.
- A draw if the same position of the pieces is repeated three times during the game.

name: Hexagonal chess
description:
The game is played on boards consisting of hexagonal cells. Since each hexagonal square that is not on the edge of the board has six adjacent squares, this increases the mobility of the pieces (which cannot move diagonally) compared to a standard orthogonal chessboard.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and offer your own version of the player's next move by making it on the board.

There are six types of hexagonal chess implemented in the game: Glinsky, Saffron, De Vasa, Bruski, McCooey, Star.
instructions:
1. Glinsky's Chess
The game is played on a vertically oriented regular hexagonal board with sides of 6 squares, which has 91 hexagonal squares of three colors, with a middle square. The usual set of chess pieces increases by one bishop and one pawn.

2. Saffron Chess
The board has the shape of an irregular hexagon.
All pieces, except pawns and kings, move and take exactly the same way as in Glinsky chess. The pawn moves diagonally like a bishop. A pawn can be taken on the pass. Castling is allowed.

3. De Vasa's Chess
Players can cast both short and long.
The pawns start the game on the third horizontal. The pawn strikes diagonally forward.

4. Chess Bars
Castling and pawn capture are allowed on the pass.

5. McCooey Chess
A pawn capture corresponds to a bishop move. 

6. Star Chess
At the beginning of the game, the players take turns placing their pieces on the squares behind their pawns. There is no pick-up on the passageway.

Your goal is to clear the board by matching tiles in pairs. The mechanics are simple but require thoughtful moves.
instructions:
Your goal is to clear the board by matching tiles in pairs. The mechanics are simple but require thoughtful moves.

Basic rules:
1. Find two identical tiles.
2. Slide one tile or a group of tiles in any direction: left, right, up, or down.
3. Tiles form a pair when:
    - they end up next to each other, or
    - they are on the same line with no tiles between them.
4. The pair automatically disappears from the board.

Tip: Think several moves ahead — success requires strategy!

Control gravity, distort space, and wreak havoc in a pixelated bank where anything is possible. It's all about shooting, humor, trash, and complete madness - everything you need for a fun-filled action game.
instructions:
Controls on PC:
W, A, S, D - movement;
mouse - shooting;
1,2,3 - change weapons.
F - take a weapon, a key, open the door lock.
G - call a KamAZ for retreat.
H - call a helicopter for retreat.
Space - turn into a black hole.

Control on a smartphone: use the stick to control the character, the camera control is on the right side of the screen, there are also buttons for aiming and changing weapons, buttons for calling transport for retreat.

name: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!
instructions:
Choose a level from the vibrant and detailed locations.
Carefully scan the screen to spot hidden objects.
Complete the level by finding all listed items and move on to the next exciting scene.

name: Draw picture by numbers. Pixel Art.
description: Discover the magic of paint by numbers and the soothing power of creativity! Immerse yourself in our extensive gallery, where many unique pixel pictures await you. From cozy landscapes and cute animals to complex portraits and fantastical scenes - there is a masterpiece for every taste here. Each image is divided into numbered pixels, and your task is simply to find the cells with the corresponding number and fill them with color from the provided palette.
instructions:
At the start of the game, you are given gold. Use it to buy paintings.
As you color, coins will appear. Tap to collect them.
A fully completed painting can be sold for a higher price.
While coloring, you can zoom in/out on the picture by pinching with two fingers on mobile or using the mouse wheel on PC.

name: MazeLoop NEON
description:
MazeLoop is a fast, glowing neon-style maze runner where your reflexes decide everything.
Navigate through an endless series of twisting neon pathways, avoid dead ends, and find the correct route before time runs out.

With smooth controls, vibrant colors, and a futuristic atmosphere, MazeLoop offers a simple but addictive puzzle-runner experience that keeps you coming back for “one more try.”
instructions:
How to Play

Start the game and a neon maze will appear.

Swipe (mobile) or use arrow keys / mouse (desktop) to move through the maze.

Find the correct path that leads you toward the glowing exit.

Avoid dead ends—if you hit one, you must turn back quickly.

The maze becomes faster and more complex as you advance.

Continue navigating to keep your score increasing.

name: DiviDrop
description: Throw numbers onto a 3x3 grid. If a number is divisible by its neighbor, the smaller number disappears. Survive the longest!
instructions: Take numbers and throw them onto the board. If a number is divisible by its neighbor, the smaller number disappears, and the larger number remains the result of the division. Excess numbers can be stored or discarded. Survive as long as possible and score as many points as possible!

name: Labubu Antistress Game
description: Labubu Antistress Game is an amazing and free to play online game for kids. Play around with our lovely Labubu doll and have fun!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: Solve a variety of 3×3 and 3×4 slide puzzles featuring cute animal drawings by moving one piece at a time into the open space on the puzzle. When all pieces are in the correct position the bottom right corner will be empty and the computer will then fill in that space for you.
instructions: Use the mouse or tap the screen to solve the puzzle.

name: Paper Wars: Battles and Upgrades
description: Real battle on a sheet of paper! Choose your troops, aim, and destroy the enemy. Play with a friend or against AI. Unlock new fighters and upgrade your attacks!
instructions:
Preparing for Battle:
At the beginning of the game, select soldiers from those available in your arsenal. The number and types of soldiers depend on your squad's upgrades.

Combat System:
When your attack is charged, select a firing point on your half of the field. The system will automatically determine the mirrored point on the enemy's side — that's where the projectile will land. Some soldiers accelerate the recharge of specific attacks — use this advantage.

name: Stack Jump
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Jump Ball! Control a bouncing ball as it descends through rotating platforms. Smash the safe sections and avoid dangerous colors. The faster you go, the more points you earn! Intuitive controls, stunning effects, and exciting gameplay make it perfect for short sessions or long playtime.
instructions:
Guide the ball through safe platforms.
Avoid black sections — they end your run.
Collect bonuses and power-ups for maximum points.

name: English Checkers
description: Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Checkers English, where every game is a test of your tactics and foresight! Also this game is known by name Draughts
instructions:
The beginning of the game. Select the mode: against the computer, online, or together on the same screen. Determine the side (black/white) and the difficulty level.

Moves. A simple checker moves diagonally forward one square. The queen (king) can move back and forth one square.

The capture. If your checker is next to the opponent's piece, and there is an empty square behind it, you must jump over and capture it. Taking is mandatory!

Chain captures. If a new capture opportunity opens after a jump, you continue to capture pieces within the same turn.

 Turning into a queen. When a checker reaches the last row, it becomes a queen and gets the right to move backwards.

name: Color Block Blast
description: "Color Block Blast" is a unique puzzle game that challenges you to show your creativity and skill in combining colors and shapes. Each figure opens up new possibilities and requires you to think flexibly.
instructions: Place the figures on the playing field so that three or more blocks of the same color touch each other to make them disappear. The game ends when none of the proposed figures can be placed on the playing field. The goal of the game is to earn the maximum number of points.

name: Parkour Obby: Jump to Victory
description: Test your parkour skills! Jump across platforms, dodge traps, and guess the right path. Only the fastest and bravest can complete all levels and become a legend!
instructions:
PC Controls:
WASD — move around the world
Mouse — control the camera
Space — jump / double jump
Shift — sprint
Tab — open pause menu / unlock cursor
X — toggle sounds on/off.

Mobile/Tablet Controls:
Left joystick — walk and run
Right side of the screen — rotate camera
Jump button — jump / double jump
Pause button — open pause menu
Music button — turn game sounds on/off.

Ready to jump? Good luck!

name: Ping Pong Air
description: Ping pong is a simple and relaxing game with modes, rewards and a collection of bats. Take a break and play right now!
instructions:
Control the bat with your mouse or finger, bouncing the ball like in real table tennis.
In the classic mode, defeat opponents and earn trophies.
In the Halloween mode, banish spirits in a limited time.
In the career, go from beginner to champion, and in the challenge, hit the targets without missing. Earn crystal orbs, unlock new bats and get achievements.

name: Labubu Puzzle Challenge
description: Labubu Puzzle Challenge is a fun, exciting, and completely free online jigsaw puzzle game designed especially for kids! In this adorable brain-teasing adventure, players must connect all the small puzzle pieces to recreate a cute Labubu picture. Each puzzle tests attention, memory, and problem-solving skills while keeping the gameplay simple, relaxing, and enjoyable for all ages. Kids can take their time, drag and drop the pieces, and watch the full image come together step by step. Whether you want a quick challenge or a calming puzzle session, Labubu Puzzle Challenge is the perfect pick. Have fun matching the pieces and completing the picture!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Labubu Auto Adventure
description: Labubu Auto Adventure is a super fun and free online driving game for kids! You play as Labubu, cruising through snowy roads in a cool jeep while collecting delicious pancakes for your girl. Gather as many pancakes as possible and make it safely to the finish line. Enjoy the adventure and have fun!
instructions: AD to drive or mouse to play. Dubble click to jump.

name: Roller Coaster 3D
description:
Go through this roller coaster, pick up more passengers along the way and have more fun!
Can you pass all the obstacles and enjoy all the crazy loops?
Enjoy the ride!
Unlocks all the different mechanics and many levels!
instructions:
The gameplay is simple:

just swipe left or right
try to collect as much money as possible
and also try to attract more people to you and avoid obstacles

name: Heartbeat
description: Step into the world of k-pop! Manage two charming idols, design your cozy home, and guide your group to stardom. Unlock romantic storylines and experience heart-fluttering dates. Enter a world of love and inspiration — let your Heartbeat guide you.
instructions:
During the story, choose what the heroine says and does. Your choices will shape the course of events and your relationships with the idols.

At the group house, complete daily tasks to unlock new story episodes.

Earn coins and spend them on new home decorations and outfits for the idols.

name: Car Out Jam
description:
Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!
instructions:
Left mouse button - click on the selected car. When you tap, the car rides to the parking place. If the car's color matches the color of the first passengers, they board the car. When all passengers board, the car rides away.
To make your task easier, you can use boosters:
- Sorting passengers,
- Sorting the queue,
- VIP parking.

name: Miami Streets
description: The Miami city street racing community decided to hold an underground car racing competition. You will take part in the Miami Streets game. At the beginning of the game, you will have your first car. She will be on city streets, and gradually picking up speed will rush forward along the road. You will need to look closely at the screen. Various vehicles will move along the road. You will not have to let your car collide with them. To do this, use the control keys to make your car make overtaking maneuvers on the road. All along the road you will come across gold coins and other bonus items. You will have to try to collect them. These actions will bring you points.
instructions: PC controls: W,A,S,D and Arrow Keys. Touch Control on all mobile devices!

name: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy and fly through levels full of danger: fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.
instructions:
Controls are super simple — hold the screen and move your finger up or down to guide your Fluffy. Avoid fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws. Don’t crash and don’t lift your finger!

Collect coins while flying — use them to buy chests. Chests may contain eggs that hatch into new Fluffies! Each one is a fluffy cube with its own style and charm. Some are rarer than others — build your full collection!

name: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
description:
A tangled detective story is about to unfold.

Inspector Hale and Detective Crane are on the trail of a mysteriously vanished professor of history and archaeology — who also happens to be Crane’s old friend.
Professor Eldridge was always a touch eccentric, but disappearing without a word and leaving his office turned upside down was never part of his habits. He’s clearly in trouble — and in need of help.
instructions:
First things first — check your Investigation log. It keeps a record of your entire adventure. You can open it anytime by clicking the book icon at the top of the screen.

At the top of the screen, a new clue will appear each turn.
Move it left or right using your mouse or finger.
When you release it, the clue will fall down.
Try to make it collide with another of the same kind.
When two identical clues meet, they combine into a new one.

name: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!
instructions:
Control on PC:
Hold your mouse in the direction you want to move the player

Control on mobile devices:
Hold your finger in the direction you want to move the player.

name: Worm: Apple Quest
description:
Get Ready for Challenging Puzzles in Worm: Apple Quest!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

Every apple you collect makes your worm longer, unlocking new paths - but beware! With greater length comes tougher control. One wrong turn and you might get stuck, ending your run.
instructions: Use WASD or arrows or on-screen buttons to move the worm!

name: CUBE KING
description:
Show them who's the real King here!

New cubes appear from the portals at the bottom. Your task is to connect cubes with the same numbers by moving them from one stack to another!

You get coins for every merge. Use them wisely:
Upgrade a selected cube!
Unlock new portals with cubes!
Increase the starting level of cubes!
Extinguish burning cubes or instantly shatter the ice on all frozen cubes!

But be careful: if a stack overflows, the game ends!
instructions:
Every 15 seconds, cubes appear on the rods.
Move them between rods to connect cubes with the same number!

If a stack overflows, the game ends.

1 Tap a cube to select it.
2 Tap another cube where you want to place it.
3 You get coins for merging cubes.

When a cube with a number divisible by 5 (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) appears, you get a random boost.
Boosts can be good or bad :)
Good ones:
Extra coins!
Upgrade random cubes!
Bad ones:
Fire Arrows - burning cubes lose 1 index every 5 seconds!

name: Vibe Colouring
description: Relax with your favorite color by number game! Paint hundreds of pictures — from funny memes to calm landscapes. Every drawing is a little story that comes to life with your colors. Over 100 levels already in the game, and the library keeps growing. All pictures are open and free — no limits or waiting. Hints will show you where uncolored areas are hiding. Check the leaderboard to see who colored the most areas.
instructions:
1. Choose a level. Open the list of coloring pages and pick any — meme, landscape, or mystery level. 
2. Pick a color. Tap a color from the palette at the bottom to activate it. 
3. Color the areas. Find the matching numbered areas and tap to fill them. Watch your picture come to life! 
4. Use the magnifier. Can’t find a spot? Tap the magnifier — it helps you quickly zoom in on the right area.

name: Winter Labubu Pacman Adventure
description: Winter Labubu Pacman Adventure is a super fun online game inspired by classic Pac-Man gameplay. Navigate the icy maze, avoid enemies, collect items, and survive as long as possible. Stay sharp, keep moving, and most importantly—have fun!
instructions: Arrow keys to play.

name: Artillery Time
description:
"Artillery Time" is a fast-paced browser-based shooter where you control a powerful cannon and fight off waves of incoming enemies.
Every shot is an explosion, and every wave is a challenge. You manually aim the artillery, choose the type of projectile, and destroy enemy vehicles with epic effects. The base has health, and allied units help you on the battlefield, while you strengthen your defenses, unlock new weapons, and discover skins.
instructions:
There are two modes in the game, you can select them in the menu:
- In the "Attack" mode, you need to help attack the enemy's base, and your task is to assist with artillery.
- In the "Defense" mode, you need to help your allies defend our base.
On a PC, you can control the game using the left mouse button, and on a smartphone, you can use your finger!
You need to select the target, release your finger, and the shot will be fired!
The game full saves your progress after a victory or defeat!

name: Edge of Defense
description: Edge of Defense is a casual Minecraft-style game where you defend a fortress from waves of enemies using upgradable weapons. The centerpiece is a pistol that can be upgraded to increase its firing speed, the number of projectiles it can fire at once, and add special effects. The game's simple controls, pixel art, and fast-paced gameplay make it accessible to everyone.
instructions:
Your task is to repel waves of enemies that are coming at you, so that you don't get eliminated! Each new wave that you complete gives you the opportunity to upgrade your weapons!
To shoot, select the target using your mouse or finger and click!
For each wave, you will receive diamond at the end of the game, which you can use to purchase weapon skins!

name: Tile Hexa Sort
description:
Dive into a world of colorful hexagons where every move requires careful planning. Your goal is to stack identical pieces into tall towers without mixing colors. The higher the tower, the more attention and strategic thinking is needed.

With each new level, more colors and towers appear, making move planning even more important. Think ahead to avoid mistakes and maintain order in the colorful chaos.
instructions: Drag tiles from the bottom of the screen to empty squares on the board by color. You need to build a tower of 10 tiles of the same color to complete it

name: Block Puzzle Master
description: In this wonderful puzzle game you will be able to create a variety of shapes and structures using blocks of different shapes and sizes, and solve complex problems that require logical thinking and strategic approach. Enjoy the simple and easy gameplay and compete for high positions in the rankings.
instructions: Drag and drop tiles onto a 9x9 grid and remove them, filling a row, column or 3x3 square completely. The pieces appear in threes, and you must expose all of them, only then a new batch will appear. By removing tiles, you get points. The game ends when the free space for tiles on the grid runs out. The goal of the game is to earn the maximum number of points.

name: Furry Wedding Proposal
description: Hi, young stylist! You will find a very unusual couple in love - a brutal fox and a feminine bunny - who are preparing for their future wedding. They dream of looking stunning on this holiday and you will become their main assistant in this exciting adventure! You have to dress the characters in beautiful wedding dresses, choose stylish hairstyles for them and apply light makeup. Are you ready to become a part of this wonderful story and help the characters become the most beautiful couple? Create, fantasize and create a fairy tale with them!
instructions: This game takes you to a fictional world of anthropomorphic animals, where you will create vivid wedding images for a very unusual couple of lovers. The most interesting wedding images can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

name: Crypto Exchange Simulator
description:
Test yourself in the world of cryptocurrency!
Buy and sell coins, follow the news, spin the wheel of fortune, and unlock new crypto groups.
Earn money, invest in property — from sports cars to islands — and climb the ranks of top crypto traders!
instructions: Intuitive controls — use the mouse on PC, tap with your finger on mobile. No extra keys or buttons required.

name: Formula Racers
description: Play Formula Racers game online and for free at NewKidsGames.org. Racing carriers in the amount of three units have already embarked on their positions at the start. As soon as the green traffic light lights up, the race will begin and it is important for you not to miss the beginning in order to immediately break forward. The control is simple, but the speed is high, so you need to react quickly, forcing your car the car deftly and accurately enter the turns. Since the track has a configuration, there will be many turns, there will be many turns. About the upcoming turn you will inform the yellow icon indicating the direction so that you react in time to Formula Racers.
instructions: Use WASD or arrow keys to drive or touch buttons on your mobile device.

name: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop
description:
"Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop" – A Charming Puzzle Game About Merging Jelly Dolls!

In this addictive game, you'll drop adorable Labubu dolls, match identical ones, and create new characters! When two matching Labubus collide, they transform into the next doll in your collection. Earn coins for every merge, then spend them to operate the claw machine – fish out exactly the Labubu you need to complete each level!

Can you collect all the Labubus?
instructions:
On Mobile:
— Press and hold a doll with your finger, then drag it to the desired location.
— Release to drop the doll - physics will take over!

On Computer:
— Mouse: Click and drag a doll, then release to drop it.
— Keyboard: Use arrow keys to move, press Space to drop the doll.

name: Car Line Rider
description: You control a neon car that leaves a bright, glowing trail behind it. Avoid crashing into your own trail or your opponents’ paths. Stay sharp, outmaneuver everyone, and aim to be the last one standing!
instructions: Left and Right Arrow to drive.

name: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

Currently, you can create two types of games ('places'): a platformer and a shooter.
instructions:
Game controls: WASD or ←, →, ↑, ↓, where S or ↓ is used to shoot. In single-player mode, you can choose any of these options.

When you get bored, be sure to click "Delete the Game" to get the in-game currency you earned while playing.

name: Nine Cards Of Winter
description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Nine Cards of Winter, a fun and relaxing tile-matching game!
Pick up to 9 Christmas tiles and match 3 of the same to clear them. Watch out — if your stack fills up, the game is over!
Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles, solve tricky puzzles, and enjoy cute holiday designs.It’s easy to play, relaxing to enjoy, and full of winter charm!
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to tap tiles and match three of the same to clear them.

name: Passengers Bus Sorting
description: Today, in the new online game, Passengers Bus Sorting will then regulate passengers at the bus station. Before you on the screen will be visible a crowd of multi-colored men. Buses of various colors will move to the stop, which will stop next to people for a few minutes. During this time, you will have to find the men of exactly the same color as the bus and clicking on them with the mouse to send them to the stop. When the passengers sit on the bus and he will get away from the stop at the Passengers Bus Sorting game will be charged points.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer
description: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer is a fun and interactive version of the classic game you know and love! Choose to host a match or join a friend’s game in just a few clicks. Challenge players from anywhere and test your strategy skills in real time. The goal is simple — line up three of your marks before your opponent does! Whether you’re playing for fun or bragging rights, Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer offers quick, exciting gameplay that never gets old. Perfect for players of all ages, it’s an easy way to relax, compete, and enjoy timeless entertainment with friends online.

name: Crazy Rocket Man
description: Crazy Rocket Man is an exciting and entertaining online game made especially for kids who love action and creativity! The main goal is simple yet super fun — match the puppet’s pose on the left side of the screen with the one on the right. Every time you successfully copy the pose, you’ll earn a rocket part as your reward. Keep matching and collecting until you’ve built your entire rocket! Once all the parts are assembled, your rocket will be ready to blast off into space. It’s a thrilling mix of memory, coordination, and imagination — perfect for players who love interactive challenges and playful adventures. Get ready to pose, match, and launch in Crazy Rocket Man!

Perfect kids vet game, pet hospital game, and pet clinic game for parents looking for safe, playable web games.

name: Candy Match Puzzle Challenge
description: Candy Match Puzzle is an exciting and free-to-play online match style game designed to bring endless fun and challenge to players of all ages! Your goal is simple but addictive — match as many colorful candies as possible to achieve the highest score. Connect four or more identical candies to clear them from the board and watch as sweet combos and chain reactions fill your screen with rewarding points.
instructions: Left and Right arrow to move the player. Z to drab the candy, X to swap two candies.

name: Halloween Match Trio
description: Halloween Match Trio is a classic match-3 puzzle game with fun challenges. Swap items to make a line of three or more matching items, horizontally or vertically. Keep matching to unlock all tiles and reach the final stage. Use power-ups like bombs, arrows, magnets, and more to clear levels faster. Complete all 75 levels to win the game!
instructions: Use a mouse or toucphad to play this game.

name: Hidden Horrors
description: Ready to explore the haunted Halloween world? Play a hidden object game with 30 Halloween levels. Each level has 6 hidden objects. Find all objects before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint. The game is easy to play. Enjoy colorful Halloween scenes and fun gameplay.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to play this game.

name: Durak vs AI
description:
In this game you will have to show your wit and ability to analyze the situation on the battlefield. The AI will adapt to your actions, learn from your mistakes and become stronger with each round.
You will use all your skills and strategy to defeat the computer opponent. Exciting games are waiting for you, where every card matters and can affect the outcome of the game.
Artificial intelligence is constantly adapting and learning, so each new game will be unique and unpredictable.
instructions: The aim of the game is to get rid of all the cards. The player who fails to do so is recognized as a " Durak " (loser). The game is started by the person who has the trump card of the lowest value in his hand. During the game, the incoming player puts any of his cards on the table, and the rebounding player must either beat it or take it. To beat a card, the highest card of the same suit or trump, if the beaten card is not a trump, must be placed on top of it.

name: Supermarket Simulator: Dream Store
description:
Build and expand your shop: add shelves, displays, products, and decorations to attract more customers. Hire staff and manage their skills and motivation. Handle orders, discounts, and marketing campaigns. Every day, your store grows bigger and more profitable!

Features:

- Full shop building: shelves, racks, cash registers, decorations.
- Customer service and queue management.
-  Hire employees and upgrade their skills.
- Finance management: pricing, discounts, promotions.
- Grow from a small store to a retail empire.
instructions:
Build your store from scratch: place shelves and products.

Hire staff and manage their skills.

Serve customers and keep them happy.

Manage finances: set prices, discounts, and promotions.

Expand your store, open new departments, and upgrade decorations.

name: Halloween Tom Math Challenge
description: Halloween Tom Math Challenge is a super fun and completely free math game that lets you test your quick-thinking and basic math skills in a spooky Halloween world! Solve simple math problems, beat the clock, and help Tom through thrilling Halloween-themed challenges. Perfect for kids and adults who love brain games with a festive twist — learn, play, and enjoy the Halloween fun while sharpening your math skills!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Boo-tiful Princess Match
description: Welcome to an exciting puzzle-game, created in a Halloween atmosphere. There are three princesses in the game and each one is ready for her own eerily beautiful transformation. The player will have to look for paired cards to discover new elements of the girls future image. Each successful match brings you closer to creating a unique costume, makeup or hairstyle. Only the most attentive players will be able to make their princesses truly scary-beautiful!
instructions: A puzzle game for the development of attention and memory, in which players create a collection of Halloween looks for girls, discovering new elements and combining them. The most interesting images can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used for control.

name: Sudoku Master - classic Sudoku
description:
Dive into the world of exciting digital puzzles with "Sudoku Master - Classic Sudoku"! This is a classic puzzle game that has become a real hit! 
"Sudoku" offers different levels of difficulty, ranging from beginners to Mega Brain! With each level the difficulty of the tasks will increase, testing your skills and ability to find non-standard solutions.
But the main advantage of Sudoku is the opportunity to develop your logical skills and train your brain while having fun. Start playing now and join the millions of players around the world who have fallen in love with this addictive digital puzzle game!
instructions:
The goal of Sudoku is to fill a 9x9 playing field (each row, column and 3x3 block) with numbers from 1 to 9, numbers vertically must not repeat, numbers horizontally must not repeat, a number in a 3x3 square can only occur 1 time. 
There are notes in the game, which greatly simplify the process of finding numbers. In order to activate the notes, click on the button with the image of a pencil. In each game you have the right to make five mistakes.  If you find the game too easy - go to a more difficult level.

name: Bolts and Nuts - Sorting
description: Bolts and Nuts - Sorting is a captivating casual game where each level challenges your logic and attentiveness! Unscrew bolts, collect nuts, and solve puzzles to progress. Simple controls and intuitive gameplay make the game accessible to everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it exciting.

name: Shogi: Japanese Chess
description:
The players make their moves one at a time. The whites go first. A move is the movement of one of the pieces of its color available on the board to any allowed field according to the rules of movement of the pieces or the setting of a piece that is in reserve. The pieces in reserve are pieces taken from the opponent.
When the figures reach the enemy's camp, they can be strengthened, transformed. When transformed, the figure turns over. Any figure can strengthen, except for the king and the golden general.
The goal of the game is to checkmate the opponent's king. It is considered that a checkmate has been placed when the king is under attack by an enemy piece, i.e. he is in a field where the enemy piece can resemble, but there is no way to defend himself or leave.

You can play with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
- The King. Moves to the same field in any direction, except for the field under the opponent's check.
- The rook. It moves horizontally and vertically to any number of fields not occupied by other shapes. Upon reaching the enemy camp, it can be transformed into the dragon king, a figure that, while maintaining the Rook's capabilities, can additionally move diagonally in any direction onto the same field.
- The elephant. Moves diagonally in any direction to any number of fields not occupied by other pieces. Upon reaching the enemy camp, he can be transformed into a dragon knight, a figure that, while retaining the bishop's capabilities, can additionally walk vertically or horizontally in any direction on the same field.
- The Golden General. It can move one field horizontally or vertically in any direction, as well as diagonally forward.
- The Silver General. It can move one field diagonally in any direction or one field vertically forward. After reaching the enemy camp, he can be transformed into a golden general.
- The horse. The knight's move is one square vertically forward, then one square diagonally to the right or left without the possibility of retreat. After reaching the enemy camp, he can be transformed into a golden general.
- The spear. It only moves forward vertically to any number of fields that are not occupied by other shapes. Upon reaching the enemy camp, he can be transformed into a golden general.
- A pawn. It moves one field forward vertically. He hits enemy pieces not diagonally, as in chess, but straight in front of him. After reaching the enemy camp, she can be transformed into a golden general.

description:
In the game, the checkers taken are not removed from the board, but are placed under the checker that took them, forming a tower. The tower moves as a single unit, obeying the rules of moving and taking checkers, depending on which checker is on top of it.

You can play with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode.

The tower belongs to the player whose top checker or queen is on it.
The tower moves entirely, obeying the rules of the move of a regular checker if there is a regular checker on top, or queens if there is a queen on top.
instructions:
An ordinary checker moves diagonally forward one square. The queen moves diagonally to any number of free fields, both forward and backward.
When a regular checker reaches the last horizontal row, it becomes a queen.
When taking a piece, it is placed under the piece that took it, forming a tower. If a tower hits another tower, then only the upper checker or queen is placed under it.
The captured checkers are placed under the checker that took them after the completion of the entire turn, and not during the capture process. If there is an opportunity to continue the fight during the capture, then the checker or queen must continue to beat as long as possible.
If, in the process of taking a checker or a queen, it returns to the field that is occupied by an already beaten checker, then the capture stops.
If there is a choice of which way to hit with multiple hits, the player chooses the option at his discretion.

The goal of the game is to cover or block all the opponent's checkers.

name: Austrian domino duel
description:
This game was widespread in Vienna at the beginning of the 20th century. In Austria, dominoes used to be played with 36 chips: 45 chips from the double eight game are taken and nine double chips are removed.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence or with an online opponent in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
Each player is dealt 10 dice. The remaining bones are deposited in the bazaar.
In the first round, the player with the largest dice goes first. In the following rounds, the one who won the previous one goes first.
The first move can be made with any dice, and then the players take turns laying out the corresponding dice in their turn on the sides of the corresponding end.
If a player cannot make a move, he must take a bone from the bazaar until either he gets a bone that can be played, or the bazaar is empty.
If the player cannot play the dice and the market is empty, the turn goes to the opponent.
The round ends if the player has played all his dice.
The winner of the round is the player who lays out all his dice, or the player with the lowest score.
The player gets the total points for the opponent's dice. 
The game lasts for several rounds and the first player to score 50, 70, 100, 120 points wins, depending on the game conditions.

name: Tavreli: Russian Chess
description:
All the rules of ordinary chess are preserved, even castling and taking on the passage. The main difference is that the pieces are not cut down, but captured, taking up a position on the opponent's piece and thus forming towers. Thus, all the pieces remain on the chessboard until the end of the game. Captured pieces can be released during the game.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and offer your own version of the player's next move by making it on the board.
instructions:
Each pawn is positioned opposite the piece it turns into on the last horizontal.
Towers can be built from your own pieces; the most powerful structure consists of two bishops, a queen, and a helga located underneath.
The entire tower can be moved according to the rules of movement of the upper figure.
During its turn, the tower can only be divided into two parts in any ratio.
The newly formed tower becomes active immediately after the division, and if it is located on the last horizontal and there is a pawn (warrior) on top, it immediately turns into its own piece.
No pieces can be placed on the king (Magus).
If a warrior who has turned into his own figure participates in the exchange and the opponent's figure stands on him, then he again becomes an ordinary warrior, and he must be moved to the last horizontal to transform.
The game is won by the player who checkmated his partner's magus.

name: Domino sausage, duel
description:
A game in which players actively try to get rid of their dominoes by redirecting them to another player through a "cut" part of the chain, which makes the game more dynamic and intense.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence or with an online opponent in multiplayer mode.

All dominoes are divided equally, with 14 open dominoes each. It is the open version of the game that is implemented, and not the closed one, where the dominoes are in a closed state for the players and where only one domino opens from the edge during the player's turn. The option with all the open dominoes is more dynamic and interesting.
instructions:
The one with the one-on-one dominoes goes first. He can walk with any of his dominoes. The game is played in two parallel lines from the first domino. The players take turns laying out dominoes that match the numbers to the end of the already laid out chain. A domino is placed so that one of its sides touches a domino in a chain with the same number.

The player can cut the sausage to his opponent. To do this, if the player takes out dominoes, for example 3 and 4, and there are 3 and 4 laid out in parallel on the table, then you can cut them off. The opponent takes the cut sausage.

The game ends when one of the players lays out all his dominoes or when the chain is blocked (no one can make a move). In case of blocking, the players count the points on their remaining dominoes and the player with the least points wins.

name: Your trumps, a card duel
description:
This is a single-attack game, the earliest printed descriptions of which date back to the 19th century.

During the game, the players place the cards from their hands into an open deck in the center of the table. The goal of the game is to get rid of all your cards. A player who cannot make a move must draw one or more cards from the top of the deck. The player who plays all his cards wins. The player who has the remaining cards is considered the loser.
Each player chooses a trump suit before dealing the cards. The cards of the player's trump suit can be used to beat any card of any other suit.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence or with an online opponent in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
The player starting the game places any card face up in the center of the table to start the playing deck. The next player has two options:
- A player can beat the top card of the game stack by playing a higher card of the same suit or by playing one of his trumps on a card of a different suit. After doing this, the player must play another card on top of it; this second card can be any card of the player's choice.
- A player who cannot beat the top card of the game stack must instead take some cards from the top of the game stack.

The goal of the game is to get rid of all your cards. When a player runs out of cards, he wins the game, and his opponent loses. If the last player in the game has only one card that can be used to beat the previous player's kara, then the game ends in a draw.

description: Chain Reaction is an intellectual game where each move can trigger a series of mergers. It is suitable for developing logical thinking, planning and concentration. Immerse yourself in the world of numbers, where every step can be the beginning of a powerful chain reaction!
instructions: Use drag and drop to move blocks from the bottom panel to the empty cells on the field. New blocks appear after placing all blocks, so plan your actions accordingly. Place a block next to the same number. They will merge in the direction of your move. New value = block value × number of merged blocks. Example: three '16' → 16 × 3 = 48. If after merging a new block collides with the same numbers, the process repeats. Example: You place '4' next to '4' → 4 × 2 = 8. The '8' block collides with two '8' → 8 × 3 = 24. The '24' block touches another '24' → 24 × 2 = 48. Achieve the maximum value using chain reactions. Points are awarded for each merge, which will elevate you in the leaderboard. The game ends if the field is fully filled, and there are no possible merges.

instructions:
- At the beginning of the game, everyone is dealt 7 knuckles.
- The player with the least double in his hand starts, except for a dummy
- Players make moves one at a time by building a chain on the table so that the numbers match on adjacent knuckles
- If there is no suitable knuckle on the hand, then they take it from the market until they find the right one.
- The winner is the player who is the first to remain without knuckles in his hand.
- The losing player counts his penalty points equal to the number of dots on the remaining knuckles
- The exceptions are 0-0 gives 25 points and 6-6 gives 50 points
- If the players have no possible move and the market is empty, then the game ends and the one with the least points on the knuckles wins.
- Then the next hand begins, and it continues until one of the players scores 100 points, and he is considered the loser in the entire game.

There are two players in the game. Each player gets seven knuckles. The players take turns walking. The player with the least double starts the game, starting with a one-one double. The double is laid out in the middle of the playing field. You can place knuckles on four sides of the first exposed double. The next player can place a die with the corresponding number on any of the four sides of the first double placed in the middle. If a player does not have a suitable dice for the next turn, he has to look for it in reserve, go to the market. He chooses one domino from the bazaar until the desired number of dice falls out or until the dice in the bazaar run out. Then the player skips his turn and his opponent goes.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence or with an online opponent in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
If a player has the opportunity to put up a double on each side, then he can put them up in one turn. The player who sets a double has the right to close it. When closing a take, further exposure of the knuckles from this side is prohibited. If several doubles are played at the same time, the player has the right to close any number of doubles.

The game ends when one of the players lays out the last die, that is, he will not have a single domino left in his hands. Next, the points remaining to his opponent are counted. These points are credited to the opponent.

The game may end with a fish, which is the name given to blocking the layout, when each player still has dice in their hands, but no one has anything to report. When fishing, the winnings belong to the one who has the least points in his hands. The points of the remaining knuckles are not credited to the winner, and the points of the remaining knuckles are recorded to his opponent, the loser.

name: Xiangqi: Chinese chess, duel
description:
The game is played on a rectangular board of 9 by 10 lines. The shapes are set at the intersections of the lines. There is a river between the two central horizontal lines, which affects the movement of pawns, knights and bishops. The two areas marked by two diagonal lines of 3-by-3 squares are called palaces. Kings and advisors cannot leave these squares. The first move is made by the red pieces.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and offer your own version of the player's next move by making it on the board.
instructions:
Shapes:
- The king can only walk one point horizontally or vertically within his palace. Kings cannot stand on the same vertical so that there are no pieces between them; moves that create such a situation are prohibited.
- The Advisor can only move 1 point in the diagonal direction in 1 turn. Like the king, he cannot leave the palace.
- The bishop moves diagonally by two points. Can't jump over pieces. Can't cross the river.
- The cannon moves like a chess rook. Captures the opponent's pieces only if there is exactly one piece between it and the attacked piece.
- The chariot moves to any number of available points vertically or horizontally.
- The knight moves to one point vertically or horizontally, and then to a point diagonally. It does not jump over the pieces, but moves in the plane of the board.: first horizontally or vertically, and then diagonally. If there is any piece at the intermediate point of the knight's move, it blocks this move.
- The pawn moves one point ahead. In the enemy's territory (across the river), it has the additional ability to walk sideways, also by one point. After reaching the last line, he walks only sideways.

Party Completion:
Check is an attack on the king by any piece. The player whose king has been given a check must defend himself against the check in return. Any other moves are forbidden to him. If there is no protection from a check, it is a checkmate and a loss. To protect against a check, you can either move the king to a point that is not under attack, or beat the attacking piece, or block its attack.
A stalemate is also a loss — the player's lack of legal moves.
The player who repeats the move three times loses.

description:
Short backgammon is a board game for two players on a special board divided into two halves. The birthplace of this game is not exactly known, but it is known that people have been playing this game for more than 5,000 years, which there is historical evidence. So, the oldest of the backgammon boards was found on the territory of Iran and dates back to about 3000 BC. An analogue of this game was found in the tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun.
The rules of the game of backgammon are simple and novice players will easily master them, but nevertheless, in order to win, you need logical thinking and of course luck. The Backgammon game consists of a special board, 30 checkers of two different colors and two dice dice. 2 players take part in the game.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
The goal of the game is to bring all your chips into the house and remove them from the board before the second player does it. Players alternately roll the dice and move the checkers in accordance with the points that have fallen out, pass the checkers full circle on the board to their house and take them out of the board.
The numbers on each dice indicate how many points, or steps, the player must move his checkers. Checkers always move only in one direction - from points with large numbers to points with smaller ones.
The following rules apply:
- a checker can only move to an open point, that is, to one that is not occupied by two or more checkers of the opposite color.
- the numbers on both dice make up separate moves.
The player who has a double, plays each of the numbers on each of the dice twice.
When a player has brought all his fifteen checkers into his house, he can start throwing them off the board. The one who first removed all the checkers from the board wins the game.

name: Ugolki - halma
description:
The goal of the game is to move all your checkers faster than the opponent to the
place where the opponent's checkers were originally located.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and offer your own version of the player's next move by making it on the board.

The game can be played on two board sizes: 8 by 8 and 10 by 10 squares. You can choose different starting arrangements: rectangle, square, triangle. As well as the possibility of movement: both normal - horizontally and vertically, and additional diagonally.
instructions:
The players take turns moving one piece per turn. They walk horizontally and vertically. In the diagonal version of the game, checkers can be moved diagonally.
A free-standing checker can be jumped over if the field behind it is clear. You can jump over both your checkers and your opponent's checkers. You can jump through any number of checkers in one move, the length of the jump is unlimited and optional – you can interrupt the "jumps" at any time. In the diagonal version of the game, you can "jump" diagonally.

The game is considered completed:

- When one of the players moves all his checkers to the place where the opponent's checkers were originally located, he is declared the winner. If the players move in the same number of moves, a draw is declared.
- On turn 80, the game ends and the player with the most checkers in the opponent's house wins. If both players have the same number, a draw is awarded.

Select three identical tiles to remove them from the board. You can only select tiles that are free and not covered from above. Only 8 tiles can fit in the bottom bar. If it fills up, you lose.

Your goal is to gradually remove all the tiles from the board. Use boosters to speed up the game.

The rules of "Coin Merge Machine" are simple. By clicking the mouse or tapping the screen, drop coins onto the field.
Merge similar coins to get more valuable ones. Keep them under the dotted line. The game will over if coin will stay beyond it for a few seconds.

Your main goal is to reach 100 gold - the biggest coin in the game.

The merging mechanics are simple, but to win the game, you will need to not only combine visible coins, but also use strategic thinking! On the machine panel, you can see the next coin and plan your move. There is also a possibility to remove unnecessary coins in the game. Use coin deletion button on machine's panel for it.

Use physics! Coins collide and roll according to the laws of physics.

Direct the movement of new coins after merging! If you throw one coin onto similar one on the left side, the new merged coin will bounce to the left, if on the right side - to the right.

name: Mill, nine mens morris
description:
This game is one of the oldest in the world. The origins of the game lie in the depths of centuries and it is impossible to say when and by whom it was invented. The earliest traces of this game were found in Troy (3000-2500 BC), Pakistan (2600-1800 BC). Archaeologists have also found hundreds of ancient boards for this game in Egypt, Armenia, Greece, Italy, Iceland, China and other parts of the Old World. No other game in the history of mankind has been so popular.

The game has a huge number of variations and names. This application presents the classic European version of the game.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, with another person on one device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
Each player takes turns placing their chip on one of the empty circles. As soon as a player has managed to line up three of his pieces in a straight line, he removes any of his opponent's pieces from the board. This row of three pieces of the same color is called a mill.

After a player has placed all of his pieces on the board, he can start moving: moving his pieces. Players move their pieces one by one to an adjacent free circle along the line, creating a mill. They cannot jump or move their pieces diagonally.

As soon as one of the players has three pieces left, he gains an advantage. On his next move, he can move his pieces to any free circle, regardless of the squares.

The game is considered over in two cases:
- When one of the players has two pieces left. He is considered the loser, since he can no longer build a mill.
- The game is considered won by a player if the opponent cannot make a move, since all the adjacent squares are occupied.

name: Reversi Othello, Duel
description:
The game uses a square board measuring 8 by 8 cells and 64 special chips, painted white and black on different sides. One player plays white, the other plays black. When making a move, a player places a chip on a cell of the board with "his" color. At the beginning of the game, 4 chips are placed in the center of the board: two black and two white. The first move is made by black. Then the players move in turns.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, with another person on one device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
When making a move, a player places his piece on one of the squares of the board in such a way that between this placed piece and one of the pieces of his color already on the board there is a continuous row of the opponent's pieces, horizontal, vertical or diagonal, so that the continuous row of the opponent's pieces is "closed" by the player's pieces on both sides. All the opponent's pieces that are part of the "closed" row on this move are turned over to the other side and go to the player who made the move.

If as a result of one move more than one row of the opponent's pieces is "closed" at the same time, then all the pieces that are on those "closed" rows that go from the placed piece are turned over.

The game ends when all the pieces are placed on the board or when neither player can make a move. The player with the most pieces on the board wins.

name: Mau-Mau - 101, card duel
description:
The game exists in many variations under different names: "Czech fool", "English fool", "Pharaoh", "Pentagon", differing in minor details. Such famous games as "Crazy eights", Uno, "What?", "Svintus", Taki originated from this game.

You can play the game with artificial intelligence or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.

The goal of the game is to discard your cards faster than your opponent. The player who discards his cards first will be considered the winner of the round. The game is played with a deck of 36 cards. In the settings of the game with the computer, you can also choose decks of 24, 32, 52 cards.

Players are dealt four cards. The remaining cards are placed in the center of the table. In the first round, the player who will go first is determined randomly. In the next round, the winner starts the turn.
instructions:
The strategy of the game is to beat the previous player's card. Players take turns making moves. Participants put a card of the same suit or similar in value (dignity) on top. For example, if they put down the eight of spades, the next player has the right to discard one of the cards of the suit of spades or an eight of any suit.

If a player does not have a card that meets the conditions, he draws a card from the common pile/deck. With this card, he can beat the card of the previous player, if it fits. Then the turn passes to the opponent.

Special cards.

6 - the opponent takes one card from the common deck instead of his turn.
7 - the opponent takes two cards from the common deck instead of his turn.
9 - the player who put it down must cover it with another card.
Ace - the opponent skips a turn.
King of spades - the opponent must take four cards from the deck and skip a turn.
The queen can be placed on any card and any suit can be ordered.

It is possible to capture an enemy figure between your figure and an empty "throne". The "Throne" is always hostile to attackers, but to defenders - only when it is empty. Capture is not obligatory. name: Makruk: Thai Chess
description:
The board has the same dimensions as in classical chess: 8 × 8 squares. The initial arrangement generally coincides with the arrangement in classical chess, but has two differences: the white queen is located on the e1 square, the white king is on the d1 square (that is, each king is to the left of his queen, when viewed from the player’s side); the pawns are located on the third rank from the player (that is, white on the third, and black on the sixth).

The usual moves of the king, rook and pawn are the same as chess ones: the king moves one square horizontally, vertically or diagonally, the rook moves any number of free squares vertically or horizontally, the pawn moves one square forward and attacks one square diagonally forward.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.
instructions:
Piece moves:
The king moves like in European chess. There is no possibility of castling (moving the king towards the rook).
Queen - moves only one point diagonally.
Rook - can move any number of squares horizontally or vertically, provided that there are no pieces in its path.
Bishop - moves one square diagonally in any direction or one square forward vertically.
Horse - moves two cells vertically and then one cell horizontally, or vice versa, two cells horizontally and one cell vertically (the same as in the European analogue).
A pawn moves one step forward vertically and cuts one step forward diagonally, as in European chess. A pawn can only transform into an analogue of a queen, reaching the sixth rank.

Victory conditions:
As in classical chess, the goal of the game is to checkmate the opponent's king. Pat brings a draw.

The goal of the game is to destroy all the opponent's checkers or deprive them of the opportunity to move ("lock").

instructions:
A 10×10 square board is used for the game. Checkers are placed on the black fields of the first four horizontal rows on each side. The player playing white moves first, then the moves are made alternately. Checkers are divided into simple and kings. In the initial position, all checkers are simple.

Rules of the course
A simple checker moves diagonally forward one square. When any field of the last horizontal is reached, a simple checker turns into a king.
The queen moves diagonally to any free field both forward and backward.
Taking is mandatory if it is possible.

The game is considered won in the following cases:
- if one of the opponents has beaten all the checkers;
- if the checkers of one of the participants are locked, and he cannot make another move.

If a participant hits the cards, the next move belongs to him. If he fails, he skips his turn, takes all the cards that his opponent threw out to him that turn, and the opponent continues the next turn.
The player who made the move is the first to replenish the supplies from the deck, and then the one who fought back.

The first player to run out of cards when the deck runs out wins. The participant with cards in his hands loses. If during the last “attack” one player got rid of his cards, and the second successfully covered them, then a draw is declared.
