The winner is the one who is the first to build a continuous row of five stones of his color vertically, horizontally or diagonally. It has many options, differing in individual details of the rules. The game is believed to have been invented in China more than two thousand years ago. Currently, the game is known all over the world; sporting competitions are held based on it.

The goal of the game is to be the first to build a continuous row of five stones in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal direction using stones of your color.
If the board is full and no player has made a row of five stones, a draw may be declared.

description:
Two players play on the field - blue and red. They move in turns, placing a dot at the intersection of lines. One dot is placed in one move and it does not move anymore. It is necessary to surround the opponent's dots, not allowing your own to be surrounded. The player who captures more dots wins.

You can play the game with artificial intelligence, together with another person on one device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.

instructions:
Players can move to free points that are not occupied by dots or not included in the encirclement. There is no option to skip a move.

When creating a continuous (vertical, horizontal, diagonal) closed line, an encirclement area is formed. If there are opponent's points inside it (there may be points not occupied by anyone's points), then this is considered an encirclement area. If there are no opponent's points, then the area is free and points can be placed in it. Points that fall into the encirclement area do not participate in the formation of encirclement lines. Points placed on the edge of the field are not surrounded.

The game ends in one of the following cases:
- When there are no free spaces left on the field.
- If the number of points required for victory is set, the game is played until one of the players encircles this set number of opponent's points.

name: Russian draughts, duel
description:
The traditional and most popular type of checkers in Russia and the countries of the former USSR. The goal of the game is to deprive the opponent of the opportunity to move by taking or locking all his checkers.

The game can be played with artificial intelligence, together with another person on the same device, or with a rival online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and offer your own version of the player's next move by making it on the board.
instructions:
The player with the white checkers goes first.
A simple checker moves diagonally forward one square.
The queen moves diagonally to any available field, both forward and backward.
Taking is mandatory.
A simple checker located next to the opponent's checker, behind which there is an empty field, is transferred through this checker to this free field. If it is possible to continue taking other opponent's checkers, then this capture continues. Taking a simple checker is done both forward and backward.
The queen hits diagonally, both forward and backward, and stands on any free field after the beaten checkers.

The game is considered won:
- if one of the opponents has beaten all the checkers;
- if one of the opponents' checkers and queens are immobilized, i.e. he is unable to make a move when it is his turn;

name: Dominoes classic, duel
description:
A board game in which a chain of dominoes ("bones", "stones") is built, touching halves with the same number of dots indicating the number of points.

You can play the game with artificial intelligence or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode.

A classic set has 28 dominoes, they are also called stones or bones. These rectangles are divided into 2 parts, each with dots from 0 to 6.
Two players play the game. At the beginning of the game, 7 bones are dealt to each player.
The remaining ones are kept aside in reserve, with the clean side up (on the market).
instructions:
The player who has a double 6-6 starts, he puts up a bone. The next players place 6-1, 6-2, etc., respectively.
After the first move, the players take turns placing suitable chips with the same value as the last one placed on the table. If there are no suitable ones, then additional ones are taken from the reserve (at the market). The more bones a player takes from the reserve, the further he is from winning, since it is not advantageous to have many tiles in dominoes.
The game ends when one of the players places his last stone. The winner is credited with the sum of the points of all the stones remaining in the loser's hand. The game can end when there are stones in hand, but nothing to report - "fish". In this situation, the winner belongs to the one with the fewest points. The difference in points is recorded as his win.
In a new round, the winner of the previous round makes the first move.
The game continues until a pre-agreed sum is reached: 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 points.

instructions:
Classical chess has sixteen pieces (six different types).
1. King - moves from his field to one of the free adjacent fields, which is not under attack by the opponent's pieces.
2. Queen (queen) - can move to any number of free squares in any direction in a straight line, combining the capabilities of a rook and a bishop.
3. Rook - can move any number of squares horizontally or vertically, provided that there are no pieces in its path.
4. Bishop - can move to any number of squares diagonally, provided that there are no pieces on its way.
5. Knight - moves two squares vertically and then one square horizontally, or vice versa, two squares horizontally and one square vertically.
6. Pawn - moves forward one space only, except for capture.

The ultimate goal of each player is to checkmate their opponent. This means that the opponent's king gets into a situation in which a capture is inevitable.

name: Turkish draughts
description:
One of the varieties of checkers, the characteristic feature of which, unlike most checkers variants, is that the moves and captures of checkers are made not diagonally, but vertically and horizontally.

You can play the game with artificial intelligence, together with another person on one device, or with an opponent online in multiplayer mode. You can also watch other players' games, act as a spectator, and also suggest your own version of the next move to the player by making it on the board.
instructions:
- The player with the white checkers goes first.
- A simple checker goes one square forward, left, or right.
- A queen goes any number of empty squares forward, backward, right, or left.
- If a player has the opportunity to capture the opponent's checkers during his turn, he must capture them. Capturing an opponent's checker is only possible when the square behind the opponent's checker is empty. If the checker that captured the opponent's checker can continue to capture from the new position, the capture of checkers continues. Several opponent's checkers can be captured in one move.
- If there are several options for capturing the opponent's checkers, the player must choose the one that captures the largest number. This applies to capturing with both checkers and queens.
- If there are several options for capturing the same number of checkers, the player has the right to choose any of these options.
- A simple checker captures the opponent's checker standing in front, to the right, or to the left. Taking back an opponent's checker or queen is prohibited.
- A queen takes opponent's checkers standing any number of empty squares in front, behind, to the right and to the left of it, if the square following the checker is free. A queen, like a simple checker, can take several opponent's checkers in one move. Having taken an opponent's checker, a queen must stand on the square behind the taken checker.
- When taking checkers, they are removed from the board one by one during the battle, but a queen does not have the right to change its direction to the opposite, that is, by 180°, during a vertical or horizontal strike move.
- A simple checker that has entered the eighth horizontal becomes a queen at the end of the move, but it cannot continue to take as a queen on the same move.
- The winner is the one who was able to destroy all the opponent's checkers or deprive them of the opportunity to move, or the one who is left with several of his simple checkers against one simple checker of the opponent. - If the players have one checker left on the board, a draw is declared.

name: Minesweeper Duel
description:
Minesweeper Duel is a new mode for the game familiar from childhood.

In a one-on-one competition, you open the cells in turn with your opponent and get points equal to the face value of the open cell. The player with the highest score wins. The player who stumbles upon a mine loses immediately.

Available field sizes:
- Newbie
- Amateur
- Professional

Time for thinking is limited, choose different modes:
- The bullet
- Blitz
- Classic

The shortest timer in the Pool, you have only one minute to either open the entire field or hold out until the opponent makes a mistake. Real madness for extreme sports fans!

Most of the time is in the Classics, and this gives a completely different character to the game. Carefully plan which cells you will open and calculate the opponent's moves so that you get the most points. And if you open a free zone, you can get 10 points at once!

Minesweeper Duel trains mindfulness, concentration, logic. And in the competition there is also strategic thinking
instructions:
The basic goal of the game is to open all the cells of the field where there are no mines.
The numbers on the cells will help in this - each number shows how many mines are on neighboring cells.
Based on this information, gradually open cell by cell. But be careful - if you come across a mine, you will lose immediately.

On a computer, a left-click opens a cell. Right-clicking marks a cell with a flag, which means that you assume a mine on this cell. Right-clicking on a cell again marks it with a question mark.
In the game on your mobile phone, you can select the input mode using three buttons above the field: open the cell, put a flag, put a question mark.

In a single player, the task is to open the entire field yourself in the shortest time.

The game offers various boosters to help you overcome challenges:

Bombs: Destroy a group of fruits, clearing space for new ones.
Shakers: Shake the screen to move fruits and merge those far apart.
Upgrades: Instantly level up a selected fruit, bringing you closer to rare combinations.
Removers: Remove any chosen fruit from the board.
With simple mechanics and engaging gameplay, Blend Fruits is perfect for both beginners and experienced players.
instructions:
Starting the Game:
Press the "Play" button to begin. Fruits will start dropping onto the game board.

Dropping Fruits:
Control the falling fruits by dragging them with your finger (or mouse if playing on a PC). Your goal is to merge identical fruits to create bigger ones.

Using Boosters:

Tap on the booster icon at the bottom of the screen.
Select the fruit or area where you want to activate its effect.
Game Objective:
Survive as long as possible by merging fruits and scoring points. Prevent the board from filling up to the top.

Game Over:
The game ends when the fruits reach the top of the board. You can restart and try to beat your high score!

instructions:
Lay out cards of the same suit in sequence from Ace to King.
You can put any ace in the four left cells.
In a free cell you can put a card of the same suit as the card lying to the left of this cell, but one higher in value.
You can't put anything next to the king.
If there are no more moves left, the cards can be shuffled.
You can only shuffle the cards 3 times.

An addictive physics puzzle game, the goal of which is to crash the robot on each level in all sorts of ways or give him the opportunity to do so himself. Arrange items from your inventory and trigger a chain of events to reach the goal! Also use cannons and jumppads.

The game has over 50 levels +5 bonus levels!
instructions:
Drag items from the inventory at the top of the screen onto the game scene and start the chain of events by clicking on the "Start" button at the bottom, middle of the screen.

To fire the cannon, turn it to the desired angle, simultaneously select the force of the shot and release it. The shot will be fired automatically if the number of shots is indicated on the cannon.

To control the jumpad, similar to the cannon, turn it to the desired angle while selecting the bounce force.

It is possible to aim the cannon and control the jumpad even after the "Start" button is pressed.

Replay the level if the goal is not reached.

Tips:
- If you don't know how to place items, use the hint (button with a question mark).
- If you replay levels with a lot of explosions, you can score more points.

PC: mouse. 'P'/'Esc' - pause. 'R' - restart level.

Phone/tablet: use touch.

name: Klondike: Classic Solitaire
description:
"Klondike: Classic Solitaire" is a classic card game where the goal is to sort the cards by suit in order from ace to king into four stacks. The game offers:

- Play without time or move limits, allowing you to enjoy the game at a relaxed pace.

- Customization options through the store. Change the table, card backs, and deck to create a unique style.

- Automatic game completion when all cards on the table are revealed.
instructions:
- Arrange cards from Ace to King into four piles in the top left corner. Each pile must be of a single suit.

- Aces are the lowest cards, and Kings are the highest. The piles start with Aces and end with Kings.

- Cards in columns are arranged in descending order, alternating colors — red and black. For example, a black 5 can be placed on a red 6.

description: Hey, the cute colored Boxes need your help to escape from this dark world! Your mission is to land the Boxes in the safe area with the least number of attempts. Each level presents unique challenges that will test your timing and precision. Can you navigate the perilous terrain and guide the Boxes to safety? Additionally, challenge yourself to earn three stars on each level by optimizing your moves and minimizing your attempts.
instructions: Just one click to play!

name: Nuts Bolts Screw jam
description: Welcome to Screw Out: Jam Puzzle Games, the ultimate nuts and bolts challenge! Dive into pins and wood nuts, where every twist and turn in puzzle games will test your skills and patience. Get ready for an exciting adventure filled with mind-bending puzzles that revolve around solving complex nuts and bolts problems.
instructions: click with mouse to unlock the screw

name: Diamond Mermaids
description: Welcome to the underwater kingdom! Glamorous and fashionable mermaids live there. Create a unique sparkling diamond look for these little mermaids. Choose a luxurious hairstyle for lush long mermaid hair, trendy tops and accessories. Immerse yourself in the magic of the underwater world!
instructions: Create your own bright and unique mermaid doll. For this purpose, the following tools are offered to you: numerous makeup settings; a rich selection of unusual hairstyles; bright outfits and accessories. Save the resulting result as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used for control.

name: Happy Monsters
description:
The collection of fun games is designed for children of any age and will not leave anyone indifferent.
The kitten brothers play different games in which you need to collect fruits. Help them collect as much as possible to earn postcards with animals. Collect the whole collection of postcards!
instructions:
1) Flying - tap on the screen or click the mouse to fly up, collect fruits and dodge kites.
The bonus for advertising is a helmet that will protect you from one blow.

2) Basket fishing - catch fruits and dodge bombs. Use the arrows or the AD to move or tap on the movement buttons.
Bonus for advertising - restore 1 health.

3) Find a pair - find 2 identical ones, and then tap on the fruits to get them.
The bonus for advertising is to look at all the cards for 2 seconds.

4) High jumps - jump on platforms, collect fruits.
The bonus for advertising is an additional propeller helmet.

5) Assemble the puzzle - choose the difficulty according to the number of puzzle pieces.
The bonus for advertising is to view the full picture for 2 seconds.

6) Fruit miner - collect fruits by hooking them with a hook. Bombs will take away the fruits.
The bonus for advertising is to add 20 seconds of round time.

7) Skater - collect fruits, jump over rocks and dodge birds.

name: Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator
description:
Want to relax? Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator is created for you, the craziest ragdoll simulation game! In this stress-relieving game, you need to break as many bones as possible on your ragdoll doll by falling from tall buildings and points across a variety of levels. Break bones, get game points, improve and edit your ragdoll doll!

Game Features:

- Stress-relief: Push your ragdoll dummy off towering buildings for maximum damage!
- Ultra Destroy: Realistic ragdoll impact physics!
- Totally immersive: Feel every bone of your character with audio and modern graphics
- Strategic gameplay: Test your strategic thinking as you navigate complex levels and devise creative solutions to overcome obstacles and earn more coins.
- Customize your experience: Unlock new levels and skins to personalize your ragdoll.

Are you prepared for the ultimate destroy experience? Let the dummy fall and witness bone-breaking action like never before!
instructions:
Click on the screen to throw a ragdoll.
Upgrade your ragdoll power, fly and money bonus to fly further and open new levels.

name: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 70 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to play this game.

name: Ghost Miner
description: Are you ready for the adventure of the cute, timid ghost who escaped from the mine and is now roaming the city in a mine cart? You need to be very careful! Help the friendly ghost collect all the pumpkins and reach the finish line to escape the city. There are many dangerous events happening in the city. Watch out for trash cans and buses—don’t crash into them!
instructions:
*Press the "WASD" keys or the "Arrow keys" to move. 
*Mobile gameplay is available. 
*Double jumping is possible. 
*4 different costumes can be found in the market. 
*Collect all the pumpkins.

name: Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments
description: Welcome to a small humorous adventure in which you will try on the role of a stylist for the most mysterious lady of all time - Mona Lisa Gioconda. Connect the past and the present by mocking trends and memes. Just imagine how Mona Lisa, with glasses on her nose, grimaces, trying on the outfit of a comic book superheroine. Or how she puts on a chic retro-style dress inspired by love movies with a flirtatious grin! Each of your changes is a small work of art, and each outfit immediately causes fireworks of pleasant emotions. There is no framework here - only freedom of expression. And the variety of images is guaranteed to make your time in the game unforgettable!
instructions: Show your imagination and creativity in fashionable experiments with the iconic masterpiece of world painting. Choose makeup, outfits and accessories for Mona Lisa to achieve the main goal - your good mood! Interesting images of the main character can be saved as PNG images. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it.

name: Adventure of Kittens
description:
Cute cats ???? go on a journey through a forest full of dangers and invite you to join them.
28 levels await you, during which you will have to help the furry couple overcome various obstacles by solving simple puzzles.
instructions: To complete the level you need to find a way to get to the exit unharmed and, of course, collect all the fish. You can play alone, alternately controlling both characters, or together with another player.

name: Bunny Boy online
description: Bunny Boy Online is an action-packed online shooter where you can challenge players from around the world or enjoy matches with friends. Step into the fast-paced world of Bunny Boy, where you’ll have access to a variety of weapons and maps to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. Select from multiple game modes, each offering unique objectives and challenges that push your skills to the limit. With smooth, dynamic mechanics and intense combat scenarios, Bunny Boy Online is the ultimate competitive playground. Climb the ranks, prove yourself in every match, and aim to become the best of all!
instructions:
Run on W , A, S, D
View the account Tab
Open a chat Enter
Menu F4
Change weapons E
shoot with the left mouse button.
Aim and rotate the mouse.
Jump is a space bar.
Interaction F

name: Cube Master
description: Dive into the world of Cube Master, the ultimate cube-matching adventure! Match, blast, and conquer your way through challenging levels filled with vibrant cubes and exciting power-ups. Cube Master brings you hours of engaging gameplay, where your puzzle skills will be put to the test with each new level!Get ready to swipe, match, and blast in Cube Master! Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages, this game promises endless fun and excitement. Are you ready to become the ultimate Cube Master? Download now and start matching!
instructions:
Desktop : Tap the left button of the mouse to match cubes of the same color to complete objectives and earn high scores.
 
Mobile: Tap the screen to match cubes of the same color to complete objectives and earn high scores.

name: Witchs House Halloween Puzzles
description: Halloween is a time of magic and miracles. Let's take a walk around the neighborhood and find out where witches and witches live. For the holiday, they decorated their houses with pumpkins and magical ornaments. Some of the witches keep owls and bats at home, while others brew potions. Well, we collected all these festive pictures and made puzzles out of them. Collect festive puzzles for Halloween - visit the inhabitants of the magical world of fairy tales and legends!
instructions: You can challenge your friends and collect puzzles for speed. Each puzzle has its own timer. And at the end of the game you will receive a beautiful certificate, which will indicate the total time for which you have collected all the puzzles in the game. Go ahead!

name: Monster Sketch Drawing Game
description: Monster Sketch Drawing Game is a coloring game where you can fill out with dozens of different colors more than 50 drawings. You can save your artwork on your computer or smartphone and maybe upload them again to add some new features to your painting. You can choose between more than 50 weird creatures! If you want you can choose an empty canvas too and start a drawing of your own!
instructions: Touch or click to draw / paint

name: Market life
description:
Dive into the exciting world of store management, where your adventure begins with a cozy but modest space! Your task is to transform it into a thriving supermarket, where every corner will work for success. Organize cash registers, arrange shelves and order food trucks to satisfy the needs of your customers.

With each decision you make, you will expand the space, build new objects and increase the flow of customers. Upgrade your store to maximize throughput and profit! Keep a close eye on your staff - do not let contracts expire and keep the team in great shape.

Collect money from the cash register and invest it in upgrades and decor, so that your store not only functions, but also attracts the attention of customers. Save up funds to level up and unlock new exciting features and products!
instructions:
W,A,S,D, arrows, or hold finger on screen - move your character.
Step on the green build point to build shop object or expand shop area.
Move close to the shop object to see the upgrade\hire bottom menu, where you can manage available options of this object.
Trucks with products will arrive automatically (Deliver time could be upgraded via truck point's bottom menu)

name: Merge Dragons
description: Start by acquiring diverse dragons, each with unique traits. Nurture your collection, race your dragons on adrenaline-filled circuits, and earn coins to grow your empire. The real magic lies in the merging system—combine dragons to create even more powerful, higher-tier species, unlocking their true potential. Watch your dragons evolve, race, and bring home increasing riches as you strategize their composition.
instructions:
Collect Dragons: Use your earned coins to acquire new dragons with unique abilities.
Race Your Dragons: Form a team of your strongest dragons and race them on circuit tracks. Strategy is key—select your team based on their strengths.
Merge Dragons: Combine dragons of the same type to unlock higher-tier species, boosting their abilities and earning potential.
Earn Coins: Use your dragons to race and bring in coins, which you can invest in even more powerful dragons or upgrading your current collection.
Grow Your Empire: Continue merging, racing, and collecting until you've amassed the ultimate dragon fleet and treasure!

name: Obby Halloween Danger Skate
description: Obby is skateboarding on the rooftops and performing dangerous tricks. He wants to skateboard on the rooftops during Halloween. Help Obby reach the finish line safely. You must be very careful! Since it's Halloween, the city is flooded with toxic water, and if you fall from the building, you will die. Jump from barrels to containers and climb to the top of the building. Collect all the pumpkins along the way to earn money. Gather all the pumpkins and reach the finish line!
instructions:
*Use the 'WASD' keys to move.
*15 different levels with unique challenges.
*Collect all the pumpkins.
*You can buy 4 different costumes from the shop.

name: Spooky Tripeaks
description: It is a Halloween variation of Solitaire. You need to pass all 100 levels. Use jokers and other bonus cards to simplify the process. You can get the bonus cards by clicking on the ghosts and other spooky characters.
instructions: You have to draw cards one at a time from your stockpile. Select the cards that are higher or lower in value to your drawn card to remove it from the playing field. To complete a level you need to remove all the cards from the playing field without runnin

name: Alien Buster
description:
Alien Buster is an adrenaline-fueled shooting game that pits players against a relentless alien invasion in a quest to save Earth. Equipped with an arsenal of futuristic weapons, players face off against waves of powerful extraterrestrial enemies across a variety of intense levels and visually stunning landscapes.
Alien Buster is perfect for fans of space combat and shooter games, offering hours of thrilling gameplay. Do you have what it takes to defend Earth and become the ultimate alien-bursting hero? Download Alien Buster today and join the battle!
instructions:
Desktop: Use the on-screen directional buttons. Press the left  button on the mouse to move left side and press right button to move your character right. And tap anywhere on the screen to shoot aliens.  

Mobile: Use the on-screen directional buttons. Press the left on the screen to move left side and press right move your character right. And tap anywhere on the screen to shoot aliens.

name: Bubble Wheel Halloween
description: Play Bubble Wheel Halloween and get ready for spooky bubble-shooting fun! Aim and shoot to match Halloween-themed bubbles on a rotating wheel. Line up groups of 3 or more to collect them all and clear the board. With each spin, new bubbles appear, adding excitement to every shot!
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to aim and shoot bubbles onto the rotating Halloween wheel. Match 3 or more identical bubbles to clear them. Clear the board before new bubbles fill it

name: Football League
description: Step into the thrill of the Football League, where strategy meets excitement in the world's most popular sport! Challenge yourself in a competitive football environment that simulates real-life football action with smooth controls, realistic physics, and immersive gameplay. Create your dream team, go head-to-head with skilled opponents, and score your way to victory. Each match brings new challenges, from quick goal opportunities to defensive plays that keep you on your toes. Perfect your skills and lead your team to the top of the league!
instructions:
Desktop:
Tap the right buttons of the mouse to throw the ball to other player.
Mobile:
Tap the screen to throw the ball to other player.

name: Hexa Dots
description:
Match colorful dots in this addictive hexagonal puzzle game. Challenge your mind with Hexa Dots!
Dive into the vibrant world of Hexa Dots: Color Match Puzzle, the ultimate color-matching challenge designed to test your brain and keep you entertained for hours! Arrange and match colorful hexagonal dots to solve intricate puzzles and unlock new levels. With smooth gameplay, stunning graphics, and hundreds of levels, Hexa Dots is the perfect game to sharpen your strategic skills and unwind.
instructions:
Mobile Controls
Tap to Rotate: Touch anywhere on the screen to make the dots rotate around the central point and match the dots.

Desktop Controls
Click to Rotate: Click anywhere on the screen to make the dots rotate around the central point and match the dots.

name: Ghost Happy Halloween
description: If you want to witness the cute ghosts stealing pumpkins, join your friend in this two-player game and steal pumpkins from each other. You need to compete with your friend during Halloween. The player who has the pumpkin when time runs out wins. You can also collect candies to earn money. Gather your money and buy hats from the market!
instructions:
*Use the 'WASD' keys and the 'Arrow Keys' to move. 
*Playable on both mobile and PC. 
*At the end of 60 seconds, the player who has the pumpkin wins. You can buy 4 different hats from the market.

name: Pumpking vs Mummy
description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the mummy and the pumpkin king on Halloween? Yes, someone has to win on Halloween! Team up with a friend and choose to be either the mummy or the pumpkin king. Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn money by eating candies, and by gathering all the pumpkins, you can win the game. Catch the balloons and take them to the treasure chest. The one who collects and brings them back the fastest wins. As you win, different Halloween hats await you. So, gather your friends, race, and collect all the pumpkins!
instructions:
*Use the 'WASD' keys and the 'Arrow Keys' to move. 
*Playable on both mobile and PC. 
*Four different hats available in the shop. 
*The player who collects 10 pumpkins the fastest wins.

name: Frozen Choco Quest
description: Frozen Choco Quest is a winter-themed puzzle adventure where players guide a chocolate candy character through icy levels by matching 2, 3, or more identical candy blocks. Without the need for sliding, players simply tap to match candies, strategically clearing the board to achieve objectives and unlock new levels. The game includes special power boosters like the Axe to smash individual blocks, Vertical and Horizontal tools to clear rows and columns, and the Change booster to replace candies, adding layers of fun and strategy. With its cozy, frosty design and intuitive gameplay, Frozen Choco Quest provides a delightful and challenging experience for puzzle lovers.
instructions: In Frozen Choco Quest, tap on groups of 2 or more matching candies to clear them from the board and reach your level goals. Use power boosters like the Axe to break single blocks, Vertical and Horizontal tools to clear entire rows or columns, and the Change tool to swap candies for better matches. Complete each level within the set moves to progress and unlock new, frosty challenges!

name: Pirates Mahjong
description: Set sail with Pirates Mahjong, a deluxe tile-matching game packed with pirate-themed puzzles. Match pairs of tiles adorned with pirate symbols to clear the board, uncover hidden treasures, and solve challenging levels. Ideal for puzzle fans and pirate enthusiasts alike, this top-rated game offers endless high-seas adventure. Play Pirates Mahjong on lofgames.com.
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to click on matching pairs of pirate-themed tiles to clear them from the board.

name: Spot The Unique Halloween
description: Test your observation skills in Spot the Unique Halloween! Look through spooky characters like ghosts, witches, and vampires to find the one that is different. Each level gets harder with more portraits to search. Can you find the unique one? A fun Halloween game for all ages!
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to play this game.

name: Trick Or Spot
description: Trick or Spot is a Halloween-themed spot-the-difference game where players must find the subtle differences between two spooky images. Challenge your observation skills as you explore haunted scenes filled with ghosts, pumpkins, and eerie details. Spot all the differences before time runs out in this fun and festive puzzle adventure! Suitable for all ages.
instructions:
Mouse or Touchpad: Click or tap directly on the differences between the two images.
Hint Button: If you get stuck, click or tap the hint button for help.
Timer: Keep an eye on the timer! Find all the differences before it runs out to complete the level.

name: Juicy Match
description: Juicy Match is a vibrant and engaging match-3 puzzle game where players match colorful fruits and candies to clear levels. The game follows the familiar mechanics of the match-3 genre, where players swap adjacent items to create matches of three or more identical items, which then disappear, allowing new items to fall into place. The game is designed to challenge players with increasingly complex levels and various objectives, such as clearing specific tiles, collecting particular items, or reaching a certain score within a limited number of moves.
instructions:
How to Play:

Swap Pieces: Use your finger or mouse to swap two adjacent pieces. The pieces will only swap if they create a match of three or more.
Make Matches: Line up 3 or more identical pieces to make them disappear. Matching more than 3 in a row creates special power-ups.

name: Cute cat's adventures
description: An adventure game for girls about a cat, with whom you have to go in search of kittens. Colorful levels await you, filled with traps, obstacles and secrets, as well as dangerous enemies who will try to prevent you from completing your main goal.
instructions: The goal of the game is to go through all the levels, find 3 kittens on each of them and collect all the coins.

name: Candy Cascade
description: Click on groups of two or more candies to destroy them. You need to collect certain amount of different sweets on every level.  Wooden blocks, honey and jam should be cleared from the game field. If there is a key on the game field it should be dropped down. The moves are limited for each level. If you have hard time with a task you can use bonuses that can be received when you collect jam.
instructions: Destroy tiles by tapping on a group of them.

name: Horror Ban Ban 1-2 Player Parkour
description: The terrifying siblings need to escape the haunted house. They must face their fears and collect what they need to get away. Choose one of the two siblings and escape together. Each sibling has specific items to gather, and you’ll need to find the red and blue remotes to unlock the door. Be very careful—there are thorns and sharp knives everywhere in this frightening house. Make sure to reach the door safely!
instructions:
*Use WASD Keys to move and jump.
*Collect the Bowling Toy first and then the remote control Toy in order. 
*Both mobile and desktop playability.

name: Jump and Fly
description: Join the adventure in Jump and Fly, where youll guide an energetic squirrel and a cheerful bee through a vibrant and whimsical forest! Jump from platform to platform, collect coins, and grab power-ups to boost your abilities in this action-packed game. Embark on a magical journey and help our adorable characters reach new heights. Whether you’re a seasoned gamer or new to mobile gaming, Jump and Fly offers endless fun and excitement.
instructions:
Desktop: Press the Spacebar to make the squirrel and bee jump from platform to platform. Use the Arrow Button to move left and right.
Mobile: Tap the screen to make the squirrel and bee jump from platform to platform.

name: Cute Sheep SkyBlock
description: Two cute sheep must jump from island to island in the sky to escape from the farmers and reach the portal. They need to work together as a team to overcome obstacles. You must help them. Be careful of the obstacles that fall from the ground and sky. The farmers are looking for you, and they want to catch you, so jump over them to escape. If the path is clear, eat all the hay you find. Gather all the hay and safely reach the portal.
instructions:
*Move using the "WASD" keys and "Arrow Keys." 
*You can jump twice in a row. 
*Safely guide both sheep to the portal. 
*Playable on both mobile and PC.

name: Halloween Merge Mania
description: Fun Halloween merge game with creepy monsters to merge. Combine eerie Halloween characters to create even spookier creatures. Merge pumpkins, bats and more to unlock higher-level characters like Frankenstein and Jack Skellington. The more you merge, the bigger and scarier your creations become! Can you master the merge and unlock the ultimate Halloween monster?
instructions:
Use the mouse or touch to drop the monsters. Combine like monsters to create the next bigger, badder monster.  See if you can create the Scream Ghost Face monster which is the final monster to beat!

Use the Monster Map Wheel at the top left side of the game to see which monster is created when two monsters merge.  You can click on the Monster Map Wheel to get a better view of the monster heirarchy. The next monster up is shown in the Next box located at the top right side of the screen.  Use this information to help you make strategic drops.

name: NoobHood HalloweenCraft
description: Noobhood is actually a folk hero. Of course, that's how he is in our game too. He has one main goal: to dress in a Halloween costume, prepare his horse for Halloween, and collect all the Halloween coins. Gather all the Halloween coins. You must be very careful; surviving in this dark and scary forest is truly difficult. There are pumpkin monsters in this forest, and you must defeat them with your sword. Throw your sword at the monsters to defeat them all.
instructions:
*Move with the "WASD" keys.
*Double jumping is available in the game.
*Can be controlled from both mobile and PC.
*Press the "P" key to throw the sword and defeat monsters.
*Press the "P" key to throw the sword and break doors.

name: Hexa Tile Master
description: Welcome to Hexa Tile Master! Drag stacks of hex tiles from the bottom of your screen to empty spots on the board. Watch as similar tiles merge into bigger stacks, and collect stacks of 10 or more matching tiles to clear them. Your goal is to clear all the hex tiles before time runs out. Each level gets more challenging, but don't worry—fun animations and exciting rewards will keep you engaged. Enjoy the strategic fun and see how far you can go!
instructions: You can move stacks using touch or mouse.

name: Haunted Puzzle Pieces
description: Haunted Puzzle Pieces is a spooky jigsaw game with two challenging modes: 16 pieces and 32 pieces. Assemble eerie images piece by piece and enjoy a hauntingly fun puzzle experience. Can you complete the puzzles before the ghosts catch up?
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to drag and drop the puzzle pieces into place. Complete the image by fitting all pieces together. Choose between 16 or 32 pieces for your challenge.

name: Halloween Merge Promax
description: Drop Halloween-themed balls like wizards, pumpkins, and more! Merge matching balls to create bigger ones in this endless puzzle. Don’t let the board fill up! Plan your moves, merge balls, and keep the fun going!
instructions: Tap to drop Halloween-themed balls from above. Merge identical balls to create new combos and score points. Utilize the 'Remove Smallest Item' button to clear tiny ball instances from the stage. Embark on an unstoppable fun travel!

name: Loop Survivors Zombie City
description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fight zombies and mutants, upgrade your city and character, collect weapons and armor. Build your shelter, unlock random perks, and become the ultimate survivor!
instructions: Control a hero who navigates through cyclic locations, battling waves of zombies and mutants. Collect weapons, armor, and choose random perks to strengthen your character. After each cycle, you can build and upgrade your city, as well as improve your shelter and hero. Every run makes you stronger and brings you closer to victory!

name: Color Maze
description: In Color Maze your mission is to light up all the paths on the map to complete a level. Make the right move, avoiding obstacles or just pay attention to not get stuck in a corner. Beat all the 20 levels with increasing difficulty to show yourself that you are the real king of Color Maze. Remember, if a level is to hard for you, you can always skip it clicking or touching the reward button in the up right corner of the screen.
instructions: WASD or ARROWS  To Move

name: Star Exiles
description: Embark on an incredible adventure where the future of humanity is on the brink of an abyss. The earth has turned into a devastated desert after a terrible natural disaster. The only salvation for humanity is the colonization of other planets. Take part in a large-scale space expedition. You have to become one of the brave settler colonists, board a spaceship and fight the alien threat. Go to uncharted planets, look for resources for survival, create new settlements and protect them from enemies.
instructions:
Controls in battle:
on a computer: use the mouse to control the direction of the ship's movement.
on phone: touch and swipe the screen in the direction you want to move your spaceship. Shooting is carried out automatically when you touch the screen.
During the battle on the planet, be sure to destroy hotbeds of infection. Collect crystals and DNA to buy new spaceships.

name: Little Commander. Red vs Blue
description: Build and develop your camp! Upgrade your army. Reds versus Blues! Command squads, build tanks and vehicles! Lead a crowd of soldiers! Lead them into battle! Attack and defend! You are the leader, the little commander! Get on the tank and into the battle
instructions:
Control:

For PC.
Character control - "WASD", "arrows" or hold the left mouse button and drag the mouse in the desired direction.
Shooting - the hero shoots automatically.

For Mobile devices.
Character control - press your finger on the screen and drag your finger in the desired direction.
Shooting - the hero shoots automatically.

name: Emoji Puzzle
description: Emoji Puzzle is an engaging skill game. Featuring levels constructed entirely with popular emojis. The game offers six distinct puzzle types: link puzzle, memory puzzle, word quiz, related puzzle, shadow puzzle, and crop puzzle. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Dino Survival: 3D Simulator
description: Survive in this prehistoric Jurassic park. Tame and grow dinosaurs, fight dinos, explore uncharted territories and incredible areas. Build your settlement. Sail to distant islands. Go to Raid! Conquer! Defeat raptors and the huge T-Rex!
instructions:
Improve your own shelter by collecting various resources. To obtain resources, go on trips using portals located in the shelter.

Improve your weapons using the Forge in the hideout.

To raise your own dinosaur, look for eggs in the forest.

Control:

For PC.
Character control - "WASD", Arrow keys or hold down the left mouse button and drag the mouse in the desired direction.
Attack - the hero attacks automatically.

For Mobile devices.
Character control - press your finger on the screen and drag your finger in the desired direction.
Attack - the hero attacks automatically.

name: Blondie Reload
description: Look who's back! This is the charming Blondie and her boyfriend Kerry. They are a great stylish couple. Just take a look at their wonderful outfits inspired by the fashion of the 80s. Charge yourself with the radiant energy of Blondie and Kerry, plunge into the world of high fashion with your lovers on the sunny coast and among the lights of the night city. Dance, have fun and roller-skate through the streets of the metropolis or along the promenade.
instructions: Look who's back! This is the charming Blondie and her boyfriend Kerry. They are a great stylish couple. Just take a look at their wonderful outfits inspired by the fashion of the 80s. Charge yourself with the radiant energy of Blondie and Kerry, plunge into the world of high fashion with your lovers on the sunny coast and among the lights of the night city. Dance, have fun and roller-skate through the streets of the metropolis or along the promenade.

name: Magic Blocks
description: The game has several game modes, classic and adventure. In the classic game you need to score as many points as possible, and in the adventure game you need to complete levels, collect multi-colored crystals, earn points, and complete other tasks.
instructions: To successfully complete levels, you need to drag blocks and form them into vertical and horizontal lines on the playing field, thus clearing it, earning points and obtaining crystals. The game ends if there is no free space left for pieces on the playing field.

name: Happy Save Puzzle
description:
Happy Save Puzzle - draw one line to save Stickman from the threat!

Are you a good artist or Do you want to test your creative skills?
Are you a fan of puzzles?

Now you have a good chance!

Draw a line to help the little man and protect him from swords, bullets, bombs.... and many other life-threatening attacks!
You are free to draw any cover and protection to help the little man survive.
Learn to draw lines creatively, develop logic and grow your brain!

GAME FEATURES
+ Lots of levels and endless fun!
+ Never be bored again!
+ Simple but amazing physics system!
+ Improve your brain!
+ Exciting and relaxing gameplay.
instructions:
+ Draw only one continuous line to complete the level task.

+ Make sure your line does not damage the Stickman you need to protect.

+ There can be more than one answer.
Draw any thing you want, as each one can be a solution to the challenge!

name: Princesses at Horror School
description: In this game, you will meet Laura and Frankie, two charming monsters who study at a school for young monsters. Every morning, the girls carefully think over their images, mixing elements of a classic princess and a creepy monster. Each of the girls has their own special fashion preferences, but when going to class, Laura and Frankie always attract the admiring glances of classmates. After all, they are not just princesses, but real monsters whose terrifying style makes even the bravest tremble!
instructions: Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it. The result can be saved as a PNG image.

name: Torn Pics Jigsaw Halloween
description: Torn Pics Jigsaw Halloween is a different flavor of classical jigsaw game. Arrange the jigsaw pieces of a picture to form the original picture. There are 2 modes in the games. Each mode has 24 levels. You must complete a level within time limits.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to play this game.

description:
Buddy Blocks Survival is an engaging online game suitable for both kids and adults. The game combines fun, strategy, and quick thinking, making it an entertaining challenge for all ages. Here’s a breakdown of the game:
Objective:

The primary goal is to get Buddy safely to the floor by eliminating the blocks beneath him. However, it’s not as easy as it sounds, as there are various obstacles to avoid.
Gameplay:

    Block Destruction: You need to strategically click on the blocks to destroy them, ensuring that Buddy lands safely on the ground.
    Obstacles: Throughout the game, you will encounter TNT and Lava boxes, which are hazardous to Buddy. Avoid these at all costs, as triggering them can cause you to lose the game.

Tips for Success:

    Plan your moves: Think ahead about which blocks to destroy first. Careless clicks can cause Buddy to fall into danger.
    Avoid the traps: Watch out for the TNT and Lava boxes. If you destroy a block near them without caution, you might trigger them and lose.
    Balance fun and strategy: While it’s tempting to rush, taking a moment to plan out your clicks will increase your chances of success.

Fun Factor:

The mix of colorful visuals, engaging mechanics, and progressively challenging levels ensures that Wright: Buddy Blocks Survival provides hours of entertainment. The game is easy to learn but can be tricky to master, keeping both kids and adults engaged.
