Explore hundreds of levels with different levels of difficulty.

Be as accurate as possible to free all the cats.

Buy and use boosters on challenging levels.

To win - clear the field of all the balloons.
instructions:
- Use the guide line to aim and explode the bubbles. Balls may ricochet off walls - take this into account when aiming.
- You will see the next color of balloon in the cart. Use this in your strategy.
- Don't forget about the shot counter!

name: Asoka Makeup Indian Bride
description: Immerse yourself in the colorful world of the Indian wedding tradition with Princesses Jacqueline and Eliza! Help them create the perfect wedding look with the help of various cosmetics and accessories. Choose a wedding outfit; decorate your hair with traditional accessories and create a festive makeup for the bride. Use bright shadows, radiant blush and long-lasting lipstick to make the princesses look dazzling. Do not forget about the traditional jewelry: nath, earrings and necklace. Complete the image of an Indian bride and help the princesses become the most beautiful on the holiday!
instructions: Help two girlfriends create their own unusual version of the traditional Indian bride's outfit: apply wedding makeup; choose one of the festive hairstyles; complement the image of the bride with oriental jewelry. And, after all this pleasant fuss, welcome to the wedding photo shoot! The resulting fashionable images can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it.

name: Real Racing 3D
description: Immerse yourself in exciting racing! Play classic cars - step on the gas and win! Win championships and unlock new cars!
instructions:
Controls:
W, A, S, D - driving
N - camera change
Space - drift
X - return
P - pause, exit

name: Tile Farm Story
description: The Stone sisters never tire and they are ready to take on any farm and nature reserve that needs their help, wherever it may be. Visit Africa, China, South America and the North Pole — unforgettable adventures and new encounters await you everywhere! Every time you play, the game will surprise you with a new puzzle, a colorful location or a new turn in the story. Olivia and Britney are so different that their differences sometimes seem insurmountable, which is why they need so much of your help to finish off their building efforts!
instructions: All you need is to find identical tiles on the field and collect them. Clear the field to the end, and you win!

name: Brazil Coloring Adventure
description:
Brazil Coloring Adventure is an exciting and vibrant coloring game that offers endless fun for both kids and adults! Immerse yourself in the rich culture and breathtaking scenery of Brazil as you color your way through beautifully designed images inspired by the country’s iconic landscapes, wildlife, and traditions. Whether you're a young artist or just looking for a relaxing, creative experience, this game provides the perfect balance of fun and creativity.

With an easy-to-use interface, you can play it online for free and unleash your imagination. Get ready to bring Brazil to life with your own colors—enjoy endless hours of artistic exploration!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Kawaii Elf Dress Up Game
description:
Step into a magical world with Kawaii Elf Dress Up Game, where you can unleash your creativity and design stunning anime-style elf avatars! Inspired by famous elf characters from games like Legend of Zelda and the anime Frieren, this kawaii game allows you to craft your perfect elven character, whether she’s a graceful princess or a fierce elven warrior. Perfect for fans of anime dress-up games, kawaii games, and avatar makers, this game is a must-play for girls who love fantasy and style.

Art by Tizy Izumy
Game by Kawaii Games
instructions: Click on the categories and then choose the item. Choose the item's colors using the brush icon.

name: Heaven Challenge - 2 Player
description: In this adventure, you need to collect the red and yellow keys to find out if its heaven or hell. You must be very careful as there are obstacles everywhere. Both the obby and noob must be extremely cautious, or you might die. Collect the yellow and red keys without dying and get back to the door before time runs out. You need to be quick. Dont forget, you must go everywhere together. If you get separated, youll get lost on the camera.
instructions: *Use the WASD keys and Arrow keys to move. *Collect the yellow and red keys. *Reach the door before time runs out.

name: Zombie Counter Craft
description: ZOMBIE COUNTER CRAFT is an action-packed survival game where your primary goal is to defeat hordes of zombies and endure for as long as possible. When your ammunition runs out, scavenge the surroundings for scattered ammo to stay in the fight. Prepare yourself—it's time to face the zombie apocalypse!
instructions: Use WASD to move and left mouse click to shoot.

name: Landmine Cube
description: In this puzzle game, you play as a rolling cube tasked with collecting all the jewels in each level while avoiding deadly landmines scattered throughout the floor. If you step on a mine, you'll lose a life, and if you run out, you'll have to restart the level from scratch. Thankfully, the cube has a warning system that lets you know when a landmine is nearby, glowing brightly to alert you to potential danger. With 21 levels to conquer, can you successfully navigate the treacherous terrain and collect all the jewels?
instructions: WASD or ARROWS to move the player

name: Escape Noob
description: In this adventure, the noob is escaping from his own clone. The clone is a very evil character and wants to kill the real noob. He has tamed a bear and is trying to have the bear kill the noob. You must avoid the clone and the bear, collecting all the gold along the way. Remember to get the key. Once you have the key, use it to lower the iron bars at the finish line. Lowering the iron bars will prevent the bear and the evil noob from attacking you, and youll be able to escape as you wish. Don’t look back—just keep running and escaping.
instructions:
*Use the WASD keys to move. 
*Collect the gold key and make sure not to look back. 
*Gather all the coins. 
*Activate the iron bars at the end of the level.

name: Mahjong Solitaire Unlimited
description: Classic mahjong solitaire puzzle game with dragons! Let yourself relax in this mahjong solitaire game with endlessly generated levels of varying difficulty. You don't have to limit yourself to time or choose a timed game if you like a challenge! Customize the look of the puzzle to your liking or choose a child-friendly tile look for your child's educational game! Collect achievements with dragons and compete with other players! Follow the path of the dragon! How far can you go?
instructions:
Select two identical tiles to remove them from the playing field.
You can only select tiles that are free on the left or right and are not closed at the top.
Each tile appears on the playing field four times.
Your task is to remove all tiles from the playing field.

name: Stickman Hook
description:
Discover Stickman Hook, the new MadBox game.

Tap to hook and make incredible jumps; Avoid every obstacle that stands in your way. Can you execute all these acrobatic tricks in a row like a boss? Will you be the first survivor to cross the finish line?

In this game, embody the spider stickman.
Finish all the levels with the same agility as a spider.
instructions:
- Tap to hook and make incredible jumps
- Press your screen to hook your stickman with your grapnel and release to let go
- Avoid every obstacle that stands in your way
- Swing from hook to hook to pass all the levels

name: Hit Archery Masters: Bow Fighting
description: In front of you is the addictive game "Hit Archery Masters: Bow Fighting". In it you will have to fight with rivals to raise your authority and get a new rank, as well as earn coins and buy clothes, becoming a cool and real kid in the neighbourhood.
instructions:
Each round, 3 random weapons drop down. Choose one of them, then tap on the screen and pull to the side to choose the trajectory and strength of the throw. When attacking an enemy, aim for the head to do maximum damage. The stronger the throw and more accurate the hit, the greater the damage.

Different weapons have different flight speeds, masses, and gravity, so take this into account when throwing. For example, a bowling ball can do the most damage, but it's much harder to hit.

Some weapons also have bonus damage. For example, a grenade, in addition to hitting, then explodes, and a Molotov cocktail sets everything on fire.

name: Screws Master
description: Screw Master is a logic game based on puzzles made of metal strips screwed to a base. To solve them, you need to unscrew all the screws holding the metal strips in the correct sequence, using free holes and special devices.
instructions: To solve the puzzle, you need to unscrew all the screws holding the metal strips in the correct sequence, using the free holes and special devices.

name: Jelly-Belly. Make the Elephant
description: It is a puzzle like "Watermelon game" where you need drop animals in a container and try not to cross the top line. Animals of the same type will combine and create a larger animal. Merge the animals to create the biggest animal - Elephant.
instructions:
Connect same animals with your finger or mouse to get new ones!

Keyboard arrows to move new animal
Spacebar or down arrow to drop the animal

Game will over when animal crossed the top line.

name: NoobCraft Totem
description: In this adventure, the noob needs to collect all the immortality totems. Gather all the immortality totems and reach the portal at the end of the level. You must reach the portal because a challenging adventure awaits you. Unfortunately, it’s a cold winter day, and the noob must avoid and escape from dangerous creatures in the forest. You need to evade snowmen and polar bears. You can defeat them by throwing your sword. Dont forget to collect the gold in the forest. Gather the gold and totems, activate the portal, and pass through it.
instructions:
Use the Arrow keys to move.
Collect all the totems and gold.
Defeat all the monsters and animals in the forest.
Reach the portal safely.

name: Stickman: Dinosaur arena
description: Take command of a squad of dinosaurs and go into battle with them! Reinforce your squad, unlock new dinosaurs and upgrade existing ones. Go as far as possible and become a great Dino Commander!
instructions:
Unlock new dinosaurs and strengthen your squad. Kill all the enemies in the level to move on to the next one.

Control your character with WASD on PC and with the joystick on your phone.

name: Cut For Cat Challenge 2
description: The  cat who loves lollipops has become popular in the gaming space, which means that the continuation of his adventures should have appeared. Meet the game Cut For Cat Challenge 2, where at each level the cat will patiently wait until you drop him a round colored candy disc. To do this, you need to cut the rope on which the candy dangles. But first, think about which side to do this and take into account the items that are on the playing field, they must be used to achieve the goal. The candy is not always directly above the cat, so it needs to be moved somehow. Think and act in Cut For Cat Challenge 2.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Cut For Cat Challenge
description: Quite a few little kittens are very fond of sweets. Today, in the new exciting game Cut For Cat Challenge, we want to invite you to feed some of these kittens with delicious sweets. A playing field will appear on the screen in front of you, at the bottom of which a kitten will sit. Above it, at a certain height, you will see a candy hanging on a rope. It will swing in space like a pendulum. You will have to guess a certain moment and cut the rope with scissors. If you calculated everything correctly, then the candy will fall into the paws of the kitten and he will eat it. You will receive points for this and go to the next level of the game.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Noob Chicken Hunter
description: Noob is trying to collect all the chickens. The chicken hunter noob must gather all the chickens found wandering in the forest. Collect all the chickens and coins and escape from the forest as soon as possible. The forest is very dangerous and filled with challenging obstacles. You need to survive. Stay alive and catch all the chickens. Be careful, as there are monsters in the forest, and they might eat the chickens. Avoid the monsters and catch all the chickens.
instructions:
*You can move by pressing the WASD keys. 
*Collect all the gold. Catch all the chickens.
*Complete all the tasks safely and move on to the next level.

name: Funny Face Quest
description: Funny Face Quest is a hilarious facial distortion game featuring famous celebrities! Get ready to crank up the fun-o-meter as you choose an image and let your creativity run wild. Make the faces as funny as possible, then share your masterpiece with friends! Every minute you spend playing earns you 100 shiny coins, which you can use to unlock even more images to play with. Get ready for some giggles and enjoy this funny game online for free!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Noob vs Pro Super Hero
description: In this adventure, Noob is now very strong; Noob is saving Pro. Pro got injured in the forest and needs Noob to get home. If Noob can find the Superpower Totem, he can rescue both of them from the forest. With the Superpower Totem, he can jump very far or run very fast. Use all the superpowers to reach the portal and get through the doors to reach the portal.
instructions:
*Use the Arrow Keys to move the Pro.
*Use the WASD to move the Noob.
*both mobile and desktop playability.

name: Police Obby Prison Save
description: In this adventure, youre disguised as a police officer and rescuing your friends from prison. Find all your friends and launch them into the helicopter. You need to save your friends from prison. Make sure your friends get into the helicopter and then escape from the guards. You need to escape from the prison. To escape, you must reach the car and get in it.
instructions: *Use the WASD keys to move. *Rescue 3 of your friends and collect all the iron bars. *Safely reach the car at the end of the level.

name: Burst the colorful balloons
description:
Collect three or more combinations of identical balls to make them disappear. The more same-colored combinations you collect, the more points you'll earn! Once you reach your goal, you'll have a chance to get some well-deserved bonuses!
Boldly go ahead, to the game!
instructions: To pass the level, you need to produce the specified number of explosions. To do this, click on the ball with which at least two balls of the same color are in contact.

name: PixelCraft Animal School
description: In order to survive in this world, you must avoid dangerous animals. On a cold winter day, you need to reach the portal. You can either go alone or with a friend to collect gold in the snow-covered forest. Gather all the gold and reach the portal at the end of the level without dying. Collect the gold and buy different costumes for yourself. Bears, wolves, wild boars, and other terrifying animals will chase you, so dont stop—run without looking back.
instructions:
*Alex , Press WASD keys to move and jump.
*Steve , Press Arrow Keys keys to move and jump.
*Mobile Control Available

name: Rise Minions Maker
description: A minion is a devoted servant of his master. Since ancient times, minions have been looking for a ruler worthy of their service. Create your own minions and become their master! Choose hairstyles, clothes and accessories to your liking. Experiment with colors and accessories, you are only limited by your imagination. Which of the minions is worthy to take a place in your great corporation? You decide!
instructions: Create your own helper - minion. Save the resulting result as a PNG-image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screen is used for control.

name: Snowcraft - 2 Player
description: In the world of Snowcraft, it’s snowing and the temperature is dropping rapidly. Steve and Alex need to be very careful. They must reach the portal before they freeze. Steve can use his sword to defeat the snowman monsters. Defeat all the snowman monsters and reach the end of the level. The snowman monsters are very smart and are constantly wandering through the snowy forest. Use your sword to kill them. Collect all the coins. Gather all the coins and reach the portal.
instructions:
*Use the WASD keys to move. 
*Press the P key to attack with the sword and throw the sword. 
*Mobile controls are available for playing on mobile. 
*Double jump is active in the game. You can jump twice.

name: Minecraft Obby
description: Minecraft Obby is an amazing parkour game that you can play totally free! Do your best as you navigate through challenging obstacle courses, avoiding pitfalls and traps along the way. Collect coins scattered throughout each level to buy yourself a new sword and enhance your gameplay experience. With each jump and sprint, you'll improve your skills and push your limits. Dive into the blocky world of Minecraft Obby, avoid obstacles, collect those coins, and most importantly—have fun!
instructions: Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Space Bar or J to jump!

name: RedPool Legend - 2 Player
description: In this game, two siblings must do everything they can to survive their adventure full of surprises. The yellow and red siblings need to advance together. Since the red character is the leader, they must move together. Collect all the coins and reach the invisible door.
instructions:
*Move to WASD + Arrow Keys      
*Double Jump available      
*Mobile Touch Control

name: Grandfather Road Chase: Realistic Shooter Guns
description:
Shoot the enemies chasing you!
Break away from the chase, your AK47 will help you with this
Huge selection of realistic weapons
AK47, Minigun, Crossbow, Machine gun, Uzi
Destroy motorcycles, ATVs, racing cars, helicopters
Realistic graphics like Stalker

Your goal is to break away from the chase. But bad luck, you have a rather weak car.
No problem! But you have plenty of weapons =)!

Use a huge arsenal of weapons to stop the chase.
AK47, Minigun, Crossbow, Stationary gun, Machine gun, Flamethrower...

Shoot car parts, wheels, body parts. Hand out headshots, do combos! Shoot weapons, machine guns, stationary guns. Do everything to stop the chase.

The game has a huge selection of weapons, and there will be even more!

Do not rush to relax, the enemy is not asleep. And their attacking arsenal is varied.
Motorcycles, ATVs, racing cars, drones, jeeps, helicopters...
But you can handle it ;)

Complete over 50 unique levels
Unlock all locations and all types of weapons.
Defeat all bosses!
Realistic weapons and cars!

This is your road madness!
instructions:
The task of each level is to break away from the pursuit, or rather to destroy all the pursuers!

Control:
Shoot: left mouse button
Aim control: by moving the mouse
Switch weapons: 1, 2, 3, 4
Reload - R

Push the screen on mobile

name: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
description: Welcome to the game in which every new tide carries a new wave of style! Help two girlfriends to celebrate the new beach season with dignity. Each of the girls has her own unique sense of fashion and style. Combine swimsuits with a variety of accessories to create unique summer looks. And don't forget to pick up a surfboard or a sapboard. Get ready for adventures on the water and to become the most stylish on the whole coast!
instructions: In this dress up game you will meet two young heroines who are preparing for a vacation on the beach and need your help to create fashionable images for the beach. In the game, you can change images as many times as you want, creating new combinations and experimenting with fashion. The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it.

name: Gladiator Fights
description: An action game based on battles with gladiators, where players can plunge into the world of ancient Rome and become real warriors. The game offers an exciting and dynamic gameplay where players have to go through many challenges and defeat a number of dangerous opponents.
instructions:
On mobile devices, the movement of a fighter is controlled by a joystick, attacks are activated by buttons.on the screen

On a PC, the movement is carried out using the arrows on the keyboard or the WASD keys.
Attacks are activated by mouse and keyboard buttons:
A simple attack is the left mouse button or the "Space" key.
Powerful attack - right mouse button or "Shift" key (any)
Long-range attack - right mouse button or "Shift" key (any)
Kick - clicking on the mouse wheel or the "Z" or "/" key

name: 2048 3D
description: A whole new take on the famous brain teaser number game 2048! Now in 3D with crazy fun physics! Cubes don't stay in place — they fall realistically and bounce off each other if you haven’t managed to merge cube number blocks!
instructions: Tap to release the cube and merge the same number blocks

name: Slider
description:
Slider is a puzzle game similar to the well-known Tetris.

The essence of the game is to move the appearing blocks of different lengths - so that one or more lines are filled with blocks.

When a horizontal row of 8 cells is filled, it disappears and everything above it falls by one cell.

When a line fills up, it "burns out" and new blocks appear in its place. The more lines you manage to complete, the more points you get.
instructions:
In the game "slider" you need to move the blocks in a horizontal plane. Blocks have different lengths and must fill the free space of the same length.
The block itself is moved either with a finger, if it is a mobile phone screen, or with a mouse, if it is a computer.

name: Silicon Valley. Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to idle office tycoon game where you start as an idle startupper in an empty city with just one office. Your goal is to build a thriving business empire by upgrading offices and increasing income. Become the owner of large corporations!
instructions: Speed up the delivery people by clicking on their office or on the path they are walking along. To build a city, you need to upgrade your office. You earn money with the help of couriers, increase their number, buy new stores, pump up the income and speed of the deliverers so that corporations earn more money! As the office gets upgraded, it will grow and develop. Also buy other companies. If you catch the golden deliverer, you will receive a bonus. Also, do not miss the proposed accelerators that will help accelerate the development of your technological city. You can move the camera by swiping your finger across the screen or with the mouse. You can zoom in and out of the camera by swiping two fingers across the screen or using the mouse wheel.

name: Hidden Kitty
description: Hidden Kitty is an engaging and delightful hidden object game for kids, available for free! Step into a world of adventure as you help an old lady reunite with her beloved kitties, who are playfully hiding throughout the building. Embark on a Kitty-Finding Adventure now and have fun!
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Kamala Funny Face Challenge
description:
Kamala Funny Face Challenge is an entertaining and interactive online game designed especially for kids. Dive into the world of creativity and laughter as you transform the lovely Kamala’s face into the funniest expressions imaginable.
Make Silly Faces and Laugh Out Loud
Using simple controls, kids can drag the yellow dots around Kamala’s face to stretch, twist, and warp her features into all sorts of hilarious shapes. Will you make her eyes pop or give her the biggest grin? The possibilities are endless, and every combination brings a new giggle-inducing result.
instructions: Use mouse to play.

name: Little Yellowmen Jumping
description: In this adventure, you need to escape from the pink poison thats rising and trying to kill you. You can play alone or with a friend as you avoid the poison. Climb as high as you can and never look back. Keep jumping without looking behind and escape from the laboratory. If you don’t escape from the laboratory, you might drown in the pink poison.
instructions:
Use the WASD keys to move and jump in the game.
Use the Arrow Keys keys to move and jump in the game.
*Mobile Control Available

name: Skibidi toilet IO
description:
Skibidi toilets IO is an interesting arena game where you play as a skibidi toilet and push other skibidi toilets into the abyss. The game is similar to agar.io and slither.io, but about skibidi toilets and camera heads. You can play with a friend on one device and on one computer together!

Game features:
- Single player and two-player game on one phone or PC
- Skibidi toilets
- Fascinating simple and clear gameplay
instructions:
Drag the virtual joystick (for phones/tablets) or the mouse cursor (PC) in the direction you want your skibidi toilet to move, or use WASD to move (PC only)
Push enemies into holes to win!

name: Detective - Logic Puzzles
description:
Become a Detective! Solve logic puzzles to find the criminal! 
Lots of levels and interesting stories!

You will have to solve a lot of different cases, in this you will be helped by the method of deduction known to all detectives.
instructions:
1) Use the hints to put ticks or crosses on the field.

2) When the whole field is marked, the case is solved.

3) Play the extra mode to earn clues and unlock a new story!

name: Obby Papa Pizzas Escape
description: In this adventure, Obby and Bacon are doing everything they can to survive and escape from the pizza place. Help Obby and Bacon escape from the pizza place with your friend. Be careful, as Chef Papa Pizza is very angry and wants to catch you. Watch out for the pizza maker—if they catch you, you cant escape and youll lose. Be very careful, as there are obstacles everywhere and the pizza maker is very angry. Bacon can defeat the pizza maker with his sword by throwing it at the pizza maker at the right time. Obby and Bacon need to collect all the pizzas and reach the red door to escape from the pizza maker
instructions:
*You can move by pressing the WASD keys and Arrow Keys
*Playable on mobile. Mobile controls are available.
*Collect all the pizzas and reach the red door.
*Press the P key to throw the sword.

name: Luminara Multiplication
description: Switch between day and night to get MathPup to the bone on each level.  At the start of each level you'll need to answer the multiplication problem correctly before you can switch.
instructions:
Click the Instructions button on the main menu to see the detailed instructions. Note that you will have to click the down arrow key or button to switch between day and night and that you'll need to do that at the start of each level to bring up the multiplication problem.

Note that some dangers are not visible.  Be on the lookout for signposts indicating those types of dangers.

name: Funny kittens 2
description: A collection of 4 children's games of different genres in which you need to collect coins. For the collected coins, you can open a collection of toys. Collect the whole collection!
instructions:
1) Color rhythm - colorful balls are falling, play the right notes to hit the balls and get coins. 

2) Toy airplane - defeat enemies, dodge bullets, upgrade your airplane.

3) Save the Balloon - the kittens brothers are flying in a hot air balloon. Blocks are flying to the meeting, you need to take the blocks away from the ball.

4) Cannon - you need to dodge crystals and knock down points for them.

name: Sorting frogs
description: A game in the sorting genre, but in the form of sorting frogs, great graphics, very many levels, and a large variety of frogs. Several variations of levels. Pass levels, get achievements, unlock new kinds of frogs!
instructions:
Frogs scattered all over the logs, you need to collect 4 identical frogs on the same log. 

To do this, click or tap on the desired log to select the desired frogs, they will be highlighted. Next, click on another log on which you want to move the frog. 

If the conditions are met, the frog will jump to the new location. 

When 4 identical frogs gather on the log, they will run away and you will get a reward.

name: Block Puzzle Travel
description:
The goal of the game is to destroy as many blocks as possible. By doing so, you will earn points for completing the game perfectly.
By solving puzzles, you train your attention, thought processes and brain.
In this game you have to achieve the maximum result, and pass all levels.
instructions: Destroy diamond blocks, earn points, pass level after level until you pass the game completely. The more blocks destroyed in one turn, the more points the player gets.

name: Hard Rock Zombie Truck
description:
We ride on the roof of a truck, shoot, blow up and crush zombies!
This is a 2D shooter where you need to destroy crowds of zombies and monsters by shooting, crushing and exploding them. At the same time, it is necessary to save living people. We also upgrade our weapons and abilities! Lots of funny sounds, lots of blood (cartoonish!!!) and humor.
instructions: (WASD + mouse) or (Virtual joystick) A/D - drive slower/faster, S - grenade, W - air support, Spacebar - rocket engine, Mouse - shoot.

name: Galaxy Carnage
description: Battle in space with countless enemies and their bosses coming in waves. Lots of weapons, lots of lasers, lots of explosions and effects. Upgrade the starship to the most powerful machine for exterminating alien invaders.
instructions:
Controls: (WASD) - moving, LMB - shooting, SPACE - death ray, F - shield.
The ship is upgraded automatically.
For mobile devices: movement - swipe on the left side of the screen, shooting - swipe on the right side of the screen, virtual buttons on the screen.

name: Obby Barry Prison Run
description: In this adventure, you need to reach the finish line of the obby, board the helicopter, and escape from the prison. You must help Obby by collecting all the gasoline cans in the prison. Collect all the gasoline cans and reach the helicopter. Be very careful as the police officer is on duty. The police officer is looking for you everywhere, so avoid them and reach the helicopter
instructions:
*You can move by pressing the WASD keys.
*Collect three gasoline cans and reach the helicopter. 
*Be careful of obstacles and avoid the police officer.

name: Fall Boys 2D Parkour
description: In this adventure, you must complete the course to survive. Complete the entire course with your friend. The course may be challenging and filled with obstacles. This does not mean you cannot complete the course. As men, carefully navigate through the entire course. Obstacles are present throughout the course. Be cautious and finish the course. Reach the finish line. The royal crown awaits you. The crown at the end of the chapter is waiting for you.
instructions:
*You can move by pressing the WASD keys.
*Collect all the gold and reach the royal crown at the end of the level.
*Complete the level safely with your friend.

name: Water sort - color sort puzzle
description:
Immerse yourself in the world of "Color Sort: Kitchen Chaos", where logic and speed are your allies! This game is reminiscent of popular puzzles where you sort various liquids by color, but it stands out with its unique culinary theme. Help our chef restore order by sorting sauces by color.

This game is for everyone who loves logical challenges and competition. It features three levels of difficulty and a unique "Challenge" mode for competitive spirits. Stunning visual effects and diverse sauces make the game interesting and engaging.

Super sauces add time, while sticky sauces take time away.

Key features:

- Unique culinary theme
- Three levels of difficulty
- "Challenge" mode with leaderboard
- Stunning visual effects

Become a sorting master and show everyone what you're capable of in "Color Sort: Kitchen Chaos"!
instructions:
You touch the screen to select a test tube from which you want to pour the sauce, then touch another test tube to pour the sauce into it. Sort the sauces by color so that each test tube contains only one color.

Your goal is to help the chef restore order in the kitchen by sorting sauces by color into different test tubes. To win, you need to sort all the sauces within the allotted time.

The game features special sauces: super sauces that add 10 seconds to your time and sticky sauces that take 2 and 4 seconds to pour, costing you time. Each successful pour is accompanied by bright visual effects.

The game offers three levels of difficulty, each becoming more challenging with an increasing number of test tubes and decreasing time for sorting. In the unique "Challenge" mode, you compete with other players, trying to sort as many test tubes as possible and climb the leaderboard.

"Fire Jump 2D" is a heart-pounding action-adventure game that challenges players to navigate through a treacherous landscape engulfed in flames. Set against a backdrop of blazing infernos and perilous obstacles, players must harness their agility and reflexes to leap their way to safety amidst the raging flames.

As players progress through the game, they'll encounter a variety of environments, each more perilous than the last. From towering infernos to crumbling ruins, every level offers a unique set of obstacles and challenges to overcome.

"Fire Jump 2D" also features vibrant graphics and immersive sound design, drawing players deeper into its fiery world with every leap and bound. With each level offering new twists and surprises, players will find themselves on the edge of their seats as they race against the clock to escape the flames and emerge victorious.

With its addictive gameplay, captivating visuals, and pulse-pounding action, "Fire Jump 2D" promises to ignite the thrill-seeker in players of all ages. Are you ready to take the leap and conquer the flames?
instructions:
Objective:
Your goal is to guide the protagonist through a series of fiery obstacles and reach the end of each level safely. Navigate through the inferno by timing your jumps to avoid hazards and traps.
Controls:
Use the arrow keys or on-screen touch controls to move the character left or right.
Press the up arrow key or the on-screen jump button to make the character jump.
Hold down the jump button for longer jumps, but be cautious as longer jumps may be riskier to control.
Navigating Obstacles:
Leap over flames, pits, and other hazards to avoid being burned or falling into oblivion.
Time your jumps carefully to clear gaps between platforms and avoid colliding with obstacles.
Some obstacles may move or change dynamically, so stay alert and adjust your timing accordingly.
Collectibles:
Throughout the levels, you may encounter collectible items such as coins or power-ups.
Collect these items to score points or gain special abilities that can aid you in your journey.
Keep an eye out for hidden collectibles tucked away in secret areas of the levels.
Level Progression:
Progress through a series of increasingly challenging levels, each with its own unique set of obstacles and hazards.
Each level presents a new test of your reflexes, timing, and spatial awareness.
Complete levels as quickly and efficiently as possible to earn high scores and unlock new levels.
Restarting and Resuming:
If you fail a level, you can restart from the beginning or from the last checkpoint reached.
Checkpoints are reached at certain milestones within each level and allow you to respawn at that location if you fail.
Enjoy the Experience:
Immerse yourself in the fiery world of Fire Jump 2D with its vibrant visuals and captivating sound effects.
Challenge yourself to master each level and achieve the highest scores possible.
Have fun exploring the game's diverse environments and discovering new ways to navigate the flames!
Practice Makes Perfect:
Don't get discouraged by failures. Practice your timing and precision to improve your skills and progress further in the game.
Experiment with different strategies and approaches to overcome particularly challenging sections of the levels.
Share Your Achievements:
Compete with friends or other players by comparing your scores and achievements.
Share your progress on social media and challenge others to beat your high scores.
Above All, Have Fun:
Fire Jump 2D is all about having a thrilling and enjoyable gaming experience. So, dive in, embrace the challenge, and most importantly, have fun!

Fill the bar at the top of the screen with points to gain new levels and unlock new boosters and features.

The game will end when the field is filled to the top, so strategy and planning will be required to get the most out of the game. There is no time limit, score as many points as possible!

name: BoxBulletCraft
description:
There are as many as five unique arenas available in this game, each of which is a unique battlefield full of dangers and opportunities. Choose your favorite arena and get ready for battle!

Here you will find not only an exciting single player game, but also an exciting mode for two players on the same device! Fight with your friend back to back against monsters!

The game offers you as many as eight types of monsters that use unique attack strategies and have their own special characteristics. Challenge them and develop your own winning strategy!

Weapons are the key to your victory! The game features as many as eight different types of weapons, each of which has its own power and special abilities. Experiment with weapons and find your perfect monster killing kit.
instructions:
Player 1:
Keyboard only mode:
WASD – movement
QE – change weapons
Space – shooting

Keyboard + Mouse mode:
Left mouse button – shooting
Mouse wheel up/down – change weapons

Player 2:
Arrows on the keyboard – movement
("greater than" and "less than" signs) – change weapons
(slash) – shooting

General:
ESC – pause

name: Valentine Pets Coloring Book
description: In this game with a theme for the Valentine's Day you will find six different pictures with beautiful pets which have to be colored as fast as you can to obtain a great score at the end of the game. You have 24 different colors to choose. You can also save the colored image or print it out. Have fun!
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Cars Differences
description: In this game Cars Differences you need to keep locate differences between the two pictures in the limited amount of time given to play each time! To play, use your mouse as control. Make sure that you don’t make a mistake more than three times because that will make you fail. One minute is the total time you will play through the 20 levels in this game! In each level you have seven differences. Good luck!
instructions: Use your mouse or tap the screen to find the differences.

name: Zombie Shoot
description: We are with you in the game Zombie Shoot. On the screen in different places we will see standing zombies. In the hands of our hero will be a bazooka. You need to shoot it so that the shells fall near the enemies. In time they will explode and destroy the enemy. In doing so, when shooting, you need to consider the trajectory of the flight of shells and how they can bounce off objects. After all, some of the opponents are in very difficult places.
instructions: Use the mouse or tap the screen to shoot the zombies.

name: Valentine Hidden Heart
description:
Embark on a love-filled adventure with “Valentine Hidden Heart,” a captivating hidden object game that will sweep you off your feet! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of romance as you explore picturesque scenes filled with hidden hearts waiting to be discovered.

⭐️ Features

1. Romantic Locations: Explore dreamy landscapes, charming gardens, and intimate settings that set the perfect stage for a love story. Each level is carefully crafted to evoke the essence of Valentine’s Day, with beautiful visuals and heartwarming details.

2. Challenge Your Observational Skills: “Valentine Hidden Heart” is not just a game; it’s a test of your keen observational skills. Sharpen your senses as you seek out elusive hearts in beautifully illustrated scenes. The challenge increases with each level, keeping you engaged and entertained.

3. Vibrant Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually appealing and user-friendly interface, with captivating graphics that enhance the overall gaming experience. The interface is designed to be intuitive and accessible for players of all ages.

4. Mobile-Friendly: Designed for accessibility on both computers and mobile devices, allowing players to enjoy the game on their preferred platform
instructions: Use your mouse to search for hidden hearts

name: Fruit Merge Reloaded
description:
Dive into the juicy and colorful world of Fruit Merge Reloaded, a captivating merging game that combines the addictive gameplay of 2048 with the sweetness of your favorite fruits! Your task is to merge identical fruits to create new and exotic varieties, aiming to reach the ultimate fruit fusion.

⭐️ Features

1. Merge and Discover: Begin your journey by merging the first fruit with its identical counterpart, unlocking a brand new fruit in the process. Each merge takes you one step closer to the elusive 11th fruit.

2. Vibrant Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually appealing and user-friendly interface, with captivating graphics that enhance the overall gaming experience. The interface is designed to be intuitive and accessible for players of all ages.

3. Mobile-Friendly: Designed for accessibility on both computers and mobile devices, allowing players to enjoy the game on their preferred platform.
instructions:
Use the mouse or touch to move the fruit.
Merge each fruit with its identical counterpart

name: 2 Player Crazy Racer
description: 2 Player Crazy Racer lets you step into the vibrant world of the 60s. The visuals are not appealing just to beginners but also to seasoned gamers! This game's great selection of cars might evoke your memories of iconic video games like L.A. Noire and Mafia: Definitive Edition.
instructions:
Player 1 Controls:

WASD: Move Car
Left-Shift: Speed Up
R: Respawn
Player 2 Controls:

Arrow Keys: Move Car
M: Speed Up
L: Respawn

name: Geometry Rash
description: Geometry Rash is a 2D action platformer game requiring very fast response. Sound on and put your reflexes to a high-stakes test in this game inspired by Geometry Dash!
instructions: Use left-click, spacebar, W or up arrow key to jump.

name: Drifting Mania
description: It’s time to leave your skid marks on the asphalt! Stay focused because there are no second chances in a drifter’s life. Real masters love sharp turns on racing tracks!
instructions: Tap, hold and release the rope to stay on the road! Drift and earn money to unlock and customize your car from 13 options. Earn 30 achievements in this endless colorful road.

name: Tower Defense Clash
description: A horde of horrible monsters is attacking your kingdom, build your towers fast and survive all the waves. If arrows or stones are not enough, use elements to your advantage and slay them all.
instructions: Build towers on the free spots and they will automatically attack monsters that come near them. Use different combinations of towers and elements to your advantage. If you still feel pressured, use spells and upgrade your towers to maximum.

name: Minigolf Clash
description: It's time for minigolf and for you to show off your creativity. Use the different golf balls to your advantage and glide through the levels with ease. Buy more levels with the rewards and hone your golf skills.
instructions: Get your golf ball in the hole with as smallest number of strokes possible. Take advantage of the unique balls for different creative solutions.  Use the rewards to buy more golf balls and progressively more difficult levels.

name: Cooking Mania
description: Live out your dreams as a chef in your own restaurant. Choose from one of the five different restaurants with rising difficulty. Upgrade your equipment to manage the growing amount of customers that love your food.
instructions: Make the different customer orders as fast as you can. Earn money and upgrade your restaurant to make cooking easier. Collect daily rewards and buy more complicated restaurants as the game progresses.

name: Jewel Royal Saga
description: Sit down and listen to the sound of jewels and gems jingling as you match them. Increase your puzzle-solving skills while relaxing in your free time.
instructions: Match jewels of the same type in rows and columns. Connect as many pieces as you can to trigger stronger bombs. Gain boosters from the wheel of fortune and completing levels. Use them to make completing a level easier.

name: Crown protection
description: Сrown protection is an exciting game in the genre of "tower defense". Join the battle with monsters trying to take over your land and take your crown, show your skill in building towers. You need to think over tactics!
instructions:
For computers:
Space bar - turn off or turn on the music (Only on the computer).
Basic mouse control.
Click on the button with the character and place the tower on a free square with the image of a hammer.
To remove the tower, you just need to click on it, be careful, you will receive 50% of the cost of the tower when selling.
Click on the crystals with money, they will bring you $ 10 each. They are restored every two seconds.

name: Parking Master 3D
description:
Parking Master 3D isn’t only a fun driving experience but also it will take you to a new level! Sure thing that It’s more than just parking.

These parking lots have tons of obstacles like challenging parking situations, angry grannies, and much more. If you move them in the wrong order, your car will be flipped or into each other. Try your best to not hit granny, and don’t even think about it!
As the level gets harder, the complexity will also increase. Get all the cars on the road to get many special rewards and solve puzzles, unlock skins, complete levels without getting stuck, and more!
instructions:
WHY PLAY PARKING MASTER 3D?
NEW CHALLENGE CAR GAME. Many easy-to-hard challenges are waiting for you. Moving a path in the middle so that the stuck car can drive out.

name: Lucy All Season Fashionista
description:
Discover Lucy All-Season Fashionista, who effortlessly masters every seasonal trend. From cozy winter chic to breezy summer styles, follow her fashion journey through all seasons. Get inspired to elevate your wardrobe with Lucy’s expert tips and versatile fashion choices. Embrace a style that transcends every season!

⭐️ Features

1. Seasonal Levels: Autumn, Winter, Summer, and Spring: Each season represents a level with distinct themes and color palettes.

2. Dress-up Elements: Clothing Selection: An extensive wardrobe featuring outfits specific to each season. Mix and Match: Players can mix and match tops, bottoms, dresses, and outerwear for various looks.

3. Hairstyle Options: Seasonal Hairdos: Hairstyles ranging from cozy winter hats to flowing summer waves, fitting each season’s style. Hair Colors: Customizable hair colors and styles to match the selected outfits.

4. Mobile-Friendly: Designed for accessibility on both computers and mobile devices, allowing players to enjoy the game on their preferred platform.
instructions:
1. Character Selection:
   - Begin by moving your mouse to explore the selection of dress-up characters.
   - Left-click on your chosen character from the four available options.

2. Dress Selection:
   - Dive into the world of fashion with our extensive collection of long dresses.
   - Click on the "Tops" tag to discover 10 fabulous short clothing options.
   - Unleash your creativity and choose the perfect outfit that resonates with your style.

3. Bottoms and Skirts:
   - Click on the "Bottoms" icon to access a diverse array of 15 pants and skirts.
   - Mix and match to create unique and trendy combinations for your character.

4. Hairstyle Customization:
   - Explore the various hairstyles available by clicking on the dedicated icon.
   - Select the haircut that complements your character's overall look and personality.

5. Accessorize with Jewelry:
   - Enhance your character's style by choosing accessories under the "Necklaces" symbol.
   - Select from an array of eye-catching jewelry to add that extra touch of glamour.

6. Final Touches:
   - Take a moment to review your styled character and make any final adjustments.
   - Experiment with different combinations until you achieve the perfect look.

7. Save and Share:
   - Once satisfied with your creation, consider saving or sharing your styled character.
   - Show off your fashion sense and creativity with friends or on social media!

Remember, the possibilities are endless, and this game is all about expressing your unique style. Have fun and let your imagination run wild!

name: Bus Collect
description: An easygoing brain-teaser where your goal is to land all passengers safely. Though it seems straightforward, it offers a surprising level of depth. Enjoy a wide range of levels while honing your problem-solving skills.
instructions: play with mouse

name: Balls Bricks Breaker
description: This classic brick breaker game will give endless hours of fun and excitement to players of all ages and skill levels. This puzzle challenges you! Interestingly composed levels will not let you get bored. Will you be able to unlock all the bonuses?
instructions: Hit the bricks: The objective of the game is to destroy all the bricks on the screen by hitting them with the balls. The balls will bounce off the walls and the bricks, so aim carefully to destroy as many bricks as possible with each shot.  Keep the balls in the game: if the balls fall to the bottom of the screen, all the blocks of bricks will move down, if at least one brick reaches the bottom, then you will lose.  Keep the ball in play as long as possible to score more points.

name: Cooking World Reborn
description:
The goal of the game is to go all the way from a small food truck to a large cafe in the center of the airport.

What awaits you:

- More than 50 large levels

- Various improvements to kitchen equipment

- Several game modes
instructions: You need to prepare food for clients within a certain time frame. Get bonuses for speed and buy new, more advanced kitchen equipment.

name: Dino Chaos Idle
description: Dino Chaos Idle is an idle clicker game where you give life to the dinosaurs. You will enable them to create chaos on the surface by resurrecting them. Many scientists will work with you while you are working underground.
instructions: Use your mouse click to revive the dinosaurs.

name: FNF Funk 3D
description: FNF Funk 3D is an arcade game where you must lean on your musical ear to succeed. You will find yourself competing with a girl in music battles.
instructions: Arrow keys

name: Gladiators. Merge and Fight
description:
Gladiators: Merge and Fight is an engaging arcade game that combines character attribute creation and enhancement with combat. In this game, you start with basic materials and improve your gladiator's attributes by upgrading weapon, shield, armor, and helmet materials. Every decision affects your hero's stats. After preparing your gladiator, press the "Start" button to begin the second part of the game: arena battles. Fight against other gladiators, utilize your skills and tactics to claim victory, and become an arena legend.

Gladiators: Merge and Fight offers a unique blend of two captivating gameplay mechanics, where your ability to enhance your gladiator is crucial in the pursuit of victory and glory in the arena.
instructions:
In the first part of the game, click on a material and drag it to another cell, a character slot, or another material. By pressing the "Craft" button, you can craft a level one material. After your hero is equipped and ready for battle, press the "Battle" button.

In the second part of the game, two new buttons become available: "Block" with a shield icon and "Attack" with a sword icon. Use these buttons wisely because using either of these actions triggers a cooldown for both buttons, and they become available again after completing the action animation.

Good luck in the arena!

name: Funny Snake
description: Funny Snake is an exciting game where the player controls a fun and stretched hero – a snake that moves through different levels to collect delicious fruits. However, in its continuous hunt for goodies, the snake must avoid the thorns that are in the way.
instructions: Use your mouse or tap on the screen or use the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard.

name: Knight Princess Dress Up
description: Create your own knight princess character and dress her up in big poofy dresses combined with solid armor! A strong princess that doesn't need saving from anyone!
instructions: Use mouse to navigate through the menu.

name: Enemy Strike
description: Enemy Strike is a game in which you need to control a spaceship and shoot down enemies and dodge them to survive, you will also meet three fights with your skills. Use a variety of weapons (Lasers, bombs, jumping platforms, etc.) to destroy everyone.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Prison business
description:
Noob went to jail, and this time it's serious! It is almost impossible to escape, but if you try hard and organize a business, the way will be open!

Renovate the prison!
- Organize a business producing batons, burgers and milk!
- Open a modern high-tech laundry, soda production and much more in the exciting game "Prison Business"!
- Hire workers, make them work and earn tons of money!
- Build a store and start selling goods to visitors!
instructions:
Your task is to repair the prison and build various production facilities. Hire workers and earn money!

Control:
Move: W, A, S, D or keyboard arrows.
Mobile devices: Touch the screen and a virtual joystick will appear.

name: Salads by Chef: Merge Сraft
description:
Find out the story of the chef who creates the most delicious salads on the planet!!!

Prepare popular Russian salads - Olivier, Herring under a fur coat, Vinaigrette, Mimosa, Greek, Caesar, Crab, etc.
instructions:
Buy ingredients, combine them and drag them into a salad!

Drag and drop ingredients:
On PC - Left Mouse Button and Wheel
On the phone - Tap on the screen and move your finger

name: Hook Wars
description: Hook Wars is a 3D battle game where you need to avoid being hooked by the avatars across the river.
instructions:
To move, use the WASD or the Arrow keys.
To hook the avatars, use your left-click.
Alternatively, you can also use the space key to hook.

name: Pool Float Party
description: The best friends of Blondie and Marie decided to have a pool party. What's a party without cocktails? Let's make a refreshing mojito together from soda, lemon, lime and mint leaves. And while Blondie is busy with cocktails, Marie cleans up the area next to the pool. Help the girls with creating a unique design for the party. Now that everything is ready, you can take care of yourself. Make up for each of the girls and choose the right outfit. Choose from a variety of swimsuits and pareos. Blondie prefers pink shades, and Marie loves the combination of red and black colors and a polka dot pattern. Do not forget to complement the image with stylish accessories and choose an inflatable raft of original shape for girls.
instructions: On hot summer days, two best friends want to have fun drinking refreshing cocktails in a small but private pool. But to do this, you need to clean and repair the pool, pick up outfits and accessories for relaxing on the water and, of course, make cocktails. Help your friends to implement their plans! The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used to control it.

name: Piggy Bank
description: In front of you on the screen you will see a piggy bank, which will stand at the bottom of the playing field. There will be a special button above it at a certain height. Various objects can be placed between the pig and the button. You will have to click the button very quickly with the mouse. This way you will drop coins, which, hitting objects and ricocheting from them, will end up in the piggy bank. Your task is to collect a certain amount of coins in the piggy bank. As soon as you do this, you will be given points in the Piggy Bank game.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Egg Helix
description: Egg Helix is an arcade game where you steer a trunk adorned with many tennis rackets. There will be an easter egg bouncing up and down.
instructions:
Use the A/D or the Left and Right arrow keys to steer the trunk.
Alternatively, you may use your mouse to direct the trunk.

name: Legends Arena
description: Legends Arena is an online shooting game where you battle with your enemies as a team. There are many game options. You can play in 2v2, 3v3 and 5v5 modes.
instructions:
To move, use the WASD keys.
To reload bullets, use the R key.
To bend down, use the C key.
To jump, use the Space key.
To run, use the Left-Shift key.

name: Parking Path
description: In the game Parking Path you should try to park the cars to the designated places. The topic of today's lesson is car parking. In front of you on the screen you will see a playing field on which several cars will be located. Each of them will have a different color. At a certain distance, you will see special parking spaces that are also color-coded. Your task is to place the cars in the places corresponding to their color. To do this, using the mouse, you will have to draw driving routes for each vehicle. Keep in mind that there may be various obstacles on the way of vehicles. Also, they should not collide with each other.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Futuristic Cars Jigsaw
description: Futuristic Cars Jigsaw is a free online puzzle game. Drag the pieces into right position using mouse. Solving puzzles is relaxing, rewarding, and keeps your brain sharp. You need to spend $1000 to be able to purchase one of the following pictures. You have three modes for each picture from which the hardest mode brings more money. You have a total of 10 pictures.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Stickman Base Defense
description:
Welcome to "Stickman Defender" - the ultimate arcade idler browser game! Immerse yourself in the world of stickman heroes, where you must protect the base from hordes of attacking enemies. 

Your mission: Collect resources, build protective walls and towers, and upgrade your hero to create the ultimate defense!
instructions:
Stickman hero: 
Take control of a brave stickman defending the base. Improve his skills and equip him with powerful weapons to keep the enemies at bay.

Resource collection: 
Start by collecting water and cement to make bricks. These bricks are the basic building blocks for your defenses.

Ammunition production: 
Set up a production facility for ammunition and turn resources like shell casings into cartridges. Your towers are only as strong as their ammunition - secure their supply to fight the enemy effectively.

name: Snake Wars
description: Snake Wars is an online arcade game where you, as a little snake, try to eat food and get bigger and bigger in a pit. There will be many online players around you who are also snakes. Do not collide with them. Otherwise, you will fail the game.
instructions:
To steer the snake, use your mouse cursor.
To boost, use the left mouse button or the Space key.

name: Cute Budgie Puzzle
description:
Dive into the delightful world of Cute Budgie Puzzle, where vibrant feathers, charming chirps, and playful antics come together in a super fun jigsaw puzzle game crafted just for kids! Play around and have fun! Unlock the joy of puzzle-solving as you piece together the endearing images of these feathered friends. 'Cute Budgie Puzzle' isn't just a game; it's an interactive canvas where each puzzle piece unveils a burst of color, showcasing the charm and personality of these lovable budgies. From fluffy plumage to tiny beaks, every detail comes to life as the puzzle unfolds.

Designed with simplicity and fun in mind, this game is perfect for young enthusiasts eager to explore the world of puzzles. Play it online for free and let the laughter of these cheerful budgies accompany you on your puzzle-solving journey. As each piece slots into place, a sense of accomplishment and joy fills the air.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: Dockyard Tank Parking
description: Dockyard Tank Parking is a 3D tank driving game where you steer a huge machine and try to park it in the specified parking area.
instructions:
Use the WASD or the Arrow keys to steer the tank.
Use the Left Mouse button to shoot a tank shell.
You may also use the Spacebar key for firing.
Use the C key to change the camera view.
Use the ESC key to pause.

name: Tiny Crash Fighters
description: Tiny Crash Fighters is an online puzzle game where you build your destructive robot to fight with the CPUs or other online players' machines.
instructions:
Use your mouse to fight with other machines.
The game automatically directs the machines in combat.

name: Head Soccer 2022
description: Head Soccer 2022 is an unblocked arcade game where you play football matches versus CPU or with a friend as a famous footballer head.
instructions:
P1 Controls
To move the character, use the WASD keys.
To shoot the ball, use the N and M keys.

P2 Controls
To move the character, use the Arrow keys.
To shoot the ball, use the 1 and 2 number keys.

1 Player Arcade
To move the characters, use the Arrow keys.
To shoot the ball, use the Z and X keys.

name: Master Cooking
description: A hungry customer is an impatient customer. Which needs to be served as soon as possible. This is exactly what will happen in the game Master Cooking. Your restaurant is open. Quickly put cutlets on the pan, throw potato straws into the boiling oil and turn on the beverage dispenser. All this will be needed soon and let the dishes be ready in advance so that hungry customers do not wait and are not nervous. Serve quickly, get paid a solid tip, complete the tasks of the levels. And there will be fifty of them. Buy equipment, upgrade it and all this for the fastest service in Master Cooking.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Hide N Seek
description: In the new online game Hide N Seek we invite you and other players from around the world to play hide and seek. In front of you on the screen you will see a labyrinth in which your character and other participants in the game will be located. You will have to choose who your hero will be. He will hide or seek. If the character must hide, then you will use the control keys to make the hero run through the maze and look for a secluded place. The player who will look for you will also wander through the maze. You will constantly have to change your location and not let yourself be discovered. After holding out for a while, you will be able to run to a certain zone. Once you are in the game Hide N Seek find yourself in it, you will be awarded the victory.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Highway Cars
description: Highway Cars is a 3D driving game where you steer your car on the highway in the flow of traffic. The key point here is dodging the other cars without any accident.
instructions:
To steer the car, use the WASD or the Arrow keys.
To change the camera view, use the C key.

name: Legendary Sniper
description: Legendary Sniper is an online sniper shooter game where you follow the commands of your general. War has begun! You are the most talented sniper of the squad.
instructions:
Right Click: To aim
Left Click: To shoot

name: Doge Blocks
description: Welcome to the new online game Doge Blocks. In it you will find yourself in a world where blocky dogs live. Today you will need to place them on the playing field. You will see it in front of you on the screen. The playing field will be divided inside into an equal number of cells. Below them you will see blocky dogs that will have different shapes. Using the mouse, you can select any dog and move it to the playing field. Thus, you will fill in this field. As soon as you do this, you will be given points in the Doge Blocks game.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Out of Lava
description: Out of Lava is a very fun and never-ending game. The objective of the game is to get as far as you can through a maze of rooms and traps, where lava chases you through every room.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Alien Sky Invasion
description: Alien Sky Invasion is an aircraft driving game where you steer a jet aircraft in the infinite void of Space. But you will not be alone in the sky. Aliens from different galactic races will accompany you, but not in a good way.
instructions:
To control the jet, use the WASD keys.
To boost the speed, use the Space or the Shift key.
To shoot, use the left mouse click.
To launch a missile, use the right mouse click.
To pause, use the Tab key.

name: Stop Now
description: The colored ball will roll down the chute, which stretches for an infinite distance. It is quite difficult to get them out of it, but it is possible if you pass the obstacles incorrectly. There will be a lot of them on the way of the ball: straight, curved, cruciform, jagged and round. They move in different planes and rotate in different directions. Approaching the next obstacle, you can stop the ball and choose the right moment to pass. The goal is to get as far as possible. Take your time, speed in this case is not the main thing. It is important to pass the obstacles without losses, otherwise the Stop Now game will start again from the beginning and the ball will be at the beginning of the path.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Orbit Escape
description: In the game Orbit Escape you have to tap the screen at the right time to make the spaceship move in a straight line towards the next planet. If you don’t do this at the right time, and consequently don’t reach the planet, it results in game over. You can also collect coins to buy spaceship skins.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Metamorphosis Survivor
description: Metamorphosis Survivor: Challenge metamorphosis and survive constant transformation! In this exciting and challenging game, dive into a world in constant flux, where survival depends on the ability to adapt and transform. Take control of a character in constant evolution, whose goal is to become part of an identical group to destroy others. Face the challenge of constantly changing your form, assimilating other identities to thrive. Every collision with a different character leads to an instant metamorphosis. Uncover a world full of transformation possibilities, each with its unique advantages and challenges. Master the art of adaptation while navigating through an ever-evolving environment. Be agile, strategic, and cunning to ensure your survival in the fascinating and unpredictable universe of Metamorphosis Survivor!.
instructions: Simple Controls: Use the mouse, gamepad or touch to move the character.

name: Survival Craft
description: Survival Craft is a sandbox adventure that challenges players to create essential tools like axes, shovels, weapons, and wearables for survival in a dense jungle environment.
instructions:
To move the farmer, use the WASD keys.
Use your mouse to craft items.
Use the right mouse click to equip, drop, or eat an item or sow seeds.

name: Fort Drifter
description: Fort Drifter is a drift game where you can steer crazy cars on a platform full of jumping ramps, highway roads in different shapes, and castles.
instructions:
To steer your vehicle, use the WASD or the Arrow keys.
Press the Space key to use the booster.
Press the Q key to create your tracks.
Use the E key to change your car.
To pause or go to the menu, press the ESC key.

name: Charge Everything
description: Quite a few modern devices are powered by various batteries or batteries. Therefore, occasionally they need recharging. Today in the game Charge Everything you will put various devices on charge. An electrical outlet will be visible on the screen in front of you. Your device will be located at a certain distance from it. A cord with a socket at the end will depart from it. You will have to drag the plug with the mouse and plug it into the socket. In this way, you will connect the device to the mains, and it will start charging. For this you will be given points and you will go to the next level of the game.
instructions: Use mouse or touch on the screen!

name: Stick Runner
description: Stick Runner is an adrenaline-pumping game that challenges your reflexes and agility. Navigate through a treacherous landscape filled with obstacles that test your skills to survive. Jump over hurdles using the touch buttons or the space key to keep your character safe, or swiftly slide under barriers by pressing the down arrow. The game's fast-paced action and dynamic obstacles promise an exciting experience for players aiming to achieve the highest scores and conquer the leaderboard.
instructions: Jump over hurdles using the touch buttons or the space key to keep your character safe, or swiftly slide under barriers by pressing the down arrow.

name: Drift No Limit: Car Racing
description:
Welcome to the world of adrenaline drift racing! Are you ready to plunge into incredible adventures on the asphalt?
Game Features
Huge vehicle fleet: choose from numerous powerful cars, each of which has its own character and features. From classic sports cars to exotic race cars, the possibilities are endless!

name: Mr. Noob EAT Burger
description:
Collect all the burgers, but beware of Mr. Noob!

The essence of the game

Welcome to the world of Burger Hunter! Your task is to search and collect burgers in a giant dark maze. But be careful! Your hero is confronted by the sinister Mr. A noob who doesn't like it when someone steals his favorite burgers.

Game features

Torches: Your faithful assistant in this game is a torch. With it, you can light your way through the dark corridors of the labyrinth and avoid meeting Mr. noob.
Burger Radar: Another important tool is the burger radar. It indicates the distance to the nearest burger, making it easier to find them. However, at the most difficult level, you will be left without a radar. You will have to rely only on your skills and intuition!
Difficulty levels: The game offers three difficulty levels. At every level Mr. Noob gets faster, and the radar at the hardest level disappears altogether.
Safe Zone: There is a safe zone in the maze. If you enter it, Mr. Noob will not be able to catch you.
Running and Fatigue: The game has the ability to run, but it is limited by the fatigue bar. The more you run, the faster it disappears. Rest will allow you to recover.
Inventory: The player has two inventory slots to store a torch and a burger radar. You can quickly switch between these items during the game.
Burger Hunter is a game full of exciting adventures, stunts and challenges. You have every chance of becoming the best burger hunter if you use your tools well, explore the maze carefully, and come up with strategies to bypass Mr. noob.

Graphics and sound

The graphics of the game are made in a bright and eye-pleasing style, the animation of the characters looks lively and dynamic. Lighting effects deserve special attention, which make the labyrinth even more mysterious and tense. Find and connect letters to mark all the words hidden inside the grid.

Welcome to the international World Cup of soccer caps or table soccer game. Choose your desired national team, and control your players (caps) to kick the ball into the opponent's goal to score points.

Release to shoot.
Kick the ball into the opponent's goal to score points.

Collect points to grow, and avoid colliding with the blocks which have big numbers.
Gather stars to unlock new cool snake skins in the Shop.

To break the bubbles, you need to connect three or more bubbles of the same color together and then shoot the bubble you are given into a bunch of ocean bubbles stacked in the play area. Try to break all the bubbles with as few shots as possible.

Mobile:

- Release to shoot

Desktop:

- Click to shoot

Build the bridges nicely to cross as many deeps as possible.
Use the special items (Attack, Second Chance, Accurate Eye, Jump) wisely to help your hero on his adventure.
There are many nice themes and cool heroes to unlock.
A global leaderboard is also supported. Try to win high scores and raise your name on the leaderboard.
ENJOY NOW!

Tap the screen to extend the bridge. Release to lay it down and walk on it.
Use the special items wisely:
- Attack: Attacking the monsters.
- Second Chance: A be revived if fails.
- Accurate Eye: Helping build the bridge accurately.
- Jump: Allowing hero to jump across the small gap between the bridge and the platform.

name: Family Farm
description:
Welcome to Family Farm!
Grow your farm by planting crops and raising animals.
Firstly, you need to have an available plot to plant. Buy it with your money.
Then, open the shop to buy a seed and plant it on the plot.
Harvest the profit once the production time is finished.
You can sell a crop to plant another one.
You can also upgrade the crops to increase their productivity.
Enjoy the game and let's become a bonafide farmer!
instructions:
Click the "shovel" button and choose a plot to buy it.
Click the "dollar sign" button to sell crops.
Click the "leaf" button to upgrade productivity.
Buy seeds and special items in the shop.
Click the crops once the production time is finished to collect golds.
Click the "gift" button to visit the lucky wheel where you can spin to win prizes.
Visit the game everyday to earn daily reward (an extra spin).

name: Color Bubble Shooter
description:
Aim, match and smash all the colorful bubbles in this relaxing color matching adventure. To break the bubbles, you need to connect three or more bubbles of the same color together by shooting the bubbles you are given into a bunch of bubbles stacked in the play area. Try to pop all the bubbles with as few shots as possible.
It's time to raise your name on the leaderboard. Enjoy!

Features:
- 4 maps to play 
- 15 levels in each map (hence 60 levels in total)
- Many features (bombs, rainbows, thunders, stars)
- Many types of bubbles (colorful bubbles, Skull bubbles, Shielded bubbles, Glass bubbles, Clock bubbles, Question bubbles, Rock bubbles, Spiked bubbles...).
- Leaderboard support.
- Cool designs.

Mobile: Tap and drag to change direction. Release to shoot.
Desktop: Move pointer to change direction. Click to shoot.

name: Classic Sudoku Daily Puzzles
description:
An addictive logic-based, combinatorial number-placement puzzle game. The objective is to fill a 9 × 9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3 × 3 sub-grids that compose the grid (also called "boxes" or "blocks") contain all of the digits from 1 to 9. Each puzzle will start at a partially completed grid, which has a single solution.

Features:
- Two themes / modes: Day (Light) and Night (Dark)
- Statistics of scores / progress
- Global leaderboard
- Daily challenges to earn bonus score and hints
- Four difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Master
instructions:
Tap a cell to select it.
Tap a digit at the bottom row to fill it into the selected cell.
Use eraser to clear the current cell.
Tap the Note button to turn on the draft mode.
Use hints wisely to reveal any cells.

name: Candy Tile Blast

- Collect all the tiles required to pass each level.

name: Number Merge
description: A match 3 game where you modify the number tiles on the board by dropping "-1", "1" or "2" tiles from your list to create new numbers. The "-1" tile subtracts one from the number it is dropped on while your "1" and "2" tiles add one and two to the number tile it is dropped on. Strategically drop the number tiles from your list of tiles to make matches and keep your list topped up.
instructions:
Drag and drop the topmost tile on your list onto a tile on the board to change that tile's number. Match 3 or more numbers together to have them merge into the next larger number. Making matches will increase your score as well as add another tile to your list of tiles. Multiple matches will add even more tiles to your list.

If you have earned enough coins you can drop a bomb on a tile to remove it or drop the more powerful but more expenssive wand on a tile to remove all like numbered tiles on the board. Dropping a "-1" tile on a "1" tile will cause that tile to be deleted.

Swipe your finger across the screen to slice through fruits with precision and watch as they burst into a splash of juicy goodness. The more accurate your slice, the more points you earn. But be cautious – mixed among the fruits are dangerous bombs that you must avoid at all costs. Slice a bomb, and you'll lose valuable points.

There are three game modes in Fruit Slice: Arcade, Classic and Relax.

Arcade:

Arcade mode is more challenging than Classic mode. Players have only three lives and the goal is to achieve the highest score possible. Bombs appear more frequently in Arcade mode and the score is calculated differently than in Classic mode.

Classic:

Classic mode is the simplest mode. Players have unlimited lives and the goal is to slice as much fruit as possible in 60 seconds. The score is calculated based on the number of fruits sliced, the combos achieved, and the bonus fruits collected.

Relax:

Relax mode is a more zen-like experience. Players have unlimited lives and the goal is to simply slice fruit and relax. There are no bombs in Relax mode and the score is not tracked.
