Explore the richness of Espírito Santo culture with special items that celebrate traditions such as congo, folia de reis, pomeranian dance, casaca, and capoeira. Customize every detail of your avatar, from hairstyles and clothing to accessories and facial expressions, creating characters that reflect the diversity and beauty of Brazilian folklore.

Play now on KawaiiGames.net and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.KawaiiGames.MegaKawaiiChibiAvatarMaker) and start creating your avatar with a special touch of Espírito Santo traditions!
instructions: Click over the options to choose clothes, hair, facial features, etc.

name: Scribble World Platform Puzzle
description: Get all 100 coins across 20 levels.  Change size strategically and avoid obstacles to be able to get to the exit on each level.  You'll need to enable the exit on each level before you can exit the level.
instructions: Use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to move your player left and right. use the W or up arrow key or space bar to jump.  Use the on-screen buttons on touch devices.

name: Basketball Golf
description: A basketball goal set up on hills and water?  Of course as this is Basketball Golf where you shoot baskets like you golf except you can also modify the shot in midair. 50 levels to complete.
instructions: Touch and drag or hold the left mouse button down and drag to set the force and direction of the shot.  Once you are happy with the setting, you can release to shoot the ball.  After the shot is made and while the shot is in the air you can hold down touch or the left mouse button to slow the shot down and adjust the direction/force.

name: Panda Love
description: Help Panda get enough coins to buy flowers for his girlfriend.  Panda runs until he hits an object and then turns back the other way.  All you can do is make Panda jump. So time your jumps just right and strategize on the fly on if he should jump coming or going.
instructions: Just tap/click the screen to make Panda jump.  Once all of the stars are retrieved then the exit portal opens up. Get Panda to the exit portal to complete the level.

name: Baby Doll Simple Style
description: Minimalism is the new trend! Meet the original model doll dress up in a super-minimalist style. The combination of black and white may surprise you. Train your sense of beauty by choosing contrasting outfits for girls. Simplicity is the new concept of life and fashion!
instructions: The inhabitants of the black and white world also want to be fashionable! Help beautiful girls create a unique bright image in a world devoid of colors. The result can be saved as a PNG image. Depending on the gaming device, a computer mouse click or a simple touch on touch screens is used for control.

name: Bird Line Math Addition
description: The Number Birds come and go on the telephone line. Click a bird to add its number to the running total. There's no time limit in this game but you still have to be careful as you don't want to go over the Goal Number.
instructions:
Click or tap the Number Birds to add their number to the running total. Reach the Goal Number without going over.  Once you get the target sum you'll be given a new number to reach.

You'll get more moves each time you reach the Goal Number without going over. The game ends when you run out of moves or go over the Goal Number.

name: Scribble World Physics Puzzle
description: Embark on a delightful physics puzzle adventure with Scribble World: Physics Puzzle. In this game you need to interact with physics based elements and help Scribball find a way out of each level. Solve clever puzzles, find keys, collect coins and progress through challenging levels!
instructions: Just tap or click on objects to remove or interact with various objects.  Get Scribball to the exit door to complete each level

name: Tractor Delivery
description: Tractor Delivery is a small but very addictive physical game! You play as a tractor driver, your goal is to deliver items from the warehouse to the factory, the more items you bring, the more coins you get, for coins you can buy new tractors and trailers in your garage, as well as improve them. Show everyone who is the best transporter! The game has a garage, it’s also a store with the purchase of improvements for the tractor, in total 4 tractors and 4 trailers are available. The game has a total of 180 levels that generate the road automatically. Also, the speedometer can show the speed in kilometers or miles per hour, depending on the chosen language of the game.
instructions: Move - W,A,S,D and Arrow Keys; Handbrake - Spacebar, Nitro - X. Touch Control works on all browsers and all mobile devices!

name: Crazy Tennis
description: Your team just isn't very good but luckily the other team isn't either. They will swing their rackets when you tell them to but that is about it. Other than that they'll stumble around or fall down but that is what makes this game so fun. Play against the computer or play with a friend.
instructions:
For touch devices, touch the side your team is on to get them to jump and swing the racket. On PC's, click the mouse on your team's side or use the "w" key for the team on the left side and the up arrow for the team on the right side of the net.

If you find your players laying down on the job or not in the place you want them to be, just keep clicking or tapping and they might eventually do what you want them to do!

name: Minecraft Hidden Diamond Blocks
description: Minecraft Hidden Diamond Blocks is a wonderful online game with hidden objects. Find out the hidden diamond blocks in the specified images. Each level has 10 hidden diamond blocks. There are 6 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready start the game and have fun!
instructions: Use mouse on desktop or touch on your mobile device.

name: Rubber Car 2
description: This isn't your dad's car.  Nor is it made of rubber but it sure bounces like it. So race, bounce and roll to the end of each level. There's no time limit in this game but there are plenty of obstacles and drop-offs to keep you on your toes. If you get stuck you can always click on the Video button on the main menu to see how to complete all of the levels.
instructions:
Keyboard Controls: Up Arrow Key or W key to go forward, Down Arrow Key or S key to brake/move in reverse, Left Arrow Key or A key to roll counterclockwise or backwards, Right Arrow Key or D key to roll clockwise or forward and Space Bar to use speed boost if power level is above zero.

Touch Controls: touch to the right of the car to move right and touch left of the car to move left, Left Arrow Icon to roll counterclockwise or backwards, Right Arrow Icon to roll clockwise or forward and Double Arrow Icon to use speed boost if power level is above zero.

name: Hangman Challenge
description: At the top of the screen you will see a hint, it will direct your thoughts in the right direction, suggesting from which area the hidden word: animals, transport, school, fruit and so on. Click on the letters, choosing them from the set below. If any of them is correct, it will appear on the line. If there is none, the rope will begin to appear, then the head, and then the limbs one at a time. If a gallows draw before you guess the word, you lose.
instructions: Use mouse on desktop or touch on your mobile device.

name: Math Charge Multiplication
description: See how long you can keep your ship's health above zero by using your skill of multiplying single digit numbers. Dodge enemy torpedoes while launching depth charges to destroy enemy subs. Set the depth charge depth to the product of the multiplication problem on a sub and let the depth charge fly.
instructions:
Keyboard/Mouse: Click number keys or numbers on keyboard to enter depth. AD keys or arrow keys to move. Click X button or hit X key on keyboard to clear depth. Hit spacebar to launch depth charge or click the Launch button.

Touch: use the on-screen buttons to enter depth, launch depth charge, and clear depth. Use arrow buttons to move. Click the video button on the main menu to see how to play.

name: Pastelkatto Avatar Creator
description: Create a unique avatar by mixing and matching over 400 different items! You can try to create an anime styled version of yourself or use this game to create completely new characters! The game contains everything from casual items to fantasy items so it will be suitable for many different themes.
instructions: Use mouse to navigate through the options in the menu.

name: The Last Miner
description:
"The Last Miner" is an exhilarating third-person and first-person shooting game that thrusts players into an intense post-apocalyptic world. Step into the shoes of Mike, a blocky character, and embark on a thrilling adventure to survive against hordes of zombies and menacing monsters.

As the world plunges into chaos, you must navigate through desolate landscapes, abandoned cities, and eerie environments, armed with an impressive arsenal of weapons and your keen survival instincts. Engage in heart-pounding battles, strategically taking down waves of undead and other fearsome creatures that stand in your way.

With its captivating gameplay and stunning visuals, "The Last Miner" immerses players in a dangerous and unforgiving world. Unleash your shooting skills, upgrade your equipment, and uncover hidden secrets as you unravel the mysteries behind the apocalypse.

Are you ready to face the ultimate challenge and prove yourself as the last hope in this blocky survival adventure? Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled experience in "The Last Miner" as you fight for survival, confront your fears, and emerge as the ultimate hero in this unforgiving wasteland.
instructions: Use what it needs to survive as The Last Miner.

name: Princess Ready For Adventure's Date
description: Welcome to our new game Princess Ready For Adventure’s Date. Princess Moana is so excited. Maui invited her for a date at Te fiti. She needs your help to be prepare and to impress Maui with her stunning look. Join and help her.
instructions: Use your left mouse button or tap to play.

name: Campfire Keeper
description:
Night falls over the forest, and fluffy shadows creep toward your campfire. Shine your lantern beam to chase them away and toss logs into the fire for a bright flash that scares them all off. Keep the fire burning until the sun comes up!
By day, explore the forest: chop trees for firewood, find lost forest cubs and bring them back to camp. Build cozy cabins for them, a workbench, a bigger woodpile, and upgrade your lantern with a stronger battery and a wider beam.
instructions: At night, hold the mouse button or your finger to shine the lantern beam at the shadows. Tap the woodpile (or press Space / E) to toss a log into the fire. By day, tap the ground or use WASD / arrow keys to walk, tap a tree to chop it, and stand on a building pad to build with your wood.

name: Army Base
description: This is a simulation game where you become a commander for training new recruits. Your task is to lead them through various training facilities and transform ordinary privates into true fighters. Lead recruits through physical training, improve their endurance, teach them shooting, medicine, and tactical skills, improving the overall quality of your squad.
instructions: Take your recruits to training stations. Recruits develop gradually. To pick up a recruit, simply approach them.

name: Clash Arena
description: Build a deck of fighters, spells, and special cards, then put your tactics to the test in fast-paced arena battles. Manage elixir, defend your towers, and launch a decisive attack. Every victory brings new arenas, rewards, and powerful cards within reach.
instructions: Build a deck of 8 cards. Spend elixir to play cards on your side of the arena. Send troops toward your opponent’s towers, support them, and switch from defense to attack at the right moment. Destroy more towers before time runs out—or take the main tower for an instant win.

name: Noob hero: Idle RPG
description:
The world is about to be destroyed, and only Noob can save it! Noob Hero is an auto-battle action RPG in an open blocky world. There is no attack button: every weapon strikes on its own while the hero stands still. Move to dodge, stop to fight.

Bruce, an old ranger, leads you through ten lands: from the Green Fields and the Sand Mines to the Pirate Cove and the Frost Outpost. Defeat the master of each land to open the gate onwards.
instructions:
Controls:
- Computer: WASD to move, I or E for the inventory, Esc to pause.
- Phone and tablet: drag anywhere on the screen to move; on-screen buttons open the inventory and pause.
How to play:
Stop near an enemy: every equipped weapon attacks on its own. Weapons don't strike while you move.
2. Defeat enemies and break the objects of the world: each one gives damage, health, defence or another stat for good.
Pick up weapons, helmets and shields and equip them in the inventory.

name: Street Racer: Drift and Chase
description:
Become a street racer: cruise the city, drift through corners and escape the police. The car drives forward by itself — you steer, brake and hit the nitro.
Modes: in Winter Escape, survive a five-minute chase on icy roads. In Racer Chase, drive a police car and ram three racers to a stop. In Traffic Weave, slip through highway traffic and keep an eye on your fuel.
Online: Crumbling Platform, Capture the Flag and Traffic Weave with other players.
instructions:
In the garage, choose a car and press Play: Solo — the city and modes, Online — a match with other players.
The car drives forward by itself.
Desktop: A — left, D — right, S — brake and reverse, Space — handbrake, W or Shift — nitro (after buying it in Tuning).
Mobile: hold the left half of the screen to steer left, the right half to steer right. Touch with two fingers at once for nitro.
Low on fuel — drive into the green square by the pump at a gas station.

name: Brick Tanks
description:
A classic tank battle with toys! Enemy tanks roll in from the far side of the room and head straight for your base, a little flag behind a brick wall. Drive your tank, stop them before they break through and grab the bonuses from the flashing tanks: a star for stronger shots, a helmet, a grenade, a clock and a shovel that turns your walls to steel.
Between waves you get bricks.
instructions: Drive with the arrows or WASD (on a phone, the on-screen pad) and fire with Space or the fire button. Shoot every enemy tank in the wave before one of them destroys your base. Between waves, tap or click the tiles around your base to place bricks, then press or Enter to start the next wave. Pick up bonuses from the flashing tanks. P / Esc pauses the game.

name: Cozy Move
description:
Cozy Move is a relaxing puzzle about moving into a new home. Every level is an order from a client: a room or a whole house, a pile of boxes and a few wishes like "a plant on the windowsill" or "a picture above the bed".
Unpack the boxes and put everything in its place: dishes in the kitchen, a nightstand next to the bed, a lamp on the desk. The client rates your work on three stars — Order, Wishes and Coziness. After each level you see a before/after comparison and tips on what to improve.
instructions:
Drag an item from the tray into the room, or tap an item and then tap a spot. Tap a placed item to rotate it or put it back. Rotate the room with a swipe or the ⟲ ⟳ buttons, zoom with a pinch or the mouse wheel (R also rotates an item on PC).

Put things where they belong, fulfil the client's wishes and make the room cozy to get 3 stars. Stuck? Use a hint — it puts one item in the right place.

name: Pirate Cats: Ancient Treasure
description:
Become a brave pirate cat and set out to claim an ancient treasure! Collect gold from the chest and carry it back to your ship. But stay alert: greedy skeletons are after the loot too!
Gather resources and build mines, workshops, and storage facilities. Produce ammunition and healing potions, keep your cannons supplied, and strengthen your defenses to protect the treasure.
Recruit sailors and boatswains to help with the work.
instructions:
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick.
Follow the red arrow to the treasure chest. Stand in front of it to collect gold, then carry the loot back to your ship.
Gather resources and deliver them to construction and production areas. Build workshops to make supplies, keep your cannons stocked with ammunition, and use the barrels near the ship to replenish health and ammo.
Avoid getting too close to skeletons.

name: Happy Woods
description:
HAPPY WOODS is a simple game where you are a woodcutter who has to... well, cut wood!

Cut as many logs as you can in 90 seconds, and make the highest score EVER!


Nothing more than that...


...maybe...
instructions: To chop the wood  touch the screen or   press 'K'  when the red dot is under the blu cursor.

name: Haunted Air Hockey
description:
Get ready for a spooky twist on classic air hockey! In Haunted Air Hockey, you'll face off against creepy opponents, battle through increasingly challenging levels, and prove your skills in a supernatural hockey tournament!

Take on mischievous pumpkins, speedy ghosts, and mysterious vampires before facing the ultimate challenge — the terrifying Skull King! Each opponent brings a tougher challenge, so sharpen your reflexes, master your shots, and fight your way to victory.

Enjoy colorful Halloween arenas, glowing neon effects, thrilling puck battles, and spooky surprises. Challenge the computer, compete against a friend in two-player mode, or jump straight into an epic boss showdown!
instructions: Move your paddle to hit the puck and score goals against your opponent. Defend your side, aim carefully, and outscore your enemies to advance through the tournament.

name: Arrow Escape – Arrange Your Room
description:
Untangle the arrows. Unlock your dream room!
Put your puzzle skills to the test in Arrow Escape – Arrange Your Room! Find the arrows with a clear path and tap them to escape. Colorful, winding puzzles form playful shapes—but look closely, because every arrow can block another!
Each level you clear earns you a furniture gift for your cozy living room. Place your rewards, move them around, and create a space that feels like home.
instructions: Mouse to play.

name: SandyBay
description: Sandy Bay is a game where you sort colorful sand, find cute pets, feed them, and use helpful bonuses. Have fun!
instructions:
Tap the buckets to send them onto the conveyor.

A bucket will automatically fill with the matching color if it matches the color mark on the pixel picture.

Plan the order of your moves, keep an eye on the available spaces, and clear the entire picture.

Feed the animals and watch them grow! Collect all the pets.

Use bonuses.

name: Flow Board: Parkour Runner
description:
Flow Board: Parkour Runner - a colorful 3D water runner. Your hero races on a board through a warm lagoon between islands, with rocks, ropes, low obstacles, and jellyfish ahead. Switch between three lanes, jump, duck, and keep your momentum: your speed increases with every meter.
Perform flips, kickflips, and spins in the air — tricks earn points and increase your multiplier. Collect Anima to activate Flow, and pick up magnets, gliders, coin multipliers, and mysterious power-ups.
instructions:
Swipe left or right or press the arrow keys to move! Swipe up or press the up arrow to jump!

Obstacle rules: solid obstacles — dodge them, low obstacles — jump over them, if there’s a gap underneath — duck. The jellyfish moves to where the glowing pink ring appears.

Swipe or press the arrow keys while jumping to perform tricks. Collect Anima and activate Flow. Spend coins on boards, heroes, and upgrades in the menu.

name: Noobik: Mission to Mars
description:
A game where you, as an engineer and inventor , must help Nubik build a powerful rocket and send it on an exciting journey to Mars!
Help Nubik build a unique rocket out of blocks and successfully land it on the Red Planet to complete the delivery mission! Here’s what awaits you in this game:
Free-form building with a variety of blocks
Earn stars and unlock new blocks!
Realistic flight physics
Various delivery missions
Endless combinations for creativity
Make it to the top by completing missions!
instructions:
PC Controls:

W - Start/Stop Engines
A - Turn Left
D - Turn Right
The buttons on the right control the Nubik's ejection and parachute.

Controls on mobile platforms:

Arrow keys on the left to rotate the rocket.
Buttons on the right to launch and control the Nubik’s deployment and the parachute.

name: Honey Bee: Word Game
description:
Love making words out of letters? Come and meet the bees!
"Honey Bee: Word Game" is a relaxing word game where every letter turns into a drop of golden honey. In front of you is a flower of seven honeycomb cells: one center letter and six around it. Tap, build a word, send it to the pot and watch the honey rise to the brim.
There is no need to guess the "right" answers - any dictionary word counts. No timer, no moves, no penalties: think as long as you like and forget about the rush.
instructions:
- Pick an open flower on the map - that is your level.
- Tap the honeycomb to build a word. The center letter is required in every word, and the other letters can be used as many times as you like. A word needs at least 4 letters.
- Press "Submit". If the word is in the dictionary, the honey cubes fly into the pot. If not, they just crumble - you lose nothing.
- Wrong letter? Tap a cube in the row and the last letter is removed.

name: Find the Differences with Alice
description:
Every difference you find helps Alice turn an abandoned house into a cozy home.
Compare two pictures, find five differences – and watch the room change: a fireplace, a new sofa, a rug, flowers on the windowsill.
Alice starts her life over in a cold old house. Together you will go from a snowy porch and a dusty closet to a bright living room and a party for her guests.
Features:
• 30 story levels: before each one Alice tells what happened
• The room gets renovated as you progress
instructions:
Your goal is to find five differences between two pictures on each level.
Before a level, Alice tells what is going on. Tap the screen or click to open the level.
On a computer: click a difference on either picture. To look closer, press and hold the mouse button – a magnifier appears; move it over the picture.
On a phone or tablet: tap where you see a difference. Hold your finger on a picture – a magnifier appears; move your finger to compare the details.

name: Bubble words: associations
description:
Every bubble on the board holds a word. Berry, Waltz, Saturn, Screwdriver. Drag one bubble onto another: if the words share a theme, they merge. Four words and the theme is complete — its name lights up on the bubble and it floats away.
Simple, until five themes share one board. Is Guitar music or timber? Is Mars a planet or a god of war? A wrong guess costs no life, only a move — and five right ones in a row give a move back.
instructions:
Drag a bubble onto a bubble. Words of the same theme merge; mismatched ones do not, and the attempt still costs a move. Four words of one theme make a finished bubble: the theme's name appears on it and it floats up into the progress bar.
A level is done when every theme is collected. Moves are shown in the circle at the top, and five correct merges in a row add one. If you run out, you can buy more and continue from the same board.

name: Five Banners Online
description:
Five Banners Online is a fantasy action game with survival, crafting and multiplayer adventures. Explore a floating island, gather resources and fight monsters, then reach the safe zone to turn your haul into supplies. Other players might help you in a fight — or knock loot out of your backpack. When the island begins falling into the abyss, every detour becomes a gamble.
The island changes each cycle. Your base and gear stay with you.
instructions:
Head through the gates, gather wood, stone and ore, and fight monsters. Return to the safe zone to move your backpack's contents into storage automatically. Build workshops and craft equipment to venture farther on your next run.
On a computer:
• WASD or arrow keys — move; mouse — aim; left click — attack and gather.
• Space — dash; Q, E, R — weapon, armor and amulet skills.
• 1/2/3 — select a weapon; F — interact.
• G or 4 — first potion; 5/6 — other potions; Tab — cycle statistics.

name: GPU Tycoon Sim
description:
GPU Tycoon Sim is an immersive hardware management and mining simulator where you step into the role of a crypto entrepreneur. Starting from a humble warehouse, your goal is to build the ultimate mining empire by balancing performance, power, and profit.

Core Features
Deep Rig Building: Get hands-on with hardware. Manually equip motherboards, install powerful GPUs, manage cooling systems, and choose the right power supplies to keep your rigs stable.
Dynamic Market: Mine popular cryptocurrencies like DOGE, ETH, and BTC. Monitor market trends closely to sell your coins at the right time for maximum profit.
Hardware Shop: Visit stores like Tech Haven for new gear or the Scrap Yard for used bargains. Watch for flash sales to grab high-end components at discounted prices.
Expansion and Strategy: Unlock new mining slots, upgrade your skills in the research tree, and manage key factors such as electricity costs and hardware durability.
Competitive Progression: Level up your empire, earn experience from every block solved, and compete in global rankings to become the ultimate mining tycoon.
Special Events: Take part in seasonal battle passes and claim daily rewards to unlock exclusive silicon chips and premium hardware.
With its sleek cartoon-style interface and deep simulation mechanics, GPU Tycoon Sim offers a rewarding experience for both casual players and hardware enthusiasts. Can you manage the heat and reach the top of the leaderboard?
instructions:
Click / Tap = Select buttons, items in the shop, or navigate menus.
Scroll = Use your mouse wheel or swipe up/down to browse long lists (like the Shop inventory or your Rig list).
Tutorial Indicators = On mobile, if a tutorial target is off-screen, animated Yellow Arrows will appear. Scroll in the direction of the arrow to find your next objective.

name: Cakefoot
description: Precision avoider game where you use a single button to walk your cake as far as you can along a line, while obstacles like spikes, bombs, fire, and fish try to eliminate you. Easy to learn - press the button to walk forward, and let go to walk backward - brutally hard to defeat. 22 levels between you and the end of the line. You're live against the world with real time in-game leaderboards. Do you have what it cakes to put your name at the top?
instructions:
- Hold left-click, any key, gamepad button, or touch to walk forward, and let go to walk backward.
- Beat levels and collect coins to unlock emojis. Beat the game and collect all coins to unlock more content, including visual effects, and a faster but heavier cake on the third difficulty.
- Click your name on the title screen to edit your name and emoji.
- Turn off shaders from the pause menu if the framerate is dropping.

name: TwinBind
description: Two cars, one move. Steer both cars at once with a single left or right press and keep them clear of obstacles on two roads. Survive ice, night, wind, turbo and more across 12 stages, then go Endless. Easy to learn, hard to master!
instructions:
Controls
- Keyboard: ← → arrow keys or A / D
- Mobile: tap the left or right half of the screen, or use the on-screen buttons

How to play
- One press moves both cars at the same time.
- A car against the edge of its road stays put while the other one moves. Use this to change the gap between them.
- Obstacles come on one road at a time. Watch both roads and dodge everything.
- Special zones change the rules on one road: inverted controls, ice, mud, night, a narrow bridge, wind and turbo. A road sign shows where each one starts.
- Finish all 12 stages to unlock Endless mode. Collect coins to unlock new car skins, and continue after a crash with coins or an ad.

name: Arrow Jam 3D
description:
Ready to play?
Clear all the arrows! Arrows only move the way they are pointing. Plan the right order to clear the jam before the timer fails you. If you are having trouble, make sure to use the powerful boosters to reach your goal.
instructions:
Desktop
Click an arrow to slide them out
Space on complete/fail to go to the Next level or Retry
Esc to pause

Mobile
Tap an arrow to slide them out
Settings button to pause

Hint
Arrows only move the way they point and bump into anything in their path. Clear the board before time runs out!
Stuck? Use the Hammer to smash an arrow or Freeze to stop the clock.
